eIF2α の Ser51（GCN2 などがリン酸化して抑える部位）を PP1/: PP1/Glc7 dephosphorylates eIF2α Ser51 (the site phosphorylated by GCN2 and others to inhibit it), restoring eIF2 function
eIF2β の変異は eIF5 の GDI を失わせる。eIF2β と eIF5: eIF2β mutations abolish the GDI activity of eIF5. eIF2β and eIF5 cooperate to prevent premature GDP release from eIF2γ (27458202)
eIF4G1 を欠失すると Ssf1・Rrp15・Rrp14・Mak16 が p: Deletion of eIF4G1 causes Ssf1, Rrp15, Rrp14 and Mak16 to abnormally remain on pre-60S (35615984)
eIF5A のハイプシン化は Dys1・Lia1 の 2 段階で起こる。dys1: eIF5A hypusination occurs in two steps by Dys1 and Lia1. dys1-1 reduces hypusine and impairs translation elongation (23573236). Dys1 binds eIF5A (14675757)
eS7 の脱ユビキチン化酵素として Otu2 と Ubp3 を同定。otu2Δ: Otu2 and Ubp3 were identified as deubiquitinases of eS7. otu2Δ ubp3Δ reduces protein synthesis (33665564)
edc3 欠失株では RPS28B の転写産物が特異的に安定化する。これは mR: In edc3 deletion strains, RPS28B transcripts are specifically stabilized. This is due to loss of RPS28B autoregulation at the mRNA decay step, occurring at the decapping step without deadenylation (15225544)
erf2Δ では Ras2 のパルミトイル化が減り、一部が液胞に誤って局在する。: In erf2Δ, Ras2 palmitoylation is reduced and part of it mislocalizes to the vacuole. Erf2 was proposed to be a component of the Ras localization pathway (10490616). Ras2 is palmitoylated by the Ras palmitoyltransferase encoded by ERF2 and ERF4; mutation of the Erf2 DHHC abolishes activity, and a palmitoyl-Erf2 intermediate is detected (12193598)
erg12-d の発現解析で、呼吸の遺伝子の転写因子 RSF2 の発現が特異的に: Expression analysis of erg12-d shows a specific decrease in expression of RSF2, a transcription factor for respiratory genes (29374778)
erv14 erv15 二重変異では前胞子膜ができず、胞子形成培地で t-SNA: erv14 erv15 double mutants fail to form the prospore membrane, and t-SNAREs such as Sso1p accumulate in the ER in sporulation medium (17298976)
esl1Δ esl2Δ 二重変異は Rim101 経路の感知複合体 Rim8・D: esl1Δ esl2Δ double mutants show synthetic growth defects with deletion of Rim8 and Dfg16, components of the Rim101 pathway sensing complex (23893744)
ex vivo のメチル化と MS/MS で Hts1 を含む 12 のタンパク: Ex vivo methylation and MS/MS confirmed 12 proteins including Hts1 as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
ex vivo のメチル化と MS/MS で Mpp10 を含む 12 のタンパ: Ex vivo methylation and MS/MS confirmed 12 proteins including Mpp10 as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
ex vivo のメチル化と MS/MS で Utp4 を含む 12 のタンパク: Ex vivo methylation and MS/MS confirmed 12 proteins including Utp4 as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
ex vivo メチル化と MS/MS で Spp381 を含む 12 タンパク: Ex vivo methylation and MS/MS confirmed 12 proteins including Spp381 as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
fau1 の背景で AICAR が SHM2 の発現を上げ、たまるフォリン酸が: In a fau1 background, AICAR increases SHM2 expression, and accumulated folinic acid was proposed to inhibit methionine synthesis by Met6 (25893566)
fin1 欠失では後期に入っても Bub1 が動原体に残る。後期に入ると FEA: In fin1 deletion, Bub1 remains at kinetochores even after anaphase entry. At anaphase, FEAR recruits Fin1-PP1 to kinetochores to disassemble the SAC at kinetochores (26832405). Kinetochore Fin1-PP1 dephosphorylates Ndc80, reducing Bub1-Bub3 binding to kinetochores in anaphase (34033659)
flx1Δ で SDH のフラビンタンパク質サブユニットの量が強く減る（1455: flx1Δ strongly reduces the level of the SDH flavoprotein subunit (14555654). SDH1 expression was examined in flx1Δ (19192635)
fol1Δ を フォリン酸で育てると侵入性増殖が起き、これは Ste12 と F: fol1Δ grown on folinic acid shows invasive growth, which depends on Ste12 and Flo11 (15169867)
fra1 か fra2 の変異で鉄調節遺伝子の転写が上がり、鉄の多い培地でも A: fra1 or fra2 mutations increase transcription of iron-regulated genes; even in iron-rich medium, Aft1 moves to the nucleus and binds the FET3 promoter. Fra1-Fra2 binds Grx3/4 (18281282)
fra2（YGL220W）の欠損で鉄の多い培地でも Aft1 が核へ移る（182: Loss of fra2 (YGL220W) causes Aft1 to move to the nucleus even in iron-rich medium (18281282). Fra2 His103 is a ligand of the Fe-S cluster in the Fra2-Grx3 complex and is essential for iron-dependent control of Aft1 activity (20978135)
fsh1 欠失で AIF1・NUC1 の発現が下がり、FSH1 過剰発現で AI: fsh1 deletion lowers AIF1 and NUC1 expression, and FSH1 overexpression raises AIF1 (31363875)
fus5・fus8 はそれぞれ AXL1・RAM1 の対立遺伝子で、a 因子の産: fus5 and fus8 are alleles of AXL1 and RAM1, respectively, and reduce a-factor production. Lowering expression of the a-factor gene MFA1 causes the same fusion defect (8991086)
gac1 を欠くと Gsy2 の活性が低くグリコーゲンがたまらず、GAC1 を増: Without gac1, Gsy2 activity is low and glycogen does not accumulate; increasing GAC1 raises Gsy2 activity and causes excess glycogen accumulation (8289829). Gac1 binds both Glc7 and Gsy2 and targets Glc7 to its substrate Gsy2 (11459182)
gar1 変異と合成致死になる遺伝子として RRP8 を同定。Rrp8 は A2: RRP8 was identified as a gene synthetically lethal with gar1 mutations. Rrp8 is involved in A2 cleavage (10864042)
gcr1 欠失で ENO2 の転写が 50 倍下がる。60 bp の要素に RA: gcr1 deletion lowers ENO2 transcription 50-fold. A 60 bp element contains RAP1 and GCR1 binding sites and mediates GCR1-dependent activation (8455635)
gdi1 の変異体で Vps21・Ypt7 が Gdi1 と結合したまま細胞質に: In gdi1 mutants, Vps21 and Ypt7 accumulate in the cytoplasm still bound to Gdi1, and Vps21 cannot be loaded onto membranes in a reconstituted system (11116150)
gef1 変異株は Fet3 に依存する高親和性の鉄の取り込みに欠陥があり、分泌: gef1 mutants are defective in Fet3-dependent high-affinity iron uptake and cannot deliver Cu+ to apoFet3 in the secretory pathway. Cl- promotes copper loading onto Fet3 (9811853)
gim2Δ・gim3Δ・gim6Δ では CTT1 と HSP26 がストレスで: In gim2Δ, gim3Δ and gim6Δ, CTT1 and HSP26 are not induced by stress. Gim2, Gim3 and Gim6 are required for transcription activated by oxidative and osmotic stress (28457997)
gim5 などの欠損は tub4-1 と合成致死。Gim タンパク質は Tub4: Loss of gim5 and others is synthetically lethal with tub4-1. Gim proteins are important for Tub4p function and bind overexpressed Tub4p (9463374)
gin4 欠損で Fpk1 が過剰に働く。Gin4 は芽の出る位置で Fpk1: Loss of gin4 causes Fpk1 hyperactivity. Gin4 colocalizes with Fpk1 at the bud site and phosphorylates many sites; Fpk1 with 11 sites mutated to alanine is hyperactive (25646086)
glc7-1 変異株はグリコーゲンをためられず、Gsy2 は過リン酸化され不活性: glc7-1 mutants cannot accumulate glycogen, and Gsy2 is hyperphosphorylated and inactive. Mutations in the Gsy2 C-terminus suppress glc7-1 (11208778). Gsy2 lacking the C-terminus or S650, S654, T667 mutants restore glycogen accumulation in glc7 and gac1 mutants (8226915)
gle2∆ で Cdc42 の局在が大きく乱れ、セプチン複合体の形成と細胞分裂に: gle2∆ severely disrupts Cdc42 localization, causing defects in septin complex formation and cell division (28776765)
gln3Δgat1Δ で AVT1・AVT7 の発現が下がる（33624780）: gln3Δgat1Δ lowers AVT1 and AVT7 expression (33624780)
gln3∆gat1∆ で AVT1・AVT7 の発現が下がることを確かめた（33: It was confirmed that gln3∆gat1∆ lowers AVT1 and AVT7 expression (33624780)
glo1 欠失で Met17 の発現が下がるが、両者の直接の相互作用はない（27: glo1 deletion lowers Met17 expression, but there is no direct interaction between them (27935278)
got1 sft2 の二重欠失で ER→ゴルジ体の輸送が止まり、どちらか一方があ: got1 sft2 double deletion blocks ER→Golgi transport; vesicle fusion occurs if either one is present (10406798)
gpi1 変異株では GFP-Kre1 が培地へ分泌される。Kre1 は GPI: In gpi1 mutants, GFP-Kre1 is secreted into the medium. Kre1 is GPI-anchored (15470101)
gsf2 変異で Hxt1 が小胞体にたまる。Gsf2 は小胞体の膜タンパク質（: gsf2 mutations cause Hxt1 to accumulate in the ER. Gsf2 is an ER membrane protein (10377429)
gsf2 変異でガラクトースでの増殖が悪く、Gal2 の局在が異常。Hxt2 は: gsf2 mutations impair growth on galactose and Gal2 localization is abnormal. Hxt2 is normal (10377429)
gsk-3 欠失株と bul1 bul2 二重欠失株で Rog1 が安定化する（: Rog1 is stabilized in gsk-3 deletion strains and bul1 bul2 double deletion strains (10958669)
guk1(bra3) 変異で GMP がたまり HGPRT(HPT1) がフィー: guk1 (bra3) mutations cause GMP accumulation and feedback inhibition of HGPRT (HPT1). Purified HGPRT is inhibited by GMP (11063676)
gwt1 変異株では Gas1 の輸送が遅れ ER から Golgi への成熟に: In gwt1 mutants, Gas1 transport is delayed, with a defect in ER-to-Golgi maturation. Invertase and CPY are normal (12714589)
hal2 変異でたまる pAp が 5'→3' エキソヌクレアーゼ Xrn1・R: pAp accumulating in hal2 mutants inhibits the 5'→3' exonucleases Xrn1 and Rat1. Lithium causes the same through inhibition of Hal2 (9384595)
hap1・hap2/3/4・yap-1 の変異で ERG9 の発現が下がり、in: Mutations in hap1, hap2/3/4 and yap-1 lower ERG9 expression, while ino2/4 mutations raise it (10209263)
his3 はアミノ酸飢餓で誘導され、Gcn4 結合部位 ATGACTCTT の変: his3 is induced by amino acid starvation; mutation of the Gcn4 binding site ATGACTCTT reduces both in vivo induction and in vitro binding (3532321). Gcn4 binds specifically to the HIS3 regulatory region (3907851)
hmo1Δ で Fhl1 と Ifh1 の RP 遺伝子のプロモーターへの結合が: In hmo1Δ, binding of Fhl1 and Ifh1 to RP gene promoters is lost. Hmo1 is required for assembly of a transcription factor complex containing Fhl1 and Ifh1 (16612005)
In hmo1Δ, binding of Fhl1 and Ifh1 to RP gene promoters is lost (16612005). Fhl1 also binds the HMO1 promoter in an HMO1-dependent manner and is involved in its regulation by TOR (21924331)
hmt1 欠失でリン酸応答遺伝子（PHO5・PHO11・PHO12 など）の転写: hmt1 deletion lowers transcription of phosphate-responsive genes (PHO5, PHO11, PHO12 and others) (30206180)
hmt1Δ でリン酸応答遺伝子（PHO5・PHO11・PHO12 など）の転写が: hmt1Δ lowers transcription of phosphate-responsive genes (PHO5, PHO11, PHO12 and others) (30206180)
hog1Δ・ssk1Δ・msn1Δ で MG 添加後の MG 応答遺伝子の mR: hog1Δ, ssk1Δ and msn1Δ reduce mRNA accumulation of MG-responsive genes after MG addition (15773992)
hot1 単独変異株は浸透圧ショック後の GPD1・GPP2 の一過性の誘導が特: hot1 single mutants show particularly weak transient induction of GPD1 and GPP2 after osmotic shock (10409737)
hot1 single mutants show particularly weak transient induction of GPD1 and GPP2 after osmotic shock, and glycerol accumulation is delayed (10409737)
hpg1（rsp5 の変異）や bul1Δ bul2Δ では Tat2 の定常量: In hpg1 (an rsp5 mutation) and bul1Δ bul2Δ, steady-state Tat2 levels increase greatly, and under high pressure it is degraded in an Rsp5-dependent manner (14560004). Tat2 is degraded under high hydrostatic pressure in an Rsp5-dependent manner (19944104)
hsk3 変異で Dam1・Duo1・Spc34・Spc19 と Ask1 の結: hsk3 mutations greatly reduce association of Dam1, Duo1, Spc34 and Spc19 with Ask1, suggesting that Hsk3 incorporates Ask1 into DASH (15632076)
hsk3 変異では Dam1・Duo1・Spc34・Spc19 と Ask1 の: hsk3 mutations greatly reduce association of Dam1, Duo1, Spc34 and Spc19 with Ask1 (15632076)
hur1-A 欠失は tpk1・nej1 欠失と同じく NHEJ の効率を下げ、: hur1-A deletion, like tpk1 and nej1 deletions, lowers NHEJ efficiency, and double deletions show the same reduction (same pathway). No mention of phosphorylation (28987344) (PMID: 28987344)
hxk1Δhxk2Δ で糖を加えた直後の Mig1 の核への蓄積は、フルクトース: In hxk1Δhxk2Δ, nuclear accumulation of Mig1 immediately after sugar addition is restored by expression of any sugar kinase, except Glk1 with fructose. Sustained shuttling is restored only by Hxk1 and Hxk2 (32948893)
ime1Δ PGAL1-IME2 株で、Ids2 は SPS100 など中期・後: In ime1Δ PGAL1-IME2 strains, Ids2 is essential for expression of middle and late genes such as SPS100 (7565676)
ime1Δ PGAL1-IME2 株で、Ids2 は SPS2 など中期・後期の: In ime1Δ PGAL1-IME2 strains, Ids2 is essential for expression of middle and late genes such as SPS2 (7565676)
ira 変異株では過剰発現した Ras1・Ras2 が GTP 型にたまり、野生: In ira mutants, overexpressed Ras1 and Ras2 accumulate in the GTP-bound form, whereas the GDP-bound form predominates in wild type. Ira1 and Ira2 lower Ras-GTP levels (2178777)
isw2 変異で MATα 細胞の BAR1 のヌクレオソームの位置決めが失われ: isw2 mutations abolish BAR1 nucleosome positioning in MATα cells, partially relieving repression (16980406)
iwr1 変異株では Pol III プロモーターでの TBP と Pol II: In iwr1 mutants, TBP and Pol III binding at Pol III promoters is reduced, and TBP binding is also reduced at Pol I and Pol II genes (21695216)
jsn1 欠失でミトコンドリアと共局在する Arc18-GFP が半分に減る。J: jsn1 deletion halves the Arc18-GFP colocalizing with mitochondria. Jsn1 coprecipitates with Arc18-GFP (16107558)
keg1-1 変異細胞では Kre6 の芽への集積が減り、Keg1 との結合が下: In keg1-1 mutant cells, Kre6 accumulation in the bud decreases, its binding to Keg1 is reduced, and Kre6 becomes more susceptible to ERAD degradation. Polarized localization of Kre6 is required for β-1,6-glucan synthesis (22447934)
kin1Δ kin2Δ では HAC1 mRNA の Ire1 の集まりへの移動: In kin1Δ kin2Δ, recruitment of HAC1 mRNA to Ire1 clusters, its splicing and translation are greatly reduced, and the Kin2 kinase domain alone can activate the UPR (25348718). Kin1/Kin2 directly phosphorylate Pal2, and non-phosphorylatable Pal2 cannot rescue the UPR defect (34035143)
knr4 欠失では SBF が異常に活性化し、リン酸化型 Swi6 が増え、SC: In knr4 deletion, SBF is abnormally activated, phosphorylated Swi6 increases, SCB-lacZ rises, and periodic expression of cell-cycle genes is disrupted (12823808)
ktr1・ktr2・yur1 の欠失株で N-結合型糖鎖をもつインベルターゼの電: In ktr1, ktr2 and yur1 deletion strains, the electrophoretic mobility of invertase bearing N-linked glycans changes; the three are thought to be mannosyltransferases acting redundantly in N-linked glycan addition (8631921)
l-Mgm1 から s-Mgm1 への変換は Pcp1 に依存し、Pcp1 によ: Conversion of l-Mgm1 to s-Mgm1 depends on Pcp1; cleavage by Pcp1 and both forms are important for mitochondrial shape and mtDNA maintenance (12707284). pcp1Δ cannot cleave Mgm1 and has only the 100 kDa form; like mgm1Δ, mitochondria fragment and mtDNA is lost, although fusion is possible (12901865). Rbd1 (Pcp1) mutants are indistinguishable from Mgm1 mutants (12774122)
ldb18Δ では Nip100 と Jnm1 の結合が失われるが、Jnm1 と: In ldb18Δ, Nip100-Jnm1 binding is lost, but Jnm1-Arp1 binding is retained (18245366)
leu3Δ の転写解析と Leu3 の DNA 結合のデータを合わせ、BAT1・: Combining leu3Δ transcriptional analysis with Leu3 DNA-binding data identified BAT1, GAT1 and OAC1 as new Leu3 targets (15949974) (PMID: 15949974)
los1 変異で SOL1 mRNA と Sol1 が減る。LOS1 は SOL: los1 mutations reduce SOL1 mRNA and Sol1. LOS1 positively regulates SOL1 (8725220)
los1Δ は Gcd-（GCN4 の翻訳の抑制が外れる）（10713174）。: los1Δ is Gcd- (repression of GCN4 translation is relieved) (10713174). Gcn4 is activated when unspliced tRNA accumulates in the nucleus upon DNA damage (18045534)
lrg1 変異は fks1-1154 Δfks2 と rho1-2 のグルカン合: lrg1 mutations rescue the glucan synthesis defects of fks1-1154 Δfks2 and rho1-2; of the 8 Rho GAPs, only Lrg1 negatively regulates GS activity (11447600)
lst8-1 で Rtg1/3 の活性が脱抑制され細胞内アミノ酸が増える。Lst: lst8-1 derepresses Rtg1/3 activity and increases intracellular amino acids. Lst8 binds Tor1 and Tor2 (12719473)
m-AAA プロテアーゼの Afg3 と Yta12 は Ccp1 の 1 段目: The m-AAA protease subunits Afg3 and Yta12 are essential for the first cleavage of Ccp1. Disrupting the protease site stops cleavage (12417197)
The m-AAA protease subunits Afg3 and Yta12 are essential for the first cleavage of Ccp1 (12417197)
m2G10 を作る酵素は触媒サブユニット Trm11 と Trm112 からなり: The enzyme forming m2G10 consists of the catalytic subunit Trm11 and Trm112, which associate in vivo. Both are required for m2G10 formation (15899842)
m6A メチル基転移酵素 Ime4 は減数分裂の転写抑制因子 Rme1 の mR: The m6A methyltransferase Ime4 acts by methylating sites in the 3′ UTR of the mRNA for Rme1, a transcriptional repressor of meiosis. Genetically, IME4 is upstream of RME1. RME1 is the main mRNA whose methylation increases and expression decreases in an Ime4-dependent manner (31363087)
mac1Δ の発現解析で変化した遺伝子の欠失株を調べ、YLR047C などに銅・: Deletion strains of genes changed in mac1Δ expression analysis were examined, showing roles for YLR047C and others in copper and iron homeostasis (14534306)
mac1Δ・hst1Δ で BNA 遺伝子が脱抑制される。BNA2 プロモーター: BNA genes are derepressed in mac1Δ and hst1Δ. ChIP at the BNA2 promoter shows that Mac1 acts together with a repressor complex containing Hst1 (30760525)
maf1 変異株では Mod5p-I の細胞内の局在が変わり、核に誤局在する（7: In maf1 mutants, the subcellular localization of Mod5p-I changes, mislocalizing to the nucleus (7732762)
mak5 変異との合成致死スクリーンで Rpl14・Ebp2・Nop16・Rpf: A synthetic lethal screen with mak5 mutations found Rpl14, Ebp2, Nop16 and Rpf1 (24312670)
mds3 の欠失で mck1 での IME1 転写産物の低下が回復。mds3 p: mds3 deletion restores the reduced IME1 transcripts in mck1. In mds3 pmd1, IME1 is expressed even during vegetative growth and premature sporulation occurs (9383076)
met30 変異で Swe1 は安定化し、Met30 は生体内で Swe1 に結: met30 mutations stabilize Swe1, and Met30 binds Swe1 in vivo. cdc34 or met30 extracts cannot polyubiquitinate Swe1 (9716410)
mig1 欠失で DOG2 の基礎発現が上がる（10960096）: mig1 deletion raises basal DOG2 expression (10960096)
mih1∆ でも Cdk1 は G1 へ進むと脱リン酸化される。Ptp1 は体内: Even in mih1∆, Cdk1 is dephosphorylated upon progression into G1. Ptp1 is involved in Cdk1 dephosphorylation in vivo and directly dephosphorylates it in vitro (26715668)
mim1Δ では Tom40 が SAM の第 1 段階にたまり、Tom5 がこ: In mim1Δ, Tom40 accumulates at the first stage of SAM, and Tom5 suppresses this. Mim1's role for Tom40 is mainly through import of Tom5 (20668160)
mir1 欠失でストレス時の Ybh3 のミトコンドリアへの移行がなくなる（21: mir1 deletion abolishes translocation of Ybh3 to mitochondria under stress (21673659)
mms1Δ・mms22Δ ではヒドロキシ尿素で停止したフォークへの Mrc1・C: In mms1Δ and mms22Δ, binding of Mrc1, Csm3 and Pol ε to forks stalled by hydroxyurea is reduced (21593207)
mnr2 変異で Alr1 の活性が上がり、Alr1 は細胞内の Mg の供給で: mnr2 mutations increase Alr1 activity; Alr1 is regulated by intracellular Mg supply (21738593)
mog1 変異で SLN1-SKN7 の信号伝達が欠け Skn7 が核から外れる: mog1 mutations impair SLN1-SKN7 signaling and Skn7 leaves the nucleus (15590828)
mog1 欠損で Gsp1 が核に溜まらない（11024003）。Mog1 は: Loss of mog1 prevents Gsp1 from accumulating in the nucleus (11024003). Mog1 releases nucleotide from Ran-GTP and Ran-GDP to form a stable complex with nucleotide-free Ran; mutations disrupting Mog1-Ran binding (Mog1 E65K, Gsp1 K136E) reduce nuclear import (11509570). The in vivo effect on the GTP state of Gsp1 itself is not described, hence medium
mot3 欠失で ANB1 の抑制が弱まる。Mot3 は ANB1 の OpA: mot3 deletion weakens ANB1 repression. Mot3 binds the ANB1 OpA in vitro (10982825)
mpt5Δ の高温感受性を抑える欠失として dsf1（YEL070W）などを同定: dsf1 (YEL070W) and others were identified as deletions suppressing the high-temperature sensitivity of mpt5Δ (16328373)
mre11-S499P と rad50-A78T は Tel1-MRX の結合を: mre11-S499P and rad50-A78T weaken Tel1-MRX binding, abolishing Tel1 recruitment to DSBs and Tel1 activation (30698745). In vitro, Tel1 activation requires DNA and Rad50 plus either Mre11 or Xrs2 (31073030)
mrp1 変異は pet122 の C 末端欠失を対立遺伝子特異的に抑圧し、Pe: mrp1 mutations allele-specifically suppress C-terminal deletions of pet122, suggesting that Pet122 promotes coxIII mRNA translation through interaction with the small subunit (1848523)
msg5 の欠損で Fus3 の活性は上がるが Ste7 は変わらず、フェロモン: Loss of msg5 increases Fus3 activity without changing Ste7, and weakens adaptation to pheromone. Recombinant Msg5 has phosphatase activity and inactivates autophosphorylated Fus3 (8306972)
msn2/msn4 二重変異株での実験から、弱い熱ストレスと塩ショックでの GS: Experiments with msn2/msn4 double mutants showed that transcriptional induction of GSY2 by mild heat stress and salt shock is required for the increase in glycogen (9202465)

Experiments with msn2/msn4 double mutants revealed transcriptional induction of GSY2 and TPS1 by mild heat stress and salt shock (9202465). Msn2,4 are required for the increase in mRNAs of TPS1, TPS2, HSP104 and others at 10 °C or below (15053871)
Experiments with msn2/msn4 double mutants showed that transcriptional induction of GSY2 (glycogen synthase) by mild heat stress and salt shock is required for the increase in glycogen (9202465)
msn5 変異では細胞が大きく、Cln2 が大きく減る（SBF に依存する転写の: msn5 mutant cells are large and Cln2 is greatly reduced (decreased SBF-dependent transcription). Msn5 is required for nuclear export of Swi6 in G2-M, and export of Swi6 to the cytoplasm is required for SBF activity (12697814)
mtHsp70 が Atp5 を組み立ての流れに渡し、触媒の頭部と周辺の柄をつな: mtHsp70 hands Atp5 over to the assembly line, linking the catalytic head and the peripheral stalk. Inactivation leads to incorporation of defective Atp5 (36596815)
mtHsp70-Hsp10 複合体が未集合の Hsp60 前駆体に結合し、成熟: The mtHsp70-Hsp10 complex binds unassembled Hsp60 precursors and promotes formation of mature Hsp60 complexes (25792736)
mtm1Δ で Sod2 の活性が大きく下がり、亜鉛を加えても戻らない（3387: mtm1Δ greatly reduces Sod2 activity, which is not restored by adding zinc (33872833)
mtr10 変異では Npl3 の核への取り込みが強く妨げられ、古典的 NLS: In mtr10 mutants, nuclear import of Npl3 is strongly impaired, while import of classical NLS cargo is not. Purified Mtr10 forms a complex with Npl3 (9545233). Mtr10 mediates nuclear import of Npl3, and its loss shifts Npl3 to the cytoplasm (9412460)
myo2 smy1 の条件変異の解析で、Smy1 は分泌小胞上で Myo2 と受: Analysis of conditional myo2 smy1 mutants showed that Smy1 is a factor strengthening binding between Myo2 and its receptor Sec4 on secretory vesicles. The Smy1 tail (which binds Myo2), dimerization domain and head are all required, and overexpression of full-length Smy1 increases Sec4 and Myo2 per vesicle
myo2 smy1 変異の過剰発現による抑圧因子として F-BAR をもつ Rh: Rgd3, an F-BAR RhoGAP, was identified as an overexpression suppressor of myo2 smy1 mutations; it acts mainly on Rho3 and secondarily on Cdc42. Rgd3 overexpression alters the distribution of Rho3 at the plasma membrane (32941095). Main text: in vitro, Rgd3 stimulates the GTPase activity of Rho3 and Cdc42 about 2-fold. Consistent with the GO direction (inhibition)
nat4 変異体の H4 と H2A は N 末端がアセチル化されていない（12: H4 and H2A in nat4 mutants are not N-terminally acetylated (12915400). The effect of Nat4 on the DNA damage checkpoint is due to its N-terminal acetylation activity on H4 (39356727)
not2-4・not2::R165G で NOT2 と ADA2 の結合が失われ: not2-4 and not2::R165G abolish NOT2-ADA2 binding (12215412)
npt1 変異で 3 種のサイレンシングがすべて弱まり、細胞内 NAD+ が減る: npt1 mutations weaken all three types of silencing and reduce intracellular NAD+. Model in which Pnc1 and Npt1 recycle nicotinamide produced by Sir2 back to NAD+ (11901108)
nsf1 欠失で NaCl による ENA1 の転写活性化が損なわれ、炭素源と: nsf1 deletion impairs NaCl-induced transcriptional activation of ENA1; activation of ENA1 by carbon source and NaCl depends on Nsf1 (18667581)
nup100 欠損・nup2 欠損で Msn5 による Crz1 の核外輸送が遅: Loss of nup100 or nup2 slows Msn5-mediated nuclear export of Crz1, as does nup100ΔGLFG. The Crz1 CDRE-lacZ reporter rises in nup100ΔGLFG and nsp1ΔFGΔFXFG, where export is slow, and is unchanged in nup1ΔFXFG (23295456)
nup116-C の致死を抑える多コピーの抑圧遺伝子として SNL1 を同定（9: SNL1 was identified as a multicopy suppressor of nup116-C lethality (9450961). Snl1 unable to bind Hsp70 does not suppress the nup116 defect (12105220)
ogg1Δ でテロメアに結合した Rap1 と Rif2 の量が減る（19942: ogg1Δ reduces the amount of Rap1 and Rif2 bound to telomeres (19942858)
orm1/2Δ では Ypk1 の活性化部位のリン酸化が減り、Ypk1 の基質: In orm1/2Δ, phosphorylation of the Ypk1 activation site decreases, as does phosphorylation of the Ypk1 substrate Lac1 (reduced activity in vivo). Depends on LCBs. Ceramide synthesis falls, and endocytosis and actin polarization become abnormal (39490931). Results in the double deletion
oxa1 欠失で PSD1 の転写と Psd1 の内膜への組み込みが下がり、PE: oxa1 deletion reduces PSD1 transcription and integration of Psd1 into the inner membrane, decreasing PE (17976194)
p20 は eIF4E に結合して eIF4G と競い、eIF4E の活性を調節: p20 binds eIF4E and competes with eIF4G, modulating eIF4E activity to inhibit cap-dependent translation initiation. Disrupting CAF20 speeds growth, and overexpression slows it (9118949)
pbp1Δ は非発酵性炭素源で増殖が遅れ、COX10・COX11 の発現が下がる: pbp1Δ grows slowly on non-fermentable carbon sources, and COX10 and COX11 expression decreases. COX10 and COX11 expression is controlled by Pbp1 independently of the promoter, and the decrease in pbp1Δ is restored by deletion of Dcp1 or Xrn1 (33984024)
pbp1Δ・fir1Δ・ref2Δ 細胞の抽出液を用いた試験管内のポリアデニル化: In vitro polyadenylation reactions using extracts of pbp1Δ, fir1Δ and ref2Δ cells showed that Pbp1 is a negative regulator of PAN (poly(A) nuclease) activity (15121841). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition)
pcl6・pcl7・pcl8・pcl10 の欠失で glc7-R121K が致死: Deletion of pcl6, pcl7, pcl8 and pcl10 makes glc7-R121K lethal; these cyclins redundantly activate Pho85 (12407105)
pdr1-3 で SNQ2 が 10 倍に増え、pdr1 欠失で大きく減り、pd: pdr1-3 increases SNQ2 10-fold; pdr1 deletion greatly reduces it, and pdr1 pdr3 double deletion nearly abolishes it (8861209)
pdx1 破壊株の PDH 複合体は protein X と E3（ジヒドロリポ: The PDH complex of pdx1 disruptants lacks protein X and E3 (dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase) and is inactive. Lacking the binding domain of protein X abolishes high-affinity binding and activity of E3 (2007123)
pep4-3 変異は CPY 前駆体の成熟を妨げ、たまった前駆体は活性がない。p: The pep4-3 mutation blocks maturation of the CPY precursor, and the accumulated precursor is inactive. prb1 mutations do not affect CPY maturation (7017716)
pet122 の C 末端欠失は PET123（ミトリボソーム小サブユニットのタ: C-terminal deletions of pet122 are allele-specifically suppressed by mutations in PET123 (a mitoribosomal small subunit protein) (1848523, 2167435)
pet127 欠失で COB の前駆体 RNA がたまり、Pet127 が前駆体: pet127 deletion causes accumulation of COB precursor RNA; Pet127 provides the 5'→3' exonuclease that converts precursors to the mature form (18086665)
pet130・gep5 などの ts 変異の組み合わせで合成的な呼吸欠損。4 つ: Combinations of ts mutations in pet130, gep5 and others cause synthetic respiratory deficiency. The four are part of a high-molecular-weight inner membrane complex, possibly a complex shared with Rpm2 (30759361)
pet157 変異で前駆体 mRNA がたまり、PET157 の産物は cob-: pet157 mutations cause accumulation of precursor mRNA; the PET157 product is required for excision of bI3 of the cob-box and aI6 of coxI (1699677)
pho85 変異株では Ash1 が母細胞にも残り安定性が増す。Pho85 は試: In pho85 mutants, Ash1 also remains in the mother cell and its stability increases. Pho85 phosphorylates Ash1 in vitro, and this phosphorylation is thought to determine Ash1 stability (PMID 11703659). 21098119 is a paper on degradation by Cdc28
pho85 欠損での過剰発現の表現型から Crz1 を Pho85 の基質として: Crz1 was found as a Pho85 substrate from the overexpression phenotype in pho85 loss (16455487)
pho85 欠損でグリコーゲンが過剰にたまり、グリコーゲン合成酵素が活性化する（: Loss of pho85 causes excess glycogen accumulation and activation of glycogen synthase (8754836). Pho85-Pcl10 phosphorylates Gsy2 at physiological sites and inactivates it (10490639)
pho85Δ で UGP1 のプロモーター活性が上がり、pho4Δ や Pho4: pho85Δ increases UGP1 promoter activity, but not in pho4Δ or with promoters lacking Pho4 and Bas2 binding sites. UGP1 expression is regulated by Pho85 through Pho4 (11180457)
pho86 欠失では Pho84 が小胞体にとどまり細胞膜へ行かない。試験管内の: In pho86 deletion, Pho84 stays in the ER and does not reach the plasma membrane. In in vitro budding assays, Pho86 is required for packaging of Pho84 into COPII vesicles (10655492)
pho92 欠失で PHO4 mRNA の半減期が延びる。Pho92 はリン酸依: pho92 deletion extends the half-life of PHO4 mRNA. Pho92 binds the PHO4 3'UTR in a phosphate-dependent manner and destabilizes the mRNA (24206186)
pil1Δ と 6 回膜貫通タンパク質（Sur7 ファミリー・Nce102 ファ: The SDS sensitivity of pil1Δ and of deletion strains of tetraspanning proteins (Sur7 family, Nce102 family) is due to excessive activation of TORC2-Ypk1 (35383382)
pim1Δ だけが Isu を増やし（ほかのミトコンドリアのプロテアーゼでは増え: Only pim1Δ increases Isu (other mitochondrial proteases do not), and Isu is a substrate of the Lon-type protease also with purified proteins (26842892)
pkc1Δ 細胞では Ypk1 の量が大きく減り、Pkc1 が Ypk1 の量を: In pkc1Δ cells, Ypk1 levels are greatly reduced; Pkc1 controls Ypk1 levels (15016821)
pkr1 欠失で Vph1 の分解が速まり量が減る。Pkr1 は ER で V-: pkr1 deletion accelerates Vph1 degradation and reduces its level. Pkr1 assists assembly of V0, the membrane sector of V-ATPase, in the ER (16926153)
pmc1::lacZ はカルシニューリン・カルモジュリン・Ca2+ に依存して最: pmc1::lacZ is induced up to 500-fold dependent on calcineurin, calmodulin and Ca2+, while vcx1::lacZ decreases slightly (8628289)
pmr1 細胞で ScRCH1 を過剰発現すると ENA1 の発現が下がり、細胞: Overexpression of ScRCH1 in pmr1 cells lowers ENA1 expression and suppresses cytosolic calcium accumulation and calcineurin activation (26832117)
pmt2 変異株では Mid2 が O-マンノシル化されず、この修飾は Mid2: In pmt2 mutants, Mid2 is not O-mannosylated, and this modification is important for signaling by Mid2 (11113201)
pof1 欠失で Sdt1 の代謝回転がやや遅れる（41999890）: pof1 deletion slightly slows Sdt1 turnover (41999890)
pol α 複合体に伴うヘキサマーの DNA ヘリカーゼ A を精製し、その遺伝: Hexameric DNA helicase A associated with the pol α complex was purified and its gene identified as ykl017c. Helicase activity is stimulated by yeast RPA (9341217)
pol30 の変異が cdc44 の低温感受性の変異を抑圧するが null は抑: pol30 mutations suppress cold-sensitive cdc44 mutations but not the null. PCNA is thought to interact with Cdc44p (Rfc1) (7516465)
pol31-T415A は Pol3 CysB 領域との結合を弱め、W417A: pol31-T415A weakens binding to the Pol3 CysB region, and W417A strengthens it. pol32Δ reduces Pol3 and Pol31 levels, which W417A restores (34226278)
pos5 utr1 は合成致死で、POS5 か UTR1 のプラスミドで回復する: pos5 utr1 is synthetically lethal and is rescued by a POS5 or UTR1 plasmid. Utr1 and Pos5 account for nearly all NAD/NADH kinase activity in vivo (16760478)
ppm1 変異株でだけ Pph21p と Pph22p がメチル化されない（11: Pph21p and Pph22p are unmethylated only in ppm1 mutants (11697862)
pre3-1・pre3-6 変異体はプロテアソームの分解が欠け、fructose: pre3-1 and pre3-6 mutants lack proteasomal degradation, stabilizing substrates such as fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase (9677364)
pre9 欠失のプロテアソームには Pre6 が 2 倍入っていて、Pre6 が: Proteasomes from pre9 deletion contain two copies of Pre6, with Pre6 occupying the position of Pre9 (14739934)
pre9 欠失株で Btn2p が最も増えたタンパク質。プロテアソームの障害で抗: Btn2p is the most increased protein in pre9 deletion strains. Proteasome impairment reduces degradation of the anti-prion factors Btn2 and Cur1 (33742650). Because the summary says pre9Δ, matching finds only one of the two
pri1 と pri2 の変異の組み合わせはすべて致死で、両サブユニットが生体内: All combinations of pri1 and pri2 mutations are lethal, evidence that the two subunits interact directly in vivo (8436268)
prp45(1-169) で Cwc2 と共精製されるスプライソソームの Prp: prp45(1-169) reduces spliceosomal Prp22 copurifying with Cwc2. Prp45 supports splicing efficiency of non-canonical substrates through its interaction with Prp22 (19016306)
pse1-1 の温度感受性株では Yap1 の核への移行が大きく妨げられる。試験: In the temperature-sensitive pse1-1 strain, nuclear translocation of Yap1 is greatly impaired. In vitro, Yap1 binds Pse1 directly and is released by Ran-GTP. Pse1 is the nuclear import receptor for Yap1, with a minor role for Kap123. The import step is not affected by oxidative stress (11274141)
pse1-1 変異で Pdr1 は細胞質に局在し Pdr3 は変わらない。Pse: pse1-1 mutations make Pdr1 localize to the cytoplasm, while Pdr3 is unchanged. Pse1 and Pdr1 interact in vivo, and 44 amino acids of Pdr1 are necessary and sufficient for Pse1-dependent import. The paper states that Pse1 appears to be the only import receptor for Pdr1 (11136452)
pse1-1 株では鉄欠乏でも Aft1 が細胞質にとどまり、Aft1 は Ps: In pse1-1 strains, Aft1 stays in the cytoplasm even under iron deficiency; Aft1 binds Pse1 directly and is released by RanGTP. Induction of FTR1 under iron deficiency is also greatly reduced in pse1-1 (14523005)
ptc1 欠損で増える Slt2 のリン酸化は MKK1 の欠損で消える。Ptc: The increased Slt2 phosphorylation in ptc1 loss disappears with loss of MKK1. Ptc1 acts at the MAPKK step of the CWI pathway and can dephosphorylate Mkk1 in vitro. Many ptc1 phenotypes are due to excessive Slt2 activation from elevated Mkk1 (26546002)
ptc1Δptc6Δ で Congo red 後の Slt2 リン酸化と KDX: In ptc1Δptc6Δ, Slt2 phosphorylation and KDX1 transcription after Congo red increase more than in ptc1Δ. PTC6 negatively regulates Slt2 phosphorylation under cell wall stress (25449759)
ptp1 変異でチロシンリン酸化された p70（Fpr3）が増え、組換え Ptp: ptp1 mutations increase tyrosine-phosphorylated p70 (Fpr3), and recombinant Ptp1 directly dephosphorylates Fpr3. The site is Tyr184 (7559654)
rad28 欠失株は RAD7 または RAD16 の変異があると UV 感受性: rad28 deletion strains show slightly increased UV sensitivity when RAD7 or RAD16 is mutated (8830695)
rad50-A78T は Tel1-MRX の結合を弱め、DSB への Tel1: rad50-A78T weakens Tel1-MRX binding, abolishing Tel1 recruitment to DSBs and Tel1 activation (30698745). In vitro, Rad50 ATPase activity is essential for Tel1 activation (31073030)
rad52-L89F は Rad59 との相互作用が損なわれ rad59Δ に似: rad52-L89F impairs interaction with Rad59 and resembles rad59Δ. Rad59 acts in homologous recombination through physical interaction with Rad52 (15454565)
rad6 変異体ではユビキチン化 H2B が検出されず、Rad6 が H2B を: Ubiquitinated H2B is not detected in rad6 mutants; Rad6 is the main enzyme ubiquitinating H2B (10642555). Mutations at the Rad6-Bre1 interface reduce H2Bub1 in vivo (36715322)
rai1Δ の増殖欠陥は RAT1 の追加コピーで補われ、rai1Δ は rat: The growth defect of rai1Δ is complemented by an extra copy of RAT1, and rai1Δ is synthetically lethal with rat1-1. The 60S biogenesis defect of rai1Δ is nearly restored by high-copy RAT1. In vivo data suggest RAI1 enhances RAT1 function, and purified Rai1 stabilizes the exoribonuclease activity of Rat1 in vitro (10805743)
ras1 ras2 の膜は GTP で活性化されるアデニル酸シクラーゼ活性を欠き: ras1 ras2 membranes lack GTP-activated adenylate cyclase activity, and RAS2val19 raises cAMP
ras1 ras2 の膜は GTP で活性化されるアデニル酸シクラーゼ活性を欠く: ras1 ras2 membranes lack GTP-activated adenylate cyclase activity
rcy1Δ・snx4Δ 単独では Snc1 を再利用できるが、二重で大きく止まる: rcy1Δ or snx4Δ alone can still recycle Snc1, but the double mutant largely blocks it (32074001)
reg1Δ ではグルコースを加えても Rod1 が脱リン酸化・ユビキチン化されず: In reg1Δ, Rod1 is not dephosphorylated or ubiquitinated even upon glucose addition, impairing Jen1 endocytosis (22249293)
rei1Δ reh1Δ の pre-60S は eL24 を欠き、Rei1・Re: pre-60S from rei1Δ reh1Δ lacks eL24; Rei1 and Reh1 assist incorporation of eL24 into pre-60S (42615089)
rer1 欠失で Sec12 が ER に留まらず後期ゴルジへ漏れる。Rer1: rer1 deletion prevents retention of Sec12 in the ER, causing leakage to the late Golgi. Rer1 and α-COP initiate retrieval in the early Golgi (9152025)
rim13 の変異で Rim1p（Rim101）の C 末端の切断が止まる（90: rim13 mutations block C-terminal cleavage of Rim1p (Rim101) (9017390). Disruption of CPL1 (RIM13) promotes Rim101 degradation, and active Rim101 lacking the C-terminus suppresses alkaline sensitivity. Protease activity is essential (9928935)
rit1 欠失株で TEF2 を多コピーにすると生育が悪化。未修飾の開始 tRN: In rit1 deletion strains, multicopy TEF2 worsens growth, presumably because unmodified initiator tRNA is taken up for elongation (10485288)
rml2(fat21) 変異ではオレイン酸による CTA1 の mRNA と活性: In rml2 (fat21) mutants, the oleate-induced increase in CTA1 mRNA and activity does not occur, and is restored by ADR1 overexpression (11529680)
rot1 の細胞では Clb2 が正しく分解されず、CLB2 の欠失が rot1: In rot1 cells, Clb2 is not properly degraded, and CLB2 deletion suppresses rot1 lethality (17606994)
rox1 変異で ARE1・ARE2 とも発現の抑制が解ける（11489845）: rox1 mutations derepress expression of both ARE1 and ARE2 (11489845)
rox1 欠失株で ANB1 が恒常的に発現。ROX1 は抑制因子か抑制の補助因: ANB1 is constitutively expressed in rox1 deletion strains. ROX1 encodes a repressor or a repression cofactor (3062365)
rox1 欠失株で CYC7 の発現が上がり、ROX1 は CYC7 を低く抑え: CYC7 expression rises in rox1 deletion strains; ROX1 is required to keep CYC7 low (3062365)
rpS0・rpS2・rpS21 の S0 クラスターの形成が SSU 前駆体への: Formation of the S0 cluster of rpS0, rpS2 and rpS21 enables the initial recruitment of Nob1 to SSU precursors (36996028)
rpa12 欠失で Msn4p が AYR1 のプロモーターに結合し転写を活性化: rpa12 deletion causes Msn4p to bind the AYR1 promoter and activate transcription, leading to triacylglycerol accumulation (27637775)
rpb5-P151T で Spt5 の呼び込みが減り、後戻りが増える。Rpb5: rpb5-P151T reduces Spt5 recruitment and increases backtracking. Rpb5 supports the transition from initiation to elongation through Spt5 binding (29133017)
rpl33a-G76R 変異は uORF4 を素通りさせて GCN4 の翻訳を抑: The rpl33a-G76R mutation causes bypass of uORF4, derepressing GCN4 translation. L33 is required for translational repression of GCN4 (17548477)
rpl39 変異が SIS1・PAB1 の機能喪失変異を補う（11279042）: rpl39 mutations compensate for loss-of-function mutations in SIS1 and PAB1 (11279042)
rpn12-1 と rpt1-2 の二重変異は致死で、Rpn12 と Rpt1: The rpn12-1 rpt1-2 double mutant is lethal, suggesting a strong interaction between Rpn12 and Rpt1 (10503546)
rps10AΔ・rps10BΔ では十分な栄養下と飢餓直後に eIF2α リン酸: In rps10AΔ and rps10BΔ, eIF2α phosphorylation is reduced under nutrient-replete conditions and right after starvation, and Gcn1-mediated Gcn2 activation is impaired (25437641)
rrf1 欠損では COX1 の翻訳活性化因子 Mss51 が低分子量型にたまり: In rrf1 loss, the COX1 translational activator Mss51 accumulates in a low-molecular-weight form and Cox1 synthesis increases (27257059)
rrp47 欠失で Rrp6 の量が転写産物とタンパク質の安定性の両面で下がる。: rrp47 deletion lowers Rrp6 levels at both the transcript and protein stability levels. The main role of Rrp47 is to maintain Rrp6 levels (24224060)
rsc14Δ 細胞では Rsc3・Rsc30 の RSC への組み込みが不十分。: In rsc14Δ cells, incorporation of Rsc3 and Rsc30 into RSC is insufficient. Rsc7 and Rsc14 form a module with Rsc3, Rsc30 and Htl1 (16204215)
rse1-1 の分泌欠陥は SAR1 pre-mRNA のスプライシング不全によ: The secretion defect of rse1-1 is due to defective splicing of SAR1 pre-mRNA. It is suppressed by increasing SAR1 or removing the intron (9819400)
rsm28 欠失で COX1・COX2・COX3 座の ARG8m レポーターの: rsm28 deletion reduces translation of ARG8m reporters at the COX1, COX2 and COX3 loci. Rsm28 has a positive role in mitochondrial mRNA translation (15701796)
rsp5 の spa1-1 変異（F748V）で Pho87 と Pho91 の: The rsp5 spa1-1 mutation (F748V) greatly increases Pho87 and Pho91 levels, and both are ubiquitinated in vivo in an Rsp5-dependent manner. Concludes that degradation of the low-affinity transporters begins with Rsp5 ubiquitination and proceeds via endocytosis (18165238)
rsp5 の温度感受性変異では制限温度で Ste2 のユビキチン化も取り込みも起: In temperature-sensitive rsp5 mutants, neither ubiquitination nor internalization of Ste2 occurs at the restrictive temperature (11179425). Ste2 is reduced by constitutive and ligand-dependent internalization, which requires phosphorylation by Yck1/2 and ubiquitination by Rsp5. Ldb19 and Rod1 recruit Rsp5 to Ste2 (24820415)
rsp5 変異（欠失を含む）では、基質がないときの Sit1 の MVB への振: In rsp5 mutants (including deletion), sorting of Sit1 to the MVB in the absence of substrate is impaired, and it is delivered to the plasma membrane (18489705)
rsp5-1 で Ubp2 や Rup1 を過剰発現すると強い増殖欠損。Rsp5: Overexpressing Ubp2 or Rup1 in rsp5-1 causes a strong growth defect. Rsp5 and the Ubp2/Rup1 complex antagonize each other (15933713)
rtr1 欠失で S5P 型の RNAPII がたまり、Rtr1 は S5P か: rtr1 deletion causes accumulation of S5P RNAPII; Rtr1 is a CTD phosphatase essential for the S5P-to-S2P transition (19394294)
sbe2 sbe22 の二重変異で、小さい芽の細胞で Chs3 が誤局在する（1: In sbe2 sbe22 double mutants, Chs3 is mislocalized in small-budded cells (10679005)
sbe2 sbe22 二重変異の小さい芽の細胞で Chs3p が誤局在する（10: Chs3p is mislocalized in small-budded cells of sbe2 sbe22 double mutants (10679005)
sch9Δ では NCE103 の発現が乱れ、Sch9 は Cst6 と結合し試: NCE103 expression is dysregulated in sch9Δ; Sch9 binds Cst6 and phosphorylates it in vitro. Cst6 S266 is phosphorylated at 5% CO2, and S266A, like sch9Δ, raises NCE103 at high CO2. CO2 activation of Sch9 is via Pkh1/2 lipid signaling (28143980)
sec28Δ を 37 度に移すと Ret1（alpha-COP）の量が速く減る: Shifting sec28Δ to 37 °C rapidly reduces Ret1 (alpha-COP) levels. Sec28 overexpression suppresses the ret1-3 defect by stabilizing alpha-COP (9463377)
sec28Δ を 37℃ に移すと α-COP（Ret1）の量が急に減る。Sec: Shifting sec28Δ to 37°C sharply reduces α-COP (Ret1) levels. Sec28 overexpression stabilizes α-COP and suppresses ret1-3 (9463377)
sec66 欠失株で Pom152 のタンパク質量が減る（Pom34・Ndc1: sec66 deletion strains have reduced Pom152 protein levels (Pom34 and Ndc1 are not reduced). Control of Pom152 levels by Sec66 is involved in SPB duplication (26510791)
see1 欠失で eEF1A のメチル 2 個分が失われ、野生型抽出液は低メチル: see1 deletion causes loss of two methyl groups on eEF1A, and wild-type extracts methylate hypomethylated eEF1A in vitro (20510667)
see1（EFM4）欠失で eEF1A のメチル基 2 個分が失われ、野生型の抽: see1 (EFM4) deletion causes loss of two methyl groups on eEF1A; wild-type extracts methylate hypomethylated eEF1A in vitro, but see1 mutant extracts do not (20510667)
sen2 変異は SEN54 の過剰発現で抑圧され、tRNA 依存・非依存の働き: sen2 mutations are suppressed by SEN54 overexpression, seen for both tRNA-dependent and -independent functions (36943791)
sgf29Δ で GAL1 などの SAGA 制御のプロモーターへの TBP の: sgf29Δ weakens TBP recruitment to SAGA-regulated promoters such as GAL1 and lowers transcription (22224423)
shp1Δ は Glc7 の活性低下で分裂中期から後期への移行が遅れ、Cdc48: shp1Δ delays the metaphase-to-anaphase transition through reduced Glc7 activity; Cdc48(Shp1) regulates mitotic Glc7 activity (23418575). shp1 mutations cause Glc7 to misfold and aggregate (25616896)
shr3Δ ではアミノ酸パーミアーゼが小胞体に溜まり細胞膜へ運ばれない。Shr3: In shr3Δ, amino acid permeases accumulate in the ER and are not delivered to the plasma membrane. Shr3 is required for packaging of Gap1 into COPII vesicles (8909535). Shr3 transiently binds Gap1 and recruits COPII components (10564255)
sit4 欠損では長鎖塩基とスフィンゴ脂質が水酸化されていない形に偏り、Sit4: In sit4 loss, long-chain bases and sphingolipids shift toward non-hydroxylated forms, suggesting that Sit4 regulates the hydroxylase Sur2 or ceramide synthase (24082981)
siw14Δ では Msn2-GFP の核局在が増え、msn2・msn4 の欠失: siw14Δ increases nuclear localization of Msn2-GFP, and msn2 and msn4 deletions are epistatic to siw14Δ (31848224)
skp2 変異株ではシステイン合成のタンパク質 Str2p・Str3p・Str4: In skp2 mutants, the cysteine synthesis proteins Str2p, Str3p and Str4p are more stable than in wild type (20936605)
sli1 欠失では YPK1 の導入による ISP-1 耐性の上昇がほぼ消え、S: In sli1 deletion, the increase in ISP-1 resistance from introducing YPK1 nearly disappears; Sli1p cooperates with Ypk1p to confer resistance (15025559)
slp1 欠失は mps3 の SUN ドメイン変異の増殖を悪くする。Slp1: slp1 deletion worsens growth of mps3 SUN domain mutants. Slp1 is involved in localization of Mps3 to the nuclear envelope (NE) (23275891)
slt2Δ では Bni4 の局在が乱れ、Kss1 の過剰発現がそれを転写の応答: In slt2Δ, Bni4 localization is disrupted, and Kss1 overexpression restores it independently of the transcriptional response. Bni4 physically binds both Slt2 and Kss1, and its phosphorylation decreases in slt2Δ. MAP kinase sites are required for Bni4 function (27400980). Direct phosphorylation is at the "model" stage, so direct is left blank
smp3 は gpi13 変異で溜まる Man4-GPI の形成を妨げ、4 つ目: smp3 prevents formation of Man4-GPI that accumulates in gpi13 mutants, suggesting that the fourth mannose is important for EthN-P addition (11356840)
snf1 を欠く細胞はグリコーゲンをためられず、Gsy2 は過リン酸化された不活: Cells lacking snf1 cannot accumulate glycogen, and Gsy2 remains in a hyperphosphorylated, inactive state. Glycogen synthase kinase activity increases in snf1 (8754836). On entry into stationary phase, Gsy2 is locked in the inactive phosphorylated form in snf1 strains, and Gsy2 lacking the C-terminus restores glycogen accumulation (7961723)
snf1Δ で ADY2 プロモーターの H3 アセチル化の上昇と Gcn5 の: snf1Δ abolishes the increase in H3 acetylation and the recruitment of Gcn5 at the ADY2 promoter (22306658)
snf1Δ は胞子形成培地で IME1 の転写物をまったく誘導しない（96714: snf1Δ does not induce IME1 transcripts at all in sporulation medium (9671464). IME1 is highly expressed under nutrient conditions that activate Snf1 (12081645)
snf7Δ で TIR1 の嫌気誘導が消え、恒常活性型 Rim101 の発現で戻: snf7Δ abolishes anaerobic induction of TIR1, which is restored by expression of constitutively active Rim101 (20402793)
sod2 欠失はプリマキンの増殖阻害を強め、AIM32・MCR1 の過剰発現がそ: sod2 deletion enhances growth inhibition by primaquine, and overexpression of AIM32 and MCR1 counteracts it (26629948)
sok1 破壊で yak1 による PKA 欠損の抑圧が消える。Sok1 は負の: sok1 disruption abolishes suppression of PKA deficiency by yak1. Sok1 is activated by inactivation of the negative regulator Yak1 (8065298)
sop4Δ で野生型 Pma1 の小胞体からの搬出が遅れる（12230471）: sop4Δ delays ER export of wild-type Pma1 (12230471)
spe2 欠失のスペルミジン欠乏株では SPE1 が脱抑制され、プトレシンが大き: In spermidine-deficient spe2 deletion strains, SPE1 is derepressed and putrescine increases greatly (7961484)
spe3 変異では NRE(DIT) による DIT1/DIT2 の抑制が不完全: In spe3 mutants, NRE(DIT)-mediated repression of DIT1/DIT2 is incomplete and is partly restored by adding spermidine (9725830)
split-ubiquitin 二ハイブリッドで Gap1 と結合する候補として: Bsc6 was identified as a Gap1-binding candidate by split-ubiquitin two-hybrid, and Bsc6 affects Gap1 transport or degradation (21912684)
split-ubiquitin 法で Gal4・Tup1 の近くに Nhp6B: The split-ubiquitin method found Nhp6B near Gal4 and Tup1, and direct binding was confirmed by coprecipitation (11095729)
spo13Δ では Mam1 と Lrs4 が第一分裂の前中期・中期に動原体から: In spo13Δ, Mam1 and Lrs4 leave kinetochores early in prometaphase and metaphase I, causing a partial defect in sister kinetochore co-orientation (15620644)

In spo13Δ, Mam1 and Lrs4 leave kinetochores early in prometaphase and metaphase I, causing a partial defect in sister kinetochore co-orientation (15620644). Spo13 helps recruit monopolin to kinetochores, preventing bi-orientation of sister kinetochores (15620645)
spo13Δ では第一分裂で動原体周辺のコヒーシンが守られず、染色体全体で失われ: In spo13Δ, pericentromeric cohesin is not protected in meiosis I and is lost along entire chromosomes (15620644). Spo13 overexpression prevents cleavage of Scc1 or Rec8 by Esp1 (12101125)
spp41 株で PRP3-lacZ・PRP4-lacZ の発現が上がり、Spp: In spp41 strains, PRP3-lacZ and PRP4-lacZ expression rises; Spp41 is thought to repress PRP3 and PRP4 expression (8005438)
spt8Δ・spt3Δ で Gcn4 標的遺伝子の TBP 結合が減る。SAGA: spt8Δ and spt3Δ reduce TBP binding at Gcn4 target genes. SAGA recruits TBP through Spt3/Spt8 (40637224)
src1 欠失で PHO11・PHO12・PHO84 の発現が上がる（18762: src1 deletion raises expression of PHO11, PHO12 and PHO84 (18762579)
srd1 は rrp1-1 の温度感受性の pre-rRNA 加工欠損を抑える。: srd1 suppresses the temperature-sensitive pre-rRNA processing defect of rrp1-1. Proposed that Srd1 interacts with or regulates Rrp1 (2179050). SRD1 does not affect RRP1 mRNA levels (8165142)
sro7Δ sro77Δ で GTP 型の活性 Rho1 が減り、TOR1 が上: sro7Δ sro77Δ reduces active GTP-bound Rho1 and raises TOR1 (25061043)
sro7Δ sro77Δ で活性 Rho1 が減り TOR1 が上がる。tor1: sro7Δ sro77Δ reduces active Rho1 and raises TOR1. tor1Δ rescues the phenotype (25061043)
srs2Δ は DSB を修復しても回復できず Rad53 のキナーゼ活性が残る: srs2Δ cannot recover even after repairing a DSB, and Rad53 kinase activity persists. It also cannot adapt, which is suppressed by mec1Δ. Srs2 is required to turn off the checkpoint (12191482)
ssl2 変異が sua7-1 の生育の欠陥を抑圧し、開始点の選択と遺伝子ループ: ssl2 mutations suppress the growth defect of sua7-1 and partly restore start site selection and gene looping. Functional interaction between TFIIB and Ssl2 (22081613)
stb5Δ はアセトアルデヒドのストレスで GND1・TKL1・TAL1 などペ: stb5Δ cannot induce pentose phosphate pathway genes such as GND1, TKL1 and TAL1 under acetaldehyde stress (20806246)
stt4(ts) と合成致死になる遺伝子の探索から、Slm1 と Slm2 は正: A search for genes synthetically lethal with stt4(ts) showed that Slm1 and Slm2 are required for normal sphingolipid metabolism, and identified the inositol phosphosphingolipid phospholipase C Isc1 as a target negatively regulated by Slm1/2 (16847337)
sug1・sug2 の温度感受性株で熱ショック・メナジオンによる GAD1 の発: In temperature-sensitive sug1 and sug2 strains, GAD1 expression induced by heat shock and menadione is strongly reduced. Sug1 and Sug2 are recruited to promoters such as GAD1 (16517940)
sut1 sut2 二重欠失で NCE102・PRR2 の発現が上がり、SUT1: sut1 sut2 double deletion raises NCE102 and PRR2 expression, and overexpression of SUT1 or SUT2 lowers it (23872066)
sut1 sut2 double deletion raises NCE102 and PRR2 expression, and overexpression of SUT1 and SUT2 lowers it (23872066)
svp26 欠失で Ktr3 は小胞体に残る。Svp26 は Ktr3 と結合し: In svp26 deletion, Ktr3 remains in the ER. Svp26 binds Ktr3 and strongly promotes its incorporation into COPII vesicles (20236934)
svp26 欠失で Mnn2 と Mnn5 が小胞体に留まる。Mnn2 は Sv: In svp26 deletion, Mnn2 and Mnn5 remain in the ER. Mnn2 binds Svp26, and its incorporation into COPII vesicles is greatly promoted by Svp26 (20236934)
swi4 変異で CLN1・CLN2・HCS26 の転写産物が 3〜20 分の: swi4 mutations reduce CLN1, CLN2 and HCS26 transcripts 3- to 20-fold. Positive feedback promoting G1 transcription (1832336)
swi4 変異で HCS26（PCL1）の転写産物が減り、CCBF が HCS2: swi4 mutations reduce HCS26 (PCL1) transcripts, and CCBF binds upstream of HCS26 (1832336). Activation of the Slt2 pathway recruits SBF to the PCL1 and PCL2 promoters (11533240)
tRNA スプライシングエンドヌクレアーゼは Sen54・Sen2・Sen34・: The tRNA splicing endonuclease is a tetramer of Sen54, Sen2, Sen34 and Sen15 (16710424)
tRNA リガーゼの変異で HAC1 mRNA のスプライシングが止まり（tRN: tRNA ligase mutations block splicing of HAC1 mRNA (but not tRNA), and the UPR does not occur (8898194). Under ER stress, Ire1 excises the HAC1 mRNA intron and Trl1 ligates the exons. Incompletely processed HAC1 mRNA is degraded by Xrn1 and others (31237564)
tRNA 特異的アデノシン脱アミノ酵素は Tad2 と Tad3 のヘテロ二量体: The tRNA-specific adenosine deaminase is a heterodimer of Tad2 and Tad3 (10550050)
taf19 と not4・not5 の合成表現型。2 ハイブリッドと試験管内で: Synthetic phenotypes of taf19 with not4 and not5. Taf19 (TAF13) and Not5 bind in two-hybrid and in vitro (10864925)
tau60（TFC8）は TBP と直接結合し、その結合を介して TFIIIB: tau60 (TFC8) binds TBP directly and is involved in TFIIIB assembly through this binding (10567530)
tau91-E330K が tfc3-G349E（tau138）の温度感受性と: tau91-E330K suppresses the temperature sensitivity and DNA-binding and transcription defects of tfc3-G349E (tau138). tau91 binds DNA cooperatively with tau138 (9418847)
tcm62 変異で SDH が組み上がらず SDH 活性が失われる。Tcm62: In tcm62 mutants, SDH does not assemble and SDH activity is lost. Tcm62 forms a complex with SDH subunits and was proposed to act as an assembly chaperone (9822678)
tdp1Δ は Top2 標的薬に過敏で、Tdp1 は試験管内で DNA に共有: tdp1Δ is hypersensitive to Top2-targeting drugs, and Tdp1 removes Top2-derived peptides covalently bound to DNA in vitro (16751265)
tel1Δ では DSB への MRX の保持が下がり、Tel1 は MRX の: In tel1Δ, MRX retention at DSBs decreases; Tel1 promotes MRX retention at DSBs and functions in end tethering and repair. This function is counteracted by Rif2 (26901759). Tel1 enhances MRX activity to regulate telomere resection (22354991)
tgs1Δ は減数分裂の PCH2・SAE3 pre-mRNA のスプライシング: tgs1Δ is specifically defective in splicing of meiotic PCH2 and SAE3 pre-mRNAs. SAE3 intron removal is also weakened in extracts (21398639)
tgs1Δ is specifically defective in splicing of meiotic PCH2 and SAE3 pre-mRNAs (21398639)
tma23 と nop6 の変異は nep1(ts) と nep1 欠失の劣性サ: tma23 and nop6 mutations are recessive suppressors of nep1(ts) and nep1 deletion (17425675)
tms1 と Vps55/Vps68 複合体の欠失を重ねると MVB の積み荷の: Combining deletions of tms1 and the Vps55/Vps68 complex causes synergistic defects in MVB cargo sorting (39271159)
tor2 の優性阻害型の多コピー抑圧として TCP20/CCT6 がとれ、過剰発: TCP20/CCT6 was obtained as a multicopy suppressor of a dominant-negative tor2; its overexpression restores growth and actin polarity of tor2 mutants (8943012)
tor2 変異株では Rom2 の交換活性が下がり、PH ドメインのない Rom: In tor2 mutants, Rom2 exchange activity decreases, and overexpression of Rom2 lacking the PH domain cannot rescue tor2 mutants. Overexpression of Rom2, Rho1 or Rho2 and loss of sac7 rescue tor2 mutants (9038344)
tpm2Δ で分裂・融合の頻度が下がり、融合因子 Mgm1 が増える（42341: tpm2Δ lowers the frequency of fission and fusion and increases the fusion factor Mgm1 (42341033)
tps2Δ では窒素飢餓での Rim15 の核移行と活性化が損なわれる。Tps2: In tps2Δ, nuclear translocation and activation of Rim15 under nitrogen starvation are impaired. Tps2 is required for dephosphorylation of Rim15 S1061 and T1075, releasing Rim15 from Bmh1/2 (32240040)
trm82 欠失で Trm8 タンパク質（mRNA ではなく）が大きく減る。Tr: trm82 deletion greatly reduces Trm8 protein (not mRNA). Trm82 stabilizes Trm8 in its active form (15811913)
trx1Δ trx2Δ では通常の条件で Yap1 が常に核に集まり標的遺伝子の: In trx1Δ trx2Δ, Yap1 is constitutively concentrated in the nucleus under normal conditions and target gene expression is high (not so in grx1Δ grx2Δ). Yap1 levels are unchanged, and this is seen only under aerobic conditions (10497208). Direct reduction is not shown in the abstract
tup1・cyc8 の変異株では、Sko1 が制御する GRE2 と AHP1: In tup1 and cyc8 mutants, the Sko1-regulated GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed in the absence of stress. Tup1-Cyc8 is recruited to promoters by Sko1 and represses them (18201562)
two-hybrid で CSN のサブユニット Csn9 と Csi1 がプロ: In two-hybrid, the CSN subunits Csn9 and Csi1 bind the proteasome lid subunit Rpn5 (12672462)
two-hybrid で Dsk2 の結合相手として Irc22 を同定。細胞内: Irc22 was identified as a Dsk2 binding partner by two-hybrid. It binds Dsk2 in cells but not Rad23 or Ddi1 (24709957)
two-hybrid で Nop8 と Rrp43 が Nip7 と結合するタン: Nop8 and Rrp43 were obtained as Nip7-binding proteins by two-hybrid, confirmed by copurification (9891085)
two-hybrid で Rrp43 が Nip7 と結合するタンパク質として得: Rrp43 was obtained as a Nip7-binding protein by two-hybrid, and protein A-tagged Rrp43 copurified with Nip7 (9891085)
two-hybrid と GST の試験管内の実験で Mlh1 は Ntg2 と: In two-hybrid and GST in vitro experiments, Mlh1 binds Ntg2. Ntg2 overexpression partly suppresses MMR (12042306)
two-hybrid と生化学で Rad23p と Png1p の結合を確認（1: Binding of Rad23p and Png1p was confirmed by two-hybrid and biochemistry (11259433). The Png1-Rad23 complex is required for efficient degradation of glycosylated ricin A chain (16401726)
uL23 と eL27A の遺伝子が pol5 温度感受性変異の多コピー抑圧因子: The genes for uL23 and eL27A are multicopy suppressors of a pol5 temperature-sensitive mutation (31413149)
uORF を持つ GCN4・YAP1 mRNA の安定化配列は Pub1 と結合: Stabilizer elements in the uORF-containing GCN4 and YAP1 mRNAs bind Pub1 and prevent rapid NMD. Pub1 determines the stability of uORF-containing mRNAs (10892745)
Stabilizer elements in the uORF-containing GCN4 and YAP1 mRNAs bind Pub1 and prevent rapid NMD (10892745)
ubp2Δ ubp15Δ で Art1 が過剰にユビキチン化され、シクロヘキシミ: In ubp2Δ ubp15Δ, Art1 is hyperubiquitinated and degraded faster under cycloheximide (28298493 main text)
ubp2Δ ubp15Δ で Art1 の分解が速まる（28298493 本文）: In ubp2Δ ubp15Δ, Art1 degradation is accelerated (28298493 main text)
ubp3 変異株は浸透圧応答遺伝子の発現に欠陥がある。Hog1 は Ubp3 と: ubp3 mutants are defective in expression of osmoresponsive genes. Hog1 binds Ubp3 and phosphorylates S695, which is essential for determining the extent of transcriptional activation under osmotic stress. Ubp3 is recruited to responsive genes and regulates transcription initiation and elongation (21743437)
ubp3 欠損で Slt2 の活性化が強まり、Pkc1 が蓄積して安定性が大きく: Loss of ubp3 enhances Slt2 activation, and Pkc1 accumulates with greatly increased stability. Pkc1 and Ubp3 bind in vivo. Ubp3 regulates Pkc1 by assisting its degradation (17986446)
ubp3 欠損では Fzo1 の分解は変わらないが、融合に要るポリユビキチン鎖を: In ubp3 loss, Fzo1 degradation is unchanged, but Ubp12, which removes from Fzo1 the polyubiquitin chains required for fusion, is stabilized (29924334)
ubx2Δ では Lro1 の局在が乱れ、TAG が約 50% に減る（2245: In ubx2Δ, Lro1 localization is disrupted and TAG falls to about 50% (22454508)
ubx2Δ では、ユビキチン化された 120 kDa の Spt23 前駆体を切: In ubx2Δ, both processing of the ubiquitinated 120 kDa Spt23 precursor to active p90 and transport of p90 into the nucleus fail, lowering OLE1 expression (23793018)
ura5 以外の UMP 合成の遺伝子（ura4 を含む）は PPR1 の産物と: UMP synthesis genes other than ura5 (including ura4) are transcriptionally induced by the PPR1 product and the inducer dihydroorotic acid (2679804). The URA4 promoter contains a conserved UASURA bound by PPR1 (2204810)
ure2 変異でアンモニウム培地では 5 倍、プロリン培地では 10 倍、アスパ: ure2 mutations increase asparaginase II 5-fold on ammonium medium and 10-fold on proline medium (12489124)
vhr1 欠失株は低ビオチンで VHT1 を誘導できない。Vhr1 の N 末端: vhr1 deletion strains cannot induce VHT1 at low biotin. The Vhr1 N-terminus binds DNA in a biotin-dependent manner (16533810)
vid22 欠失では PSD2 プロモーター活性が野生型の約 5% に下がり、V: In vid22 deletion, PSD2 promoter activity falls to about 5% of wild type; VID22 is required for transcriptional activation of PSD2 (26443863)
vir1Δ/Δ で IME1 の mRNA とその制御下の転写産物が減る。IME: vir1Δ/Δ reduces IME1 mRNA and transcripts under its control. IME1 overexpression suppresses the premeiotic S-phase defect (36930734)
vma 変異株で Pma1 がユビキチン化され、Rsp5 と Rim8 に依存す: In vma mutants, Pma1 is ubiquitinated, dependent on Rsp5 and Rim8. In rsp5 and rim8 mutants, Pma1 stays at the plasma membrane (25271159)
vma16Δ では Vps41 が液胞の点に溜まり、これはリン酸化の異常ではなく: In vma16Δ, Vps41 accumulates in vacuolar puncta, due not to abnormal phosphorylation but to reduced release from the vacuole (18405665)
vps45 欠失で Tlg2 と Snc2 の量が減り、Vps45 を増やすと両: vps45 deletion reduces Tlg2 and Snc2 levels, and increasing Vps45 raises both (23166732)
vps45 欠失で Tlg2・Snc2 の量が減り、Vps45 を増やすと両方が: vps45 deletion reduces Tlg2 and Snc2 levels, and increasing Vps45 raises both. Vps45 is required for formation of endosomal SNARE complexes (23166732)
ybr062cΔ で URE2 mRNA は変わらず Ure2 タンパク質が減り: In ybr062cΔ, URE2 mRNA is unchanged but Ure2 protein decreases (especially with cadmium), and IRES-dependent translation of URE2 falls by about 80% (41801246)
yck1Δyck2ts で Rgt2 と Snf3 の量が大きく減り、Snf3: yck1Δyck2ts greatly reduces Rgt2 and Snf3 levels and abolishes Yck-dependent phosphorylation of Snf3 (38374219)
ydj1Δ では Tpk2 と同様に Cdc28 の成熟も遅れる（1844303: In ydj1Δ, Cdc28 maturation is also delayed, as for Tpk2 (18443039)
ydj1Δ では Tpk2 の一部が合成直後に分解され、残りの成熟も遅れる。Yd: In ydj1Δ, part of Tpk2 is degraded right after synthesis and maturation of the rest is delayed. Ydj1 protects nascent kinases and determines the rate of maturation (18443039)
ygr150c（ccm1）欠失では COB と COX1 の pre-mRNA: In ygr150c (ccm1) deletion, only the fourth intron of COB and COX1 pre-mRNAs is not removed (19562342)
yhm1(ggc1) 欠失で表面の鉄還元・高親和性鉄輸送・シデロフォア取り込みが: yhm1 (ggc1) deletion increases surface iron reduction, high-affinity iron transport and siderophore uptake, and the effect depends on AFT1 (14629196)
yme1 欠失で Psd1 が安定化し、Yme1 が Psd1 の分解の大きな部: yme1 deletion stabilizes Psd1; Yme1 accounts for a large part of Psd1 degradation (17976194)
ynl024cΔ で eEF1A の Lys390 のメチル化が消え、過剰発現で: ynl024cΔ abolishes methylation of eEF1A Lys390, and overexpression increases trimethylation. Ynl024c (Efm6) is the enzyme methylating Lys390 (26115316)
zap1Δ で ETR1 の発現が低下。Zap1 は ETR1 の発現を正に制御: zap1Δ lowers ETR1 expression. Zap1 positively regulates ETR1 expression (26711224)
zim17 変異で Ssc1 に依存するマトリックスへの輸入が強く損なわれ、新た: zim17 mutations strongly impair Ssc1-dependent import into the matrix, and binding of newly imported substrates to Ssc1 is greatly reduced (24030826)
Δcwc15 と Δsyf2 に遺伝的相互作用があり、働きが一部重なる（3862: Δcwc15 and Δsyf2 interact genetically, with partly overlapping functions (38627018)
Δhap2・Δhap4 株では呼吸鎖複合体のサブユニットの核遺伝子の発現が野生型: In Δhap2 and Δhap4 strains, expression of nuclear genes for respiratory chain complex subunits is lower than in wild type (the HAP complex activates them). All three of the HAP2, HAP3 and HAP5 trimer are essential for DNA binding (7828851). Individual gene names are not in the abstract

アミノ酸の添加で鉄取り込み遺伝子が下がり細胞内の鉄が減る。この調節には Aft1: Adding amino acids lowers iron uptake genes and reduces intracellular iron. This regulation requires Aft1, Gcn2 and phosphorylatable eIF2α, but not Gcn4. In GCN2c mutants, nuclear localization of Aft1 increases in low-iron medium (29626156)
アミノ酸・H+ 共輸送などで細胞質の H+ が増えると Gtr に依存して TO: When cytosolic H+ increases, e.g., via amino acid/H+ symport, TORC1 is activated in a Gtr-dependent manner. Replacing endogenous Pma1 with a plant H+-ATPase prevents TORC1 activation by H+ influx and increase (29570051)
