ガラクトース存在下で Gal3p が Gal80p に結合し、Gal80p によ: In the presence of galactose, Gal3p binds Gal80p and relieves Gal80p-mediated repression of Gal4p (10523671)
クライオ電顕の構造で、NuA3 のヒストン尾部の結合溝は Sas3（触媒）と N: In the cryo-EM structure, the histone tail-binding groove of NuA3 is formed jointly by Sas3 (catalytic) and Nto1 (non-catalytic) (41318527)
クライオ電顕構造で Fyv6 は第 2 段階因子で唯一 Prp22 ATPase: In the cryo-EM structure, Fyv6 is the only second-step factor contacting the Prp22 ATPase, and it binds mutually exclusively with Yju2 (39688371)
クライオ電顕構造で Rtt103 の P261・Y263 が Rai1 と接し、: In the cryo-EM structure, Rtt103 P261 and Y263 contact Rai1, and their mutation abolishes binding to Rat1-Rai1 (40188244)
グリシンがないときの GCV2 プロモーターの抑制には SHM2 だけが必要（1: Only SHM2 is required for repression of the GCV2 promoter in the absence of glycine (15948949)
グリシンによる GCV1・GCV2・GCV3 の誘導は、細胞質のセリンヒドロキシ: Glycine induction of GCV1, GCV2 and GCV3 is mediated by a decrease in 5,10-methylene THF through inhibition of cytosolic serine hydroxymethyltransferase (Shm2) (14645232)
グリシンによる SHM2 プロモーターの制御に Bas1 は要るが Bas2・G: Glycine control of the SHM2 promoter requires Bas1 but not Bas2 or Gcn4 (15948949)
グリセロールを炭素源とすると、PKA サブユニットのプロモーターはすべて Snf: With glycerol as carbon source, all PKA subunit promoters are upregulated via the Snf1/Cat8 pathway (28812308)
グリセロール培地で rsf1（YMR030W）欠失株は GUT1・GUT2 の転: On glycerol medium, rsf1 (YMR030W) deletion strains show greatly reduced GUT1 and GUT2 transcripts (12734673)
グリセロール培地では sch9Δ でだけ H3pT11 の増加が大きく損なわれ（: On glycerol medium, the increase in H3pT11 is greatly impaired only in sch9Δ (not in ras2Δ or tor1Δ), and purified Sch9 directly phosphorylates H3T11 in vitro. Sch9 and CK2 cooperatively control H3pT11, and mutants lacking H3pT11 have extended chronological lifespan (29938647)
グルコース→オレイン酸の切り替えで、Tog1 は POX1・FOX2・POT1・: Upon the glucose → oleate switch, Tog1 is a direct activator of POX1, FOX2, POT1, IDP2, MLS1, ICL1, PCK1 and FBP1 (24998441)
グルコースがあると Tpk2 が Jhd2 の S321・S340 をリン酸化し: In the presence of glucose, Tpk2 phosphorylates Jhd2 S321 and S340, antagonizing H3K4 demethylation by Jhd2. This phosphorylation reduces nuclear localization and chromatin binding of Jhd2 and promotes its polyubiquitination and degradation (36167807)
グルコースがあるとき SCF(Ucc1) が Cit2 をプロテアソーム分解の標: In the presence of glucose, SCF(Ucc1) targets Cit2 for proteasomal degradation, suppressing the glyoxylate cycle (description of earlier work) (31253511). Abstract of the original paper 25982115: SCF(Ucc1) mediates degradation of citrate synthase and ubiquitinates it in vitro
グルコースがないとき HXT2・HXT4 の転写は Rgt1p に妨げられ、Rg: In the absence of glucose, HXT2 and HXT4 transcription is blocked by Rgt1p, which binds the promoters of both genes and acts directly (8816466)
グルコースがなく鉄が欠乏したとき Snf1 は抑えられ、その抑制は Snf1 の: When glucose is absent and iron is deficient, Snf1 is inhibited through interaction of the Snf1 polyhistidine with Aft1. Only nuclear Snf1 is inhibited, at the nuclear envelope (36674878)
グルコースが戻ると糖新生の酵素が分解される。GID の Gid4 サブユニットが: When glucose returns, gluconeogenic enzymes are degraded. The Gid4 subunit of GID targets Fbp1, Icl1 and Mdh2 for degradation, recognizing the N-terminal Pro and the following ~5 residues (28126757)
グルコースが戻ると糖新生の酵素を壊す。GID リガーゼの Gid4 が Fbp1: When glucose returns, gluconeogenic enzymes are destroyed. Gid4 of the GID ligase recognizes the N-terminal Pro of Fbp1, Icl1 and Mdh2 and directs them to degradation, and Pck1 is targeted via its second-position Pro (28126757). Main text: Pck1 degradation is mediated by the GID ligase, and Pck1 is stabilized in both gid2Δ (rmd5Δ) and gid4Δ
グルコースが枯渇すると Rim15 は Hsf1 の標的遺伝子の発現を、転写の活: When glucose is depleted, Rim15 enhances expression of Hsf1 target genes through both transcriptional activation and mRNA stabilization. Rim15 phosphorylates Hsf1 in vitro and may activate it directly (24140345). Activation by direct phosphorylation is inferred from in vitro results
グルコースが減ると Snf1 依存で Adr1 の Ser230 が脱リン酸化さ: When glucose decreases, Adr1 Ser230 is dephosphorylated in a Snf1-dependent manner and Adr1 becomes active. This is not direct phosphorylation by Snf1
グルコースが限られると Pop2 の T97 がリン酸化され、これを担うキナーゼ: Under glucose limitation, Pop2 T97 is phosphorylated, and Yak1 was purified and identified as the responsible kinase. Phosphorylation is nearly undetectable in yak1Δ. T97A cells overgrow after the diauxic shift and cannot arrest in G1 upon glucose deprivation (11358866)
グルコースで Mms21 により SUMO 化された Snf1 は、Slx5-S: With glucose, Snf1 SUMOylated by Mms21 is directed to degradation by Slx5-Slx8, inhibiting its function (24108357)
グルコースで Mth1 は Grr1 に依存してすばやく消え、std1 mth1: With glucose, Mth1 disappears rapidly in a Grr1-dependent manner, and lacking std1 mth1 removes the need for Grr1 (12925759). Mth1 is ubiquitinated in vivo and degraded by the proteasome, and phosphorylated Mth1 binds the Grr1 LRR (15456873)
グルコースでは ADR1 の欠失で VMR1 プロモーターの活性が上がる（208: On glucose, ADR1 deletion increases VMR1 promoter activity (20846144)
グルコースで活性化した PKA は Tom22 前駆体の Thr76 をリン酸化: Glucose-activated PKA phosphorylates Thr76 of the Tom22 precursor, preventing its import into mitochondria, acting opposite to CK1 and CK2 (PMID 24093680). 21215441 shows promotion of Tom22 by CK2
グルコースで育てた細胞のヒスチジン飢餓で、Snf1 を欠くか活性化ループを変異さ: Under histidine starvation of glucose-grown cells, lacking Snf1 or mutating its activation loop lowers Gcn2 activity (T882 autophosphorylation) and eIF2α-P. In reg1Δ, T882 and eIF2α are hyperphosphorylated in a Snf1-dependent manner (20404097). Whether this is direct is not stated
グルコースによる cAMP 合成の上昇は Gα の Gpa2 に依存する（直接の: The glucose-induced rise in cAMP synthesis depends on the Gα Gpa2 (direct binding not shown)
グルコースのない培地で Gcn5 に依存して Ume6 がアセチル化され、部分的: In glucose-free medium, Ume6 is acetylated in a Gcn5-dependent manner and partially degraded. Preventing acetylation delays its degradation in meiosis (22438583)
グルコースのもとで Sok2 は IME1 の IREu を抑え、その抑制因子と: In glucose, Sok2 represses the IME1 IREu, and its function as a repressor depends on PKA phosphorylation of T598 (11238897)
グルコースの多いとき YGP1 の発現は Puf5 が正に制御し、一部は Haa: At high glucose, YGP1 expression is positively controlled by Puf5, partly via Haa1 (42566436)
グルコースは Rgt1 のリン酸化と HXT プロモーターからの解離を起こし、こ: Glucose causes Rgt1 phosphorylation and dissociation from HXT promoters, which depends on Grr1. Rgt1 inactivation does not involve degradation or ubiquitination. Lacking Mth1 and Std1 removes the need for Grr1 (12925759). In grr1 mutants, Rgt1 is not phosphorylated by glucose and always acts as a repressor regardless of carbon source (12527758)
グルコースは SUMO E3 リガーゼ Mms21 による Snf1 触媒サブユ: Glucose induces SUMOylation of the Snf1 catalytic subunit by the SUMO E3 ligase Mms21. It inhibits Snf1 function in two ways: SUMO at K549 binds a SIM near the active site, and it directs degradation by Slx5-Slx8 (24108357). Consistent with the GO direction. interaction_type set to sumoylation
グルコースを付ける段階の変異を wbp1-1 と組み合わせると、最適でない糖鎖が: Combining mutations in the glucosylation steps with wbp1-1 causes accumulation of suboptimal glycans and low OST activity, giving a strong growth defect. ALG8 was isolated by this phenotype (8016100)
グルコースを加えると PP2A と PP1 がすばやく活性化される。PP1 の活: Adding glucose rapidly activates PP2A and PP1. PP1 activation depends entirely on Reg1 and Shp1, and also on the PP2A subunit Rts1. Rts1 binds both Pph21 and Glc7, dependent on Reg1 (22290422)
グルコースを加えると Snf1 の働きが下がって Rod1 が脱リン酸化され 1: Adding glucose lowers Snf1 activity, so Rod1 is dephosphorylated, released from 14-3-3 and ubiquitinated by Rsp5. This is a prerequisite for transporter endocytosis (22249293). Treated as the direction raising Rod1's own activity
グルコースを取り込むと Ids2 は PKA に不活性化され、カロリー制限では: Upon glucose uptake, Ids2 is inactivated by PKA, and under caloric restriction it is activated by PP2C. Phosphorylation prevents Ids2-Hsp90 binding (30516470). Main text: loss of TPK3 greatly reduces Ids2 phosphorylation
グルコースを戻すと Csr2 は活性なユビキチン化型から不活性な脱ユビキチン化・: When glucose is restored, Csr2 changes from an active ubiquitinated form to an inactive deubiquitinated, phosphorylated form, involving PKA. Chemical inhibition of PKA prevents Csr2 deubiquitination (28468835)
グルコースを炭素源とするとき、PKA サブユニットのうち TPK1 のプロモータ: With glucose as carbon source, among the PKA subunits only the TPK1 promoter is repressed by the Hxk2/Mig1 complex (28812308)
グルコースを長く飢餓にした細胞に戻すと糖新生の酵素は Vid 経路で液胞で分解さ: When glucose is returned to cells starved for a long time, gluconeogenic enzymes are degraded in the vacuole via the Vid pathway. Vid28 is required for association of Vid vesicles with actin patches, and its ARM domain is required for FBPase degradation (23393132)
グルコースを除くと Hxt6・Hxt7 は Csr2 に依存してエンドサイトーシ: When glucose is removed, Hxt6 and Hxt7 are endocytosed and degraded in a Csr2-dependent manner. Csr2 binds Hxt6 in vivo and promotes its ubiquitination (28468835)
グルコースを除くと Msn5 が Mig1 を核から運び出す。Mig1 と Ms: When glucose is removed, Msn5 exports Mig1 from the nucleus. Mig1 and Msn5 bind in two-hybrid. Msn5 recognizes the nuclear export signal of Snf1-phosphorylated Mig1 and carries it to the cytoplasm, acting in relief of glucose repression (10556086)
グルコース制限で Rim15 が起こす発現プログラムは Gis1・Msn2・Ms: The expression program triggered by Rim15 under glucose limitation is mediated by Gis1, Msn2 and Msn4
グルコース制限で Snf1 の活性が上がると、野生型では Acc1 の活性が逆に: When Snf1 activity rises under glucose limitation, Acc1 activity conversely falls in wild type but not in snf1 deletion strains (7913470). Acc1 is phosphorylated and inactivated by Snf1 (11486011). Changing Acc1 S659 and S1157 increases activity. Inhibition by Snf1 is strong under glucose limitation (24803522)
グルコース制限で育つ細胞にグルコースを加えると Rds2 がすばやくユビキチン化: Adding glucose to cells grown under glucose limitation causes rapid ubiquitination of Rds2 and its proteasomal degradation. Pib1 is the E3 responsible for this ubiquitination and stability, and Pib1-mediated degradation is specific to the presence of glucose. Pib1 is required for full glucose repression (31604822)
グルコース制限下で Vps27・Snf7・Vps4 を欠くと Erg6-GFP: Under glucose limitation, lacking Vps27, Snf7 or Vps4 promotes delivery of Erg6-GFP to the vacuole and its Atg15-dependent degradation. ESCRT negatively regulates Erg6 degradation (32378292)
グルコース枯渇と窒素飢餓で Ams1 活性が上がり、PKA・TORC1 経路を通: Ams1 activity increases under glucose depletion and nitrogen starvation, controlled by Msn2/4 via the PKA and TORC1 pathways. Due to induced expression (26947009)
グルコース枯渇の細胞にグルコースを加えると PP1 が活性化し、Pig1 と P: Adding glucose to glucose-depleted cells activates PP1, and Pig1 and Pig2 inhibit this activation (22290422)
グルコース枯渇（ジオーキシックシフト）で Msn2・Msn4 が STRE を介: Under glucose depletion (diauxic shift), Msn2 and Msn4 strongly induce YGP1 via STREs (42566436)
グルコース欠乏で CSR2 は Snf1 と下流の転写抑制因子を通して転写が誘導: Under glucose deprivation, CSR2 transcription is induced via Snf1 and downstream transcriptional repressors (28468835)
グルコース欠乏で Csr2 は合成されるとユビキチン化で活性化する。arrest: Under glucose deprivation, newly synthesized Csr2 is activated by ubiquitination. Ubiquitination of conserved lysines in the arrestin-C domain is essential for its function in endocytosis under glucose deprivation, and ubiquitination by Rsp5 does not change its stability (28468835). Csr2 receives K63-linked ubiquitination by Rsp5, which is removed by Ubp2 (17028178)
グルコース欠乏で Snf1 と TORC1 の信号が Ksp1 に集まり、Ksp: Under glucose deprivation, Snf1 and TORC1 signals converge on Ksp1, which phosphorylates eIF4G. Ksp1-dependent eIF4G phosphorylation regulates decay of specific mRNAs (glycolytic, ribosomal protein) through Dhh1 recruitment. Lacking KSP1 greatly reduces Dhh1 binding to glycolytic mRNAs under glucose deprivation (29438499)
グルコース欠乏での DOG2 の脱抑制は snf1 欠失で起こらない（10960: Derepression of DOG2 under glucose deprivation does not occur in snf1 deletion (10960096)
グルコース添加で FBPase が生体内でユビキチン化され、その分解は Ubc1: Glucose addition causes ubiquitination of FBPase in vivo, and its degradation depends on Ubc1, Ubc4 and Ubc5 (7592860)
グルコース飢餓で Atg11 が Snf1 と Atg1 の結合を助け、Snf1: Under glucose starvation, Atg11 assists Snf1-Atg1 binding and is required for Snf1-dependent Atg1 activation
グルコース飢餓で Atg11 は Snf1 と Atg1 の結合を促し、Snf1: Under glucose starvation, Atg11 promotes Snf1-Atg1 binding and is required for Snf1-dependent Atg1 activation (31971848)
グルコース飢餓で Mec1 の点状構造は Atg13 との直接結合で PAS に: Under glucose starvation, Mec1 puncta contact the PAS by direct binding to Atg13. Disrupting the Atg13 MBR or the Mec1 ABR impairs recruitment of Mec1 and Atg13 to the PAS and stops glucose starvation-induced autophagy (36574691)
グルコース飢餓で Mec1・Atg13・Atg1・Snf1 がミトコンドリアに集: Under glucose starvation, Mec1, Atg13, Atg1 and Snf1 gather at mitochondria, and phosphorylation of Mec1 by Snf1 recruits Atg1 to mitochondria. This is required for maintaining respiration and for autophagy under energy shortage (28399401). The effect on Mec1 kinase activity itself is not described, so confidence is medium
グルコース飢餓で NVJ が作り変えられると Nsg1 は不安定になり Hmg1: When the NVJ is remodeled under glucose starvation, Nsg1 becomes unstable and activates Hmg1, while Nsg2 becomes stable and inhibits Hmg1. Lacking both Nsg1 and Nsg2 makes Hmg1 hyperactive, causing squalene accumulation (42227952)
グルコース飢餓で Rho5 は細胞膜からミトコンドリアへ素早く移り、それは二量体: Under glucose starvation, Rho5 rapidly moves from the plasma membrane to mitochondria, mediated by the dimeric GEF Dck1/Lmo1 (30049968)
グルコース飢餓で Snf1 がミトコンドリア表面で Mec1 をリン酸化し、その: Under glucose starvation, Snf1 phosphorylates Mec1 at the mitochondrial surface, resulting in recruitment of Atg1 to mitochondria (28399401)
グルコース飢餓で Snf1 は主に Pib2 を介して TORC1 を不活性に保: Under glucose starvation, Snf1 keeps TORC1 inactive mainly via Pib2 (effects of Pib2 and Sch9 phosphorylation are additive)
グルコース飢餓で Snf1 依存の Kog1 Ser491/494 のリン酸化が: Under glucose starvation, Snf1-dependent phosphorylation of Kog1 Ser491/494 causes TORC1 disassembly and Kog1 body formation, raising the threshold for TORC1 activation
グルコース飢餓で Xrn1 は細胞膜のアイソソームに隔離され、その間 Xrn1: Under glucose starvation, Xrn1 is sequestered at plasma membrane eisosomes, during which Xrn1-mediated mRNA decay stops. In cells lacking Pil1, Xrn1 does not bind the plasma membrane and remains active into stationary phase (28501103). Binding of Xrn1 to the plasma membrane requires at least one of Pil1 or Lsp1 (39416838, main text)
グルコース飢餓で Ypf1 が Nsg1・Nsg2・Hmg1・Hmg2 の NV: Under glucose starvation, Ypf1 promotes recruitment of Nsg1, Nsg2, Hmg1 and Hmg2 to the NVJ (42227952)
グルコース飢餓で Ypf1 が Nsg1・Nsg2・Hmg1・Hmg2 を NV: Under glucose starvation, Ypf1 gathers Nsg1, Nsg2, Hmg1 and Hmg2 at the NVJ. This remodeling destabilizes Nsg1, activating Hmg1, and stabilizes Nsg2, inhibiting Hmg1. Lacking both Nsg1 and Nsg2 makes Hmg1 hyperactive, causing squalene accumulation (42227952)
グルコース飢餓での Hxt3 と、ラパマイシン・窒素制限での Hxt7 の分解は: Degradation of Hxt3 under glucose starvation and of Hxt7 under rapamycin or nitrogen limitation both depend on Rsp5 (23227176)
グルコース飢餓での Pma1 の S911-T912 の脱リン酸化は Glc7: Dephosphorylation of Pma1 S911-T912 under glucose starvation depends on Glc7 PP1. Glc7 promotes dephosphorylation of S899, S911 and T912, putting Pma1 into an autoinhibited state (38227612). S899 and S911/T912 are phosphorylated in vivo upon glucose activation, and Glc7 is involved in S899 dephosphorylation under glucose starvation (26019146)
グルコース飢餓で栄養輸送体の一部が Ygr130c と Pil1 の変化によって: Under glucose starvation, some nutrient transporters are retained in eisosomes through changes in Ygr130c and Pil1. Main text: in ygr130cΔ, Mup1-GFP distribution becomes dispersed (33443082)
グルコース飢餓で液胞のカルシウムが細胞質へ出て Rck2 を活性化する。Rck2: Under glucose starvation, vacuolar calcium is released into the cytoplasm and activates Rck2. Phosphorylation of Atg11 by Rck2 strengthens its binding to Bmh1/2 bound to Snf1-Sip1-Snf4, recruiting Snf1 to the PAS to activate Atg1 and initiate autophagy (38980288)
グルコース飢餓と Ca2+ による GPX1 の誘導は Msn2・Msn4 と: GPX1 induction by glucose starvation and Ca2+ depends on Msn2, Msn4 and the STRE in the GPX1 promoter (20002498)
グルコース飢餓は Hxt1 のエンドサイトーシスと分解を起こし、rsp5-1 変: Glucose starvation causes Hxt1 endocytosis and degradation, and Hxt1 levels are constantly high in rsp5-1 mutants (24821015)
グルタチオン枯渇で Yvc1 が Cys17・79・191 のグルタチオン化によ: Upon glutathione depletion, Yvc1 is activated by glutathionylation of Cys17, 79 and 191. Gtt1 acts in glutathionylation (27708136)
グルタミンでの BAT2 の抑制は ure2Δ で、または Gcn4 依存の転写: Repression of BAT2 on glutamine is relieved in ure2Δ or by Gcn4-dependent transcriptional activation. Using VIL as the sole nitrogen source activates BAT2 (28912343)
グルタミンでの BAT2 の抑制は ure2Δ 変異で解除される（2891234: Repression of BAT2 on glutamine is relieved by the ure2Δ mutation (28912343)
グルタミンで育ててラパマイシンを加えた細胞で、Gln3・Gat1 の DAL5: In glutamine-grown cells treated with rapamycin, binding of Gln3 and Gat1 to the DAL5 promoter and DAL5 expression require Pph21/22-Tpd3-Cdc55/Rts1. This does not occur in pph21Δ pph22Δ (20974806)
グルタミンを足すと Mep2 は不活性化し、細胞膜の重複したホスファターゼ Ps: When glutamine is added, Mep2 is inactivated and S457 is rapidly dephosphorylated by the redundant plasma membrane phosphatases Psr1 and Psr2 (24476960)
ゲルシフトで Yrr1 が YPL088W のプロモーターに結合（1190995: In gel shift assays, Yrr1 binds the YPL088W promoter (11909958)
コフィリンはアクチン繊維を切断する。Srv2 の N 末端が切断を直接促進（23: Cofilin severs actin filaments. The N-terminus of Srv2 directly promotes severing (23135996)
コリンに長くさらすと Hnm1 がエンドサイトーシスで分解され、これはユビキチン: Prolonged exposure to choline causes Hnm1 degradation via endocytosis, dependent on the ubiquitin ligase Rsp5 and the casein kinase 1 isoforms Yck1/Yck2 (24187140)
コリンキナーゼ Cki1 は PKA によりリン酸化されて活性化される。S30A: The choline kinase Cki1 is phosphorylated and activated by PKA. S30A, S85A and the double mutant reduce in vivo specific activity by 44, 8 and 60%, and also reduce incorporation into phosphocholine and phosphatidylcholine (12105205)
コンデンシンは後期に限ってリン酸化され、Cdc5 が 3 つの調節サブユニットを: Condensin is phosphorylated specifically in anaphase; Cdc5 directly phosphorylates the three regulatory subunits in vivo, enhancing DNA supercoiling activity (19481522)
ゴルジから ER への逆行輸送に要る Dsl1 繋留複合体は Dsl1・Dsl3: The Dsl1 tethering complex required for Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport consists of Dsl1, Dsl3 and Tip20 (21550981)
ゴルジ体の Mn2+ 輸送体 Pmr1 を欠くと細胞質の Mn が増え、TORC: Lacking the Golgi Mn2+ transporter Pmr1 increases cytosolic Mn and raises TORC1 activity. Rapamycin-induced autophagy, mitophagy and RTG signaling are counteracted (35904415)
サイクリン C-Cdk8 は AQY1 の転写を抑える。転写因子の分解を促し S: Cyclin C-Cdk8 represses AQY1 transcription. Model in which it promotes transcription factor degradation and prevents Set1 recruitment (28143948)
サイクリン C-Cdk8 はストレス応答の遺伝子の一部を抑える。H2O2 にさら: Cyclin C-Cdk8 represses a subset of stress response genes. Upon H2O2 exposure, cyclin C is degraded by the 26S proteasome; this degradation requires Not4 in vivo, and Not4 attaches Lys48 polyubiquitin chains to cyclin C in vitro. Before degradation, cyclin C moves from the nucleus to the cytoplasm (22421358)
サイクリン C-Cdk8（Ssn3）は Rim15 を直接リン酸化し、ストレスの: Cyclin C-Cdk8 (Ssn3) directly phosphorylates Rim15, preventing Rim15 activation in the absence of stress. Phosphomimetic mutations at the Cdk8 sites lower Rim15 activity. When cyclin C is degraded under stress, Rim15 becomes active (35433688). Phosphorylation of the PAS domain is in vitro, so confidence is medium
サイクリン Clg1・Pcl1・Pho80 は Pho85 と組んで Sic1: The cyclins Clg1, Pcl1 and Pho80 partner with Pho85 to promote Sic1 degradation and positively regulate autophagy (20417603)
サイレントな HMLalpha1/alpha2 プロモーターにも Pol II: Pol II is recruited even to the silent HMLalpha1/alpha2 promoters, but binding of capping and elongation factors is nearly abolished. Sir2 targets the transition from initiation to elongation (18391020)
ザイモリエースによる細胞壁ストレスで、CRH1 などの転写の活性化は Slt2: Under cell wall stress by zymolyase, transcriptional activation of CRH1 and others depends on Slt2-regulated Rlm1, not on transcription factors downstream of Hog1 (18184748)
シクロヘキシミドでユビキチン化された Agp2 が消えるが、brp1 欠失では: Cycloheximide causes ubiquitinated Agp2 to disappear, but Agp2-GFP does not decrease in brp1 deletion (37108141)
シクロヘキシミドは Rsp5 に依存した Can1 のユビキチン化とエンドサイト: Cycloheximide promotes Rsp5-dependent ubiquitination and endocytosis of Can1 in a Bul1/2-dependent manner (34638549)
Cycloheximide promotes Rsp5-dependent ubiquitination and endocytosis of Can1, which depends on Bul1/2 (34638549)
シクロヘキシミド追跡で、Ecm7 は Mid1 により、Mid1 は Cch1: Cycloheximide chase shows that Ecm7 is stabilized by Mid1, and Mid1 by Cch1 (21252230)
システインを入れた Bet1 と Sec22 が架橋されたヘテロ二量体を作り、試: Cysteine-introduced Bet1 and Sec22 form cross-linked heterodimers, which also form in in vitro transport reactions (16303754)
シトクロム b 遺伝子の末端イントロン bI2 の生体内での除去には核遺伝子 C: In vivo removal of the terminal intron bI2 of the cytochrome b gene requires the protein of the nuclear gene CBP2. Cbp2 also promotes splicing in vitro (2685564)
シトクロム c はミトコンドリアに取り込まれ、CYC3 がコードするヘムリアーゼ: Cytochrome c is imported into mitochondria and receives heme from the heme lyase encoded by CYC3. In cyc3 mutants, apo-iso-1 (Cyc1) is not seen and is degraded by the ubiquitin-proteasome system (9395529). cyc3 mitochondria cannot import apocytochrome c (2846529)
シャペロン Hsp82 は Lys14 による LYS 遺伝子の十分な活性化に必: The chaperone Hsp82 is required for full activation of LYS genes by Lys14 (11952910)
ジオーキシックシフトでのグルコース制限のあと Rim15 が活性化する発現のプロ: The expression program activated by Rim15 after glucose limitation at the diauxic shift is mediated by Gis1, Msn2 and Msn4 and includes oxidative stress genes such as SOD1 and SOD2 (15300954)
ジオーキシックシフト後とグルコース枯渇で、Mtl1 は TOR1 の働きを抑え、: After the diauxic shift and upon glucose depletion, Mtl1 inhibits TOR1 function and inhibits PKA through Sch9 inactivation and Bcy1 phosphorylation (25855033)
スクロースを唯一の炭素源にすると Tpk2 が活性化し、Rpd3L の触媒サブユ: With sucrose as the sole carbon source, Tpk2 is activated and phosphorylates Rpd3, the catalytic subunit of Rpd3L, inhibiting its ability to deacetylate Ada3. This promotes SAGA dimerization, nucleosome acetylation, and transcription of sucrose utilization and TCA cycle genes (40301306)
ステロールは液胞の NPC2 と膜タンパク質 NCR1 の疎水ポケットの間で受け: Sterol is transferred between the hydrophobic pockets of vacuolar NPC2 and the membrane protein NCR1 (31543266)
ステロール取り込みの遺伝子 AUS1・DAN1 は Sut1 の標的で、PAK（: The sterol uptake genes AUS1 and DAN1 are Sut1 targets, and PAKs (Ste20, Cla4, Skm1) lower their expression (19793923)
ストレスで活性化した Mpk1/Slt2 は Sir3 をリン酸化し、Sir3: Stress-activated Mpk1/Slt2 phosphorylates Sir3, and Sir3 hyperphosphorylation correlates with reduced subtelomeric silencing (PMID 12504006). Phosphorylation of Sir3 S275 via the Slt2 pathway shortens lifespan, and removing the site extends it (PMID 12640455)
ストレスで活性化した Rho1 は TORC1 の Kog1 に直接結合し、TO: Stress-activated Rho1 binds Kog1 of TORC1 directly, lowering TORC1 activity and disrupting its membrane association. The binding also triggers release and activation of the Tap42-2A phosphatase (22445487)
ストレスで誘導される Sdp1 は Slt2 を直接脱リン酸化して負に調節する。: Stress-induced Sdp1 directly dephosphorylates Slt2 and negatively regulates it. sdp1 deletion increases heat-induced Slt2 phosphorylation (PMID 11923319). Yil113p (Sdp1) binds Slt2 and dephosphorylates and inactivates it in vivo (PMID 12220658)
ストレスのないとき Kar2 は Ire1 の内腔ドメインに結合して不活性の非リ: In the absence of stress, Kar2 binds the Ire1 lumenal domain and keeps it in an inactive, unphosphorylated state; under ER stress it is released and Ire1 is activated (11118306). kar2 mutations in the substrate-binding domain abolish Ire1 binding and activate the UPR without stress, while ATPase mutations keep Kar2 bound and prevent the UPR (12808051)
ストレスのないとき Sis1 は核質に集まり、Hsp70 の Hsf1 への結合: In the absence of stress, Sis1 concentrates in the nucleoplasm and promotes Hsp70 binding to Hsf1, repressing the heat shock response. Upon heat shock, Sis1 moves to a network at the nucleolus and ER surface (33326013). A 2026 preprint, 42619928, also reports that depleting Sis1 enhances the response outside heat shock (not cited because it is not peer-reviewed)
ストレスのないとき Ssa1 は Hsf1 を抑え、Ssa1 のシステインの修飾: In the absence of stress, Ssa1 represses Hsf1, and modification of Ssa1 cysteines activates Hsf1 (22809627). Hsf1 is normally bound to Hsp70 and transiently released upon heat shock (27831465). Removing CE2, the Hsp70-binding site of Hsf1, raises basal activity and delays inactivation after heat shock (29393852). An older report, 11251812, found that SSA2 overexpression does not repress the heat shock response
ストレスのないとき核の Ypt1 が pre-HAC1 mRNA に結合して分解: In the absence of stress, nuclear Ypt1 binds pre-HAC1 mRNA and recruits decay factors; the degraded precursor is poorly delivered to Ire1 clusters, lowering splicing and translation. Under ER stress, Ypt1 moves to the cytoplasm and pre-HAC1 mRNA increases (37533322)
ストレス下で rsp5 変異体では Egd2 がたまる。温度を上げると Egd2: Under stress, Egd2 accumulates in rsp5 mutants. Raising the temperature causes Egd2 ubiquitination in wild type but not in rsp5 mutants, and Rsp5 ubiquitinates Egd2 at high temperature in vitro as well. Under stress, Egd2 is degraded mainly by the proteasome (19682071)
ストレス下での Rho5 のミトコンドリアへの移行には Alo1（と Fun14: Translocation of Rho5 to mitochondria under stress requires Alo1 (and Fun14 and Msp1) (38503132)
ストレス時に Dcp2 は Ste20 によって S137 がリン酸化される。こ: Under stress, Dcp2 is phosphorylated at S137 by Ste20. This phosphorylation affects decay of some mRNAs and is required for Dcp2 to gather in P bodies, for binding to specific proteins, and for efficient stress granule formation (20513766). In the main text, non-phosphorylatable S137A does not gather in P bodies under glucose starvation, but in vitro decapping activity is unchanged for both S137A and S137E
スフィンゴシンによる Ca2+ 流入の一つの経路は Cch1・Mid1 を要し、: One pathway of sphingosine-induced Ca2+ influx requires Cch1 and Mid1 and depends on Lcb4 and Lcb5 (11278643)
スフィンゴ脂質代謝の阻害や細胞膜の伸展による膜ストレスで Slm タンパク質が細: Membrane stress from inhibited sphingolipid metabolism or plasma membrane stretching moves Slm proteins between plasma membrane domains, increasing their binding to TORC2 and TORC2 activation (22504275). TORC2 activation by increased membrane tension involves movement of Slm1/2 from eisosomes to the TORC2-containing compartment (30154550)
スフィンゴ脂質合成の阻害や Ypk1 の欠失で起こる PLB1 の発現上昇は C: The increased PLB1 expression caused by inhibition of sphingolipid synthesis or Ypk1 deletion is under Crz1 control (25258318)
スペルミン・スペルミジンでの QDR3 の転写の上昇は Gcn4 と Yap1: The increase in QDR3 transcription by spermine and spermidine depends on Gcn4 and Yap1. The increase under nitrogen and amino acid limitation also depends on Gcn4 (21148207)
スペルミン・スペルミジンでの QDR3 の転写の上昇は Yap1 に依存する（2: The increase in QDR3 transcription by spermine and spermidine depends on Yap1 (21148207)
スルフィレドキシン Srx1 は Tsa1 のシステインスルフィン酸を ATP: Sulfiredoxin Srx1 reduces the cysteine sulfinic acid of Tsa1 in an ATP-dependent manner and is required for the antioxidant function of peroxiredoxin (14586471). Srx1 reduces and reactivates Tsa1 that has become hyperoxidized and inactive with aging (21884982)
セパラーゼのバイオセンサーで、セパラーゼが 1 分以内にほとんどのコヒーシンを切: A separase biosensor showed that separase cleaves most cohesin within 1 minute. PP2A(Cdc55) counteracts polo kinase phosphorylation of Scc1 to inhibit cleavage, and at the start of anaphase separase inhibits PP2A(Cdc55) to promote cleavage (22814605). The abstract does not distinguish the catalytic subunits (Pph21/Pph22), so confidence is medium
セパリン Esp1 は Scc1 のタンパク質分解による切断を促して染色体から外: The separin Esp1 promotes proteolytic cleavage of Scc1, releasing it from chromosomes, and uncleavable Scc1 blocks sister chromatid separation (10403247). Esp1 is a caspase-like cysteine protease that alone cleaves Scc1 in vitro, and cleaving Scc1 in metaphase-arrested cells separates sister chromatids (11081625)
セパレースは Cdc14 を活性化することが知られ、Cdc14 がセキュリンの分: Separase is known to activate Cdc14, and Cdc14 accelerates securin degradation, forming positive feedback that abruptly initiates anaphase (18552837)
セプチンにつくキナーゼ Elm1 と Gin4 は細胞周期の 2 か所で互いを調: The septin-associated kinases Elm1 and Gin4 regulate each other at two points in the cell cycle. At bud emergence, Gin4 targets Elm1 to the bud neck by direct binding and phosphorylation, controlling assembly and stability of the septin hourglass
セラミドで活性化された Sit4 が Sso t-SNARE を脱リン酸化し、S: Ceramide-activated Sit4 dephosphorylates Sso t-SNAREs, increasing complex formation with Sec9 and secretion. Mutating the PKA site S79 to alanine rescues snc mutants (11157748). Sso1 and Sso2 are treated together
セラミド合成酵素の正しい働きには CK2 の Cka2 サブユニットが要る。La: Proper function of ceramide synthase requires the Cka2 subunit of CK2. Lac1 and Lag1 are direct CK2 targets, and phosphorylation of conserved C-terminal sites is required for optimal activity. Phosphorylation is also involved in their localization and distribution in the ER membrane (25429105)
セントロメアの数が増えると細胞が大きくなる。これは Cln3 の分解が増えること: Increasing centromere number enlarges cells. This is a G1 delay due to increased Cln3 degradation, mediated by Mad3 and Bub3. Mad3 binds both Cln3 and Cdc4, and this binding is essential for the effect (30080861)
ソルビトール-6-リン酸とリビトール-5-リン酸は Pgi を阻害し、糖アルコー: Sorbitol-6-phosphate and ribitol-5-phosphate inhibit Pgi, and Pyp1 activity is important for maintaining Pgi activity in the presence of sugar alcohols. Main text: pyp1 deletion strains show features of Pgi inhibition (increased glucose-6-phosphate and decreased FBP) (30240188)
ソーティングネキシン Ypt35 が Vps13 をエンドソームと液胞の膜に呼び: The sorting nexin Ypt35 is an adaptor recruiting Vps13 to endosomal and vacuolar membranes (30018089)
ソーティングネキシン欠損株の画像スクリーンで積荷を探し、Ear1・Ymd8・Ym: An imaging screen in sorting nexin-deficient strains searched for cargo, showing that the cytoplasmic domains of Ear1, Ymd8 and Ymr010w confer retromer-dependent sorting and identifying the conserved residues required (27883263)
タグ付き Sec8 と Sec6・Sec15 が共免疫沈降する。複合体は小さい芽: Tagged Sec8 coimmunoprecipitates with Sec6 and Sec15. The complex localizes to the tip of small buds (7615633)
タグ付き Sec8 と Sec6・Sec15 が共免疫沈降する（7615633）: Tagged Sec8 coimmunoprecipitates with Sec6 and Sec15 (7615633)
タグ付き Tho2 から Tho2・Hpr1・Mft1・Thp2 を含む複合体を: A complex containing Tho2, Hpr1, Mft1 and Thp2 was isolated from tagged Tho2 (11060033)
タグ付きの Cox16 が Cox1 の組み立て中間体と一緒に精製される。成熟し: Tagged Cox16 copurifies with Cox1 assembly intermediates. It is also present in mature COX (28821616)
タンパク質毒性ストレスで Roq1 は偽基質として Ubr1 に結合し、N デグ: Under proteotoxic stress, Roq1 binds Ubr1 as a pseudosubstrate, regulating degradation of N-degron pathway substrates and promoting clearance of misfolded proteins (39920309)
ツニカマイシンで eS7A のユビキチン化が増え、Not4 による eS7A の: Tunicamycin increases eS7A ubiquitination, and monoubiquitination of eS7A by Not4 is required for tunicamycin resistance. Ribosome profiling showed that eS7A monoubiquitination is essential for increased HAC1i translation (33184379)
ツニカマイシン処理時、eos1 欠失株では小胞体ストレスで誘導される KAR2: Upon tunicamycin treatment, ER stress-induced KAR2 transcription is much lower in eos1 deletion strains than in wild type (17187761)
ツーハイブリッドで Ebp2 が L36a/b・L34a/b・L8 と相互作用。: In two-hybrid, Ebp2 interacts with L36a/b, L34a/b and L8. RPL36A/B are multicopy suppressors of ebp2 mutations (25119672)
ツーハイブリッドで Lin1 がコヒーシンの Irr1/Scc3 と相互作用する: In two-hybrid, Lin1 interacts with the cohesin Irr1/Scc3 (12402242)
ツーハイブリッドで Orc2-Orc3・Orc2-Orc6・Orc3-Orc6: Strong two-hybrid interactions such as Orc2-Orc3, Orc2-Orc6 and Orc3-Orc6, suggesting that 2p-3p-6p form a core complex (17825065)
ツーハイブリッドで Pex34 は Pex11・Pex25・Pex27 と結合（: In two-hybrid, Pex34 binds Pex11, Pex25 and Pex27 (21441307)
In two-hybrid, Pex34 binds Pex11, Pex25 and Pex27 (but not Vps1). Promotion of division by Pex34 depends on the Pex11 family (21441307)
ツーハイブリッドで Rpb9 が Tfa1 と結合。rpb9 欠失で Tfa1: In two-hybrid, Rpb9 binds Tfa1. rpb9 deletion reduces copurification of Tfa1 with Pol II (11779853)
ツーハイブリッドで SmE と SmG（Smx2）が結合し、直接の生化学的な試験: In two-hybrid, SmE and SmG (Smx2) bind, confirmed by direct biochemical assays (9528767)
ツーハイブリッドで Snu56 が Mer1・Nam8 と相互作用する。snu5: In two-hybrid, Snu56 interacts with Mer1 and Nam8. snu56-2 impairs Mer1-dependent meiotic splicing (18268012)
ツーハイブリッドで Spc34 の Duo1・Dam1・Dad1・Spc19 と: Two-hybrid defined the regions of Spc34 that bind Duo1, Dam1, Dad1 and Spc19 (14627828)
ツーハイブリッドで Swi6 が Rsc58 と結合する候補として見つかり、二重: Swi6 was found in two-hybrid as a candidate Rsc58-binding protein, and double mutants show stronger growth defects (15034784)
ツーハイブリッドで Vps1 が Chc1 の C 末端領域に結合。vps1 欠: In two-hybrid, Vps1 binds the C-terminal region of Chc1. vps1 deletion shifts clathrin localization to late endosomes and the vacuole (28256270)
ツーハイブリッドで Vps1 は ESCRT-II の Vps22・Vps36: In two-hybrid, Vps1 binds the ESCRT-II subunits Vps22 and Vps36 (28185357)
ツーハイブリッドと検索で見つけたサイクリン様遺伝子（CLG1 を含む）の産物はす: Products of all cyclin-like genes (including CLG1) found by two-hybrid and database search interacted with Pho85 in affinity chromatography (9032248)
ツーハイブリッドと試験管内の結合実験で Tar1 と Coq5 の物理的な結合（: Physical binding of Tar1 and Coq5 in two-hybrid and in vitro binding assays (18622616)
ツーハイブリッド・共沈・試験管内結合で eIF1A と eIF5B は直接結合し: In two-hybrid, coprecipitation and in vitro binding, eIF1A and eIF5B bind directly, with the binding site at the eIF5B C-terminus. This site is important for growth and translation (10982835)
テロメアの損傷で MEN を止める仕組みは、Rad53 に依存して Cdc5 に: The mechanism stopping the MEN upon telomere damage is Rad53-dependent inhibition of Bfa1 phosphorylation by Cdc5 (24130507). Rad53 inhibits the MEN, and loss of the Rad53 pathway loosens MEN inhibition by Bfa1 (17485442)
ニコチンアミドリボシドは NAD+ 合成を増やして Sir2 依存の抑制・サイレ: Nicotinamide riboside increases NAD+ synthesis and strengthens Sir2-dependent repression and silencing. Its action depends on two pathways, the Nrk1 pathway and the Urh1/Pnp1/Meu1 pathway (17482543)
ニコチンアミドリボシドは Nrk1 経路と Urh1/Pnp1/Meu1 経路で: Nicotinamide riboside increases NAD+ via the Nrk1 pathway and the Urh1/Pnp1/Meu1 pathway and enhances Sir2 function (17482543)
ニトロソ化ストレスで Fba1 は Cys112 で S-グルタチオン化され活性: Under nitrosative stress, Fba1 is S-glutathionylated at Cys112, lowering its activity. The cytosolic glutaredoxin Grx1 removes the glutathionylation and restores activity (36272668)
ノーザンと酵素活性で、THI80 の発現は THI2 と THI3 の正の制御因: By Northern blotting and enzyme activity, THI80 expression requires the positive regulators THI2 and THI3 (8394343)
ノーザンブロットで YIL014C-A などが FLO11 の誘導を介してバイオ: Northern blotting showed that YIL014C-A and others control biofilm through induction of FLO11 (25009170)
ヒストン H4 のアセチル化部位の変異株は NHEJ と複製と共役した修復に欠陥: Mutants of histone H4 acetylation sites are defective in NHEJ and replication-coupled repair, and both pathways require Esa1, which acetylates all lysines of the H4 tail. Arp4 of NuA4 is recruited to break sites, and Esa1-Arp4 preferentially acetylates nucleosomes near break ends (12353039). BioGRID papers (10082517, 16135807 and others) only link acetylation to the cell cycle and transcription and do not describe effects on H4 function itself. HHF1 and HHF2 encode the same H4, so the evidence is the same
ピルビン酸キナーゼ Pyk1（CDC19）はセリン代謝酵素・SAM 合成酵素など: Pyruvate kinase Pyk1 (CDC19) forms the SESAME complex with serine-metabolizing enzymes, SAM synthetases and others, which is recruited by the Set1 complex to phosphorylate H3T11 at target genes (26527276). SESAME phosphorylates H3T11 at telomeres, maintaining SIR complex binding and protecting Sir2 from autophagic degradation (33500413). Pyk1 phosphorylates H3T11 to regulate gene expression and oxidative stress resistance. Glycolytic mutations reduce H3T11 phosphorylation (28426732)
フィンブリン Sac6 は分裂中期の Clb2-Cdk1 に体内でも試験管内でも: The fimbrin Sac6 is phosphorylated at T103 by metaphase Clb2-Cdk1 both in vivo and in vitro, and this phosphorylation regulates Sac6 actin binding to control actin cable formation and stability (27068241). The main text states that sac6(T103A) shows poor cable formation in extracts, is nearly synthetically lethal with cap2Δ, and impairs Sac6 function
フェロモンで Fus3 が Fus2 S84 をリン酸化して核外へ出す。Cdk: With pheromone, Fus3 phosphorylates Fus2 S84 and exports it from the nucleus. Cdk and Cla4 phosphorylate S67, promoting nuclear import and preventing nuclear export, retaining Fus2 in the nucleus (22588722)
フェロモンで Fus3 が Fus2 S84 をリン酸化して核外へ出す。細胞分裂: With pheromone, Fus3 phosphorylates Fus2 S84 and exports it from the nucleus. After cell division it also lowers S67 phosphorylation (22588722)
フェロモンで Ste5 が細胞表面へ移り、それには Gβγ と Ste5 の G: With pheromone, Ste5 moves to the cell surface, requiring Gβγ and the Gβγ-binding site of Ste5. Membrane-tethered Ste5 activates the pathway without Gβγ (9732267). Ste4 mutants unable to bind Ste5 still bind Gpa1 and Ste18 but cannot transmit the signal and are sterile (9832519)
フェロモンで誘導される Ste12 が PRY3 プロモーターの PRE に結合: Pheromone-induced Ste12 binds the PRE in the PRY3 promoter and blocks transcription of full-length mRNA (16940175)
フェロモンで誘導される付着分子のうち、よく知られた Aga2 と Sag1 の結: Among pheromone-induced adhesion molecules, in addition to the well-known Aga2-Sag1 binding, binding such as Aga1-Fig2 was shown (19299340)
フェロモンによる Kar4 の誘導が、核融合に要る KAR3 と PRM2 の遅: Pheromone induction of Kar4 is required for the delayed induction of KAR3 and PRM2, which are needed for nuclear fusion (17101777)
フェロモン応答で Fus3 が Tec1 の T273 をリン酸化し、SCF-C: In the pheromone response, Fus3 phosphorylates Tec1 T273, leading to its ubiquitination and degradation by SCF-Cdc4 (15620356)
フェロモン応答で Fus3 は Rga2 の抑制性の S/TP 部位（CDK と: In the pheromone response, Fus3 phosphorylates inhibitory S/TP sites of Rga2 (the same sites as CDK), and calcineurin counters this by activating Rga2, lowering Cdc42 signaling. Main text: Fus3 directly phosphorylates Rga2 in vitro (28077617)
フェロモン応答で Kar4 は Ste12 の DNA 結合部位のほぼすべてへの: In the pheromone response, Kar4 promotes Ste12 binding to nearly all of its DNA-binding sites, increasing the overall DNA-binding specificity of Ste12 (41732116)
フェロモン応答で Tec1 は速やかに分解される。Fus3（Kss1 ではない）: Tec1 is rapidly degraded in the pheromone response. Fus3 (not Kss1) phosphorylates Tec1 T273 in vitro and in vivo, causing ubiquitination and degradation by SCF-Cdc4. T273V is not degraded, and filamentous growth genes are induced by pheromone (15620356, 15620357). 15558284 also states that Fus3 phosphorylates Tec1 and lowers its function, and 19897738 shows that phosphorylation of both T273 and T276 is required for Cdc4 recognition
フェロモン応答での Tec1 の分解には F ボックスタンパク質 Dia2 と: Degradation of Tec1 in the pheromone response requires the F-box protein Dia2 and Cdc53 (15620356 attributes it to SCF-Cdc4) (15620357)
フェロモン応答でカルシニューリンは Rga2 を脱リン酸化して正に調節し、Fus: In the pheromone response, calcineurin dephosphorylates and positively regulates Rga2, activating it in opposition to Fus3 (28077617)
フェロモン経路の基礎と誘導の活性が Hsp90 に依存し、Hsp82 の低発現・: Basal and induced activity of the pheromone pathway depends on Hsp90 and is lacking in strains with low Hsp82 expression or point mutations. Ste11 forms a complex with Hsp90 and requires Hsp90 to accumulate (9802897)
フォルミン Bni1・Bnr1 はアクチン繊維の形成を促し、それがトロポミオシン: The formins Bni1 and Bnr1 promote formation of actin filaments, which become tropomyosin-stabilized cables guiding polarized growth. Loss of formin function destroys cables, and increased function causes accumulation of cable-like filaments. Cable formation requires profilin but not Arp2/3 (11875440). Activated Bni1 promotes actin filament nucleation in vitro, which profilin enhances (12134165)
フットプリント法で SNQ2 のプロモーターに Pdr3 の結合部位が 3 つ。: Footprinting shows three Pdr3 binding sites in the SNQ2 promoter. SNQ2 is a target of Pdr1 and Pdr3 (8861209)
フラタキシン欠損（Δyfh1）でミトコンドリアのアスパラギン酸アミノトランスフェ: Frataxin deficiency (Δyfh1) completely inactivates the mitochondrial aspartate aminotransferase Aat1, thought to be a secondary phenotype (22010850)
フリッパーゼの Dnf1・Dnf2 は細胞膜の表層にある Fpk1 にリン酸化さ: The flippases Dnf1 and Dnf2 are phosphorylated and activated by the cortical Fpk1 and transport aminophospholipids from the outer to the inner leaflet (background statement in 25646086)
フルクトースでは Mig1 の持続的な核・細胞質の往復に Hxk2 か Hxk1: On fructose, sustained nucleocytoplasmic shuttling of Mig1 requires Hxk2 or Hxk1, and expressing Hxk1 in hxk1Δhxk2Δ restores it (32948893)
プリン de novo 合成の酵素の合成はアデニンで抑えられ BAS1・BAS2: Synthesis of de novo purine synthesis enzymes is repressed by adenine and requires BAS1 and BAS2. ADE12 and ADE13 expression is controlled in the same way (9822821)
プリン合成遺伝子の発現には BAS1・BAS2 が要り、HIS1 と HIS4: Expression of purine synthesis genes requires BAS1 and BAS2, and HIS1 and HIS4 are subject to the same control (9822821)
プリン合成遺伝子の発現には BAS1・BAS2（PHO2）が要り、HIS1 はそ: Expression of purine synthesis genes requires BAS1 and BAS2 (PHO2), and HIS1 is subject to the same control (9822821)
プリン新規合成の酵素の発現はアデニンで抑えられ BAS1・BAS2 を必要とし、: Expression of de novo purine synthesis enzymes is repressed by adenine and requires BAS1 and BAS2, and ADE12 and ADE13 expression is subject to the same control (9822821)
プルダウンで Msc6 が mIF-2（IFM1）と一過的に結合。fmt1 ms: In pull-downs, Msc6 transiently binds mIF-2 (IFM1). The respiratory defect of fmt1 msc6 is rescued by IFM1 overexpression (30767393)
プロテアソームの活性が下がった株では Rpn4 が安定になり、Rpn4 の標的: In strains with reduced proteasome activity, Rpn4 becomes stable, its targets MAG1, RAD23 and RAD52 are overexpressed, and cells become more resistant to DNA damage (23954292)
プロテイン A 付き Glc7 で精製した複合体に Mhp1 が含まれる（118: The complex purified with protein A-tagged Glc7 contains Mhp1 (11841235)
プロテオミクスで、シトクロム b5 還元酵素 Cbr1 を Dph3 の NAD: Proteomics identified the cytochrome b5 reductase Cbr1 as the NADH-dependent reductase of Dph3 (27694803)
プロテオームアレイで Hmt1 の基質候補を探し、ex vivo のメチル化と: Proteome arrays were used to find candidate Hmt1 substrates, and ex vivo methylation and MS/MS confirmed 12, including Brr1, as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
プロテオームアレイと MS/MS で Dia4 などが Hmt1 の基質と確認（: Proteome arrays and MS/MS confirmed Dia4 and others as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
プロテオームアレイと ex vivo のメチル化・MS/MS で Nug1 を含: Proteome arrays and ex vivo methylation/MS/MS confirmed 12 proteins including Nug1 as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
プロテオームアレイと ex vivo メチル化・MS/MS で Rrp43 など: Proteome arrays and ex vivo methylation/MS/MS confirmed 12 proteins including Rrp43 as Hmt1 substrates (26572822)
プロピオン酸ストレス下の Rim101p 依存の転写変化に、新しい標的として Y: Rim101p-dependent transcriptional changes under propionic acid stress include YIL029c (EMA17) as a new target, which is required for maximal tolerance to propionic acid (19220866)
プロピオン酸ストレス（pH 4.0）で Rim101 に依存して変わる遺伝子に: Genes changing in a Rim101-dependent manner under propionic acid stress (pH 4.0) include KNH1 as a new target (19220866)
プロモーターにつないだ Hir2 は HTA1-lacZ の転写を抑え、それには: Hir2 tethered to the promoter represses HTA1-lacZ transcription, which requires Hir1 and Hir3 (9001207)
プロモーターへの Pho2 の結合は Bas1 に依存し、ADE 遺伝子が脱抑制: Pho2 binding to promoters depends on Bas1 and occurs only under conditions where ADE genes are derepressed (16215179)
プロモーター解析で Nrg1 と Mig1 が NYV1 の発現を抑える。ESC: Promoter analysis shows that Nrg1 and Mig1 repress NYV1 expression. ESCRT deletion increases Nrg1 binding to the NYV1 promoter (25017437)
ヘムがないとき Ssa-Ydj1 と Sro9 が協同で Hap1 を抑える（1: In the absence of heme, Ssa-Ydj1 and Sro9 cooperate to repress Hap1 (11689685). When Ssa, Ydj1 and Sro9 functions are lost, Hap1 can no longer be repressed even without heme (15102838)
ヘムに依存する ROX1 の発現には HAP1 が要る（1588959）。ヘムと: Heme-dependent ROX1 expression requires HAP1 (1588959). Heme-bound Hap1 activates ROX1 transcription (9027731, review)
ヘムは COX5a を上げ COX5b を下げ、HAP2 と REO1（ROX1: Heme raises COX5a and lowers COX5b; HAP2 and REO1 (ROX1) are involved in positive regulation of COX5a and negative regulation of COX5b, respectively (2847035)
ヘムは Rox7（Mot3）抑制因子を通じて DAN/TIR 遺伝子の一部の発現: Heme controls expression of some DAN/TIR genes through the Rox7 (Mot3) repressor (11238402)
ヘム合成の HEM1 は HAP2 に制御されると既に報告されており、この発現の: The heme synthesis gene HEM1 has already been reported to be controlled by HAP2, and in this expression comparison too it is 2-fold higher in wild type (18629096)
ヘム合成の HEM2 は HAP2 に制御されると既に報告されており、この発現の: The heme synthesis gene HEM2 has already been reported to be controlled by HAP2, and in this expression comparison too it is 2-fold higher in wild type (18629096)
ヘム欠乏で Yeh1 の定常量が増えて唯一の活性なステリルエステル加水分解酵素に: Under heme deficiency, steady-state levels of Yeh1 increase and it becomes the only active steryl ester hydrolase. This increase requires Rox3 (16835446)
ペキソファジーの誘導で Dnm1 と Vps1 は Atg11・Atg36 との: Upon pexophagy induction, Dnm1 and Vps1 are recruited to peroxisomes destined for degradation via binding to Atg11 and Atg36, and peroxisome fission is required for efficient degradation (24451165)
ペルオキシレドキシン Tsa1 は PKA の触媒サブユニットのシステインの酸化: The peroxiredoxin Tsa1 promotes oxidation of cysteines in the PKA catalytic subunit; modification of Cys243 lowers Thr241 phosphorylation and enzyme activity
ホスファチジルイノシトール特異的ホスホリパーゼ C の Plc1 は TORC2: The phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase C Plc1 contributes to activation of both TORC2-Ypk1/2 and TORC2-Pkc1 signaling (35912799)
ポリアミンが eIF5A を抑えると HOL1 mRNA の uORF の Pr: When polyamines inhibit eIF5A, termination at the Pro-Ser-stop of the uORF in HOL1 mRNA is impaired and Hol1 synthesis is repressed (34375581)
マイトファジーの誘導で Atg32 がリン酸化され Atg11 と結合する。CK: Upon mitophagy induction, Atg32 is phosphorylated and binds Atg11. CK2 is essential for Atg32 phosphorylation, Atg32-Atg11 binding and mitophagy, and inhibiting CK2 stops only mitophagy. CK2 phosphorylates Atg32 S114 and S119 in vitro (23897086)
マイトファジーの誘導で Atg32 の C 末端が切断され、この切断は効率のよい: Upon mitophagy induction, the Atg32 C-terminus is cleaved, and this cleavage is required for efficient mitophagy. Cleavage is mediated by the i-AAA protease Yme1, and Atg32-Atg11 binding is greatly weakened in yme1Δ (24025448)
マイトファジーの誘導で分裂複合体が Atg11 と Dnm1 の結合を介して分解: Upon mitophagy induction, the fission complex is recruited to mitochondria destined for degradation via Atg11-Dnm1 binding, and preventing this binding strongly inhibits mitophagy (23810512)
マンガンが足りていると、Bsd2 は Smf1 と Smf2 の液胞への輸送を助: When manganese is sufficient, Bsd2 assists transport of Smf1 and Smf2 to the vacuole, where they are degraded. Smf3 is not regulated by Bsd2 (11027260)
ミトコンドリアには Trx3 と Trr2 からなるチオレドキシン系がある。Tr: Mitochondria have a thioredoxin system of Trx3 and Trr2. Trx3 remains reduced in trr2 single loss, but is partly oxidized when both TRR2 and GLR1 are lacking; both Trr2 and Glr1 are required to maintain the reduced state of Trx3 (15701801)
ミトコンドリアの 1-Cys Prx1 は触媒システインのグルタチオン化と、それ: The mitochondrial 1-Cys Prx1 is reactivated by glutathionylation of its catalytic cysteine followed by reduction by Trr2 and GSH (in vivo). Trx3 is dispensable for antioxidant activity (19332553)
ミトコンドリアの Fe-S 合成の遺伝子（YFH1・ISU1）の変異や発現の低下: Mutations or reduced expression of mitochondrial Fe-S synthesis genes (YFH1, ISU1) prevented induction of the Yap5 response (22915593)
ミトコンドリアの Ser/Thr ホスファターゼ Ptc7 は補酵素 Q6 の合: The mitochondrial Ser/Thr phosphatase Ptc7 is required for regulating coenzyme Q6 synthesis; it dephosphorylates Coq7, the demethoxy-Q6 hydroxylase, specifically activating Q6 synthesis and enhancing aerobic metabolism and oxidative stress resistance (23940037). Consistent with the UniProt direction (activation)
ミトコンドリアのストレスで輸入されなかった Mge1 が核へ入り、転写因子 Pd: Under mitochondrial stress, non-imported Mge1 enters the nucleus and induces mitoCPR target genes through binding with the transcription factor Pdr3 on DNA. The Mge1 MTS is sufficient and necessary for mitoCPR induction (41372412)
ミトコンドリアのプロセシングペプチダーゼ（MPP）が Arg5,6 前駆体を N: The mitochondrial processing peptidase (MPP) cleaves the Arg5,6 precursor at the N-terminus and internally, separating it into two enzymes (32997570)
ミトコンドリアの分裂・ペルオキシソームの分裂はプロテアソームの分解活性でなく R: Mitochondrial and peroxisomal fission depend not on proteasomal degradation activity but on a new function of Rpn11; Rpn11 controls the Fis1-dependent fission machinery (19773362)
ミリオシンによる Mup1 のエンドサイトーシスは、メチオニンによるものと違い、: Myriocin-induced endocytosis of Mup1, unlike methionine-induced endocytosis, requires the Rsp5 adaptor Art2, C-terminal lysines of Mup1 and K63-linked ubiquitin chains (37337792)
メチオニンによる HOM2・HOM3・THR1 の転写の促進は GCN4 による: Promotion of HOM2, HOM3 and THR1 transcription by methionine is via GCN4 (general amino acid control) (1789001)
メチオニン輸送体 Mup1 の Art1-Rsp5 によるユビキチン化とエンドサ: Features of the methionine transporter Mup1 required for Art1-Rsp5-mediated ubiquitination and endocytosis (such as an N-terminal acidic stretch) were shown. C-terminal suppressor mutations in Art1 complement Mup1 mutations (27798240)
ユビキチン受容体 Rpn13 は Rpn2 に直接結合する（22318722）: The ubiquitin receptor Rpn13 binds Rpn2 directly (22318722)
ラパマイシンで Sgs1 が速やかに失われ、rrd1Δ ではこの減少が完全に止ま: Rapamycin causes rapid loss of Sgs1, and this decrease is completely blocked in rrd1Δ (21639830)
ラパマイシンで TOR を止めると Ime1 が核に集まり安定化し初期減数分裂遺: When TOR is stopped by rapamycin, Ime1 concentrates in the nucleus and is stabilized, and early meiotic genes are induced. Activating TOR with glutamine moves Ime1 to the cytoplasm. TOR regulates Ime1 localization even without Cdk1 activity (14517308)
ラパマイシンで Tip41 の Tap42 への結合が強まり、これは Sit4: Rapamycin strengthens Tip41 binding to Tap42, due to Sit4-dependent dephosphorylation of Tip41 (11741537)
ラパマイシンで Tor1 と Tor2 を特異的に阻害すると Sit4 と Ta: Specific inhibition of Tor1 and Tor2 by rapamycin rapidly activates Mpk1 via Sit4 and Tap42; the PKC pathway is regulated by TOR function (12171921)
ラパマイシンで誘導される DAL5 の発現と Gln3・Gat1 の DAL5: Rapamycin-induced DAL5 expression and binding of Gln3 and Gat1 to the DAL5 promoter require PP2A (20974806). By ChIP, Gln3 cannot bind DAL5 without Gat1 (18245087)
ラパマイシンによる Gcn2 の Ser577 の脱リン酸化・eIF2α のリン: TAP42 is involved in all of rapamycin-induced dephosphorylation of Gcn2 Ser577, eIF2α phosphorylation and GCN4 induction (12654728)
ラパマイシンによる Tec1 の分解は HECT 型ユビキチンリガーゼ Rsp5: Rapamycin-induced degradation of Tec1 depends on the HECT ubiquitin ligase Rsp5, which physically binds Tec1 via a PxY motif (21840851)
ラパマイシン存在下や窒素飢餓で Dot6 は SCF-Grr1 に依存してプロテ: In the presence of rapamycin or under nitrogen starvation, Dot6 is degraded by the proteasome in an SCF-Grr1-dependent manner. Accumulation of Dot6 and Tod6 over-represses Ribi genes and translation, impairing growth on rapamycin (35310337)
ラパマイシン後に核へ集まった Kns1 が Rpc53 のリン酸化をプライミング: Kns1, which gathers in the nucleus after rapamycin, primes Rpc53 phosphorylation, and Mck1 then phosphorylates it. This inhibits Pol III function (22364741)
リシンによる Lys14 の活性化の抑制は、ホモクエン酸合成酵素のフィードバック: Inhibition of Lys14 activation by lysine is due to control of αAASA production through feedback inhibition of homocitrate synthase (10103047)
リジン除去後の Ypq1 の選択的分解に Rsp5 と Ssh4 からなる液胞の: Selective degradation of Ypq1 after lysine removal requires a vacuolar ubiquitin ligase complex of Rsp5 and Ssh4 (25620559)
リパーゼ Lpl1 は転写因子 Rpn4 の応答の標的（28100635）: The lipase Lpl1 is a target of the transcription factor Rpn4 response (28100635)
リパーゼ Tgl3・Tgl4 は G1/S の進行に要り、脂肪分解の欠損で Sw: The lipases Tgl3 and Tgl4 are required for G1/S progression; loss of lipolysis activates Swe1, which phosphorylates Cdc28 Y19 (25713391)
リボソームタンパク質遺伝子のプロモーターの Rap1 結合部位は UASrpg: Rap1 binding sites in ribosomal protein gene promoters are of the UASrpg type; replacing it in RPS17B with the telomeric type reduces transcription by two-thirds (11358963)
リボソーム合成の Utp7 は動原体にもあり、Sli15 と Cdc14 に結合: The ribosome synthesis factor Utp7 is also at kinetochores, binds Sli15 and Cdc14, and controls their localization. It prevents premature release of Cdc14 from the nucleolus before anaphase (18794331)
リン酸がないと Cln3 が減り G1 で止まる。Pho85 の活性が低いと C: Without phosphate, Cln3 decreases and cells arrest in G1. When Pho85 activity is low, Cln3 becomes unstable, and Cln3 with Pho85 sites replaced by aspartate is maintained at high levels even without Pho85. Pho85 stabilizes Cln3 to allow cell-cycle entry (23339867)
リン酸の飢餓で Pho4 がプロモーターに結合して PHO84・PHO89 が誘: Under phosphate starvation, Pho4 binds promoters and induces PHO84 and PHO89. Under alkaline conditions, Crz1 and others are also involved (25266663). PHO89 is transcribed only under phosphate limitation (9671031)
リン酸の飢餓で Pho87 が液胞へ運ばれるには Pho4 に依存する遺伝子 S: Delivery of Pho87 to the vacuole under phosphate starvation requires the Pho4-dependent gene SPL2 (21143198)
リン酸制限で Vip1 が作る IP7 が増え、Pho81 による Pho80/: Under phosphate limitation, IP7 made by Vip1 increases, causing inhibition of Pho80/Pho85 by Pho81 (28520786)
リン酸化された COPII の被覆は脱リン酸化されるまで小胞体に再結合できない。: The phosphorylated COPII coat cannot rebind the ER until it is dephosphorylated. Sit4 dephosphorylates coat components in vitro, and hyperphosphorylated components accumulate in sit4Δ (the abstract does not name Sfb3; the BioGRID record is Figure 2)
リン酸化された Cln1 と Cln2 は SCF-Grr1 でユビキチン化され: Phosphorylated Cln1 and Cln2 are ubiquitinated by SCF-Grr1 and degraded by the 26S proteasome (11527976)
リン酸化された Ho は F-box タンパク質 Ufo1 により SCF でユ: Phosphorylated Ho is ubiquitinated by SCF via the F-box protein Ufo1 (15964793, 16671359)
リン酸化された Mpk1 が Swi4 と複合体を作り FKS2 プロモーターに: Phosphorylated Mpk1 forms a complex with Swi4 and makes it bind the FKS2 promoter. Kinase activity is not required (non-catalytic activation)
リン酸化された Mpk1・Mlp1 が FKS2 プロモーターで Swi4・Sw: Phosphorylated Mpk1 and Mlp1 form a complex with Swi4 and Swi6 at the FKS2 promoter and activate transcription independently of kinase activity (18268013)
リン酸化された Rod1 は 14-3-3 と結合している。グルコースで脱リン酸: Phosphorylated Rod1 is bound to 14-3-3. When dephosphorylated by glucose, it is released from 14-3-3 and ubiquitinated by Rsp5 to become active (22249293)
リン酸化されていない Ssk1 は Ubc7 に依存するユビキチン-プロテアソー: Unphosphorylated Ssk1 is selectively degraded by the Ubc7-dependent ubiquitin-proteasome system, downregulating the HOG pathway after osmoadaptation (12944490)
リン酸化できない cdc37 変異体では CKII の活性が下がる。CKII と: Non-phosphorylatable cdc37 mutants have reduced CKII activity. CKII and Cdc37 form positive feedback (12435747)
リン酸化で小胞体から出た Orm2 は、ゴルジ体・エンドソームで Dsc 複合体: Orm2 that has exited the ER upon phosphorylation is polyubiquitinated by the Dsc complex in the Golgi and endosomes, extracted from the membrane by Cdc48 and degraded by the proteasome (EGAD). This relieves inhibition of sphingolipid synthesis (31368600)
リン酸化プロテオミクスで、Gcn2 は Gcn20 をリン酸化し、Gcn2 を活: Phosphoproteomics showed that Gcn2 phosphorylates Gcn20, creating negative feedback that prevents formation of the Gcn1-Gcn20 complex that activates Gcn2 (33743194)
リン酸化プロテオミクスで見つけた Rad53 の基質のうち 12 個（Snu23: Of the Rad53 substrates found by phosphoproteomics, 12 (including Snu23) were confirmed to be directly phosphorylated in vitro (30377154)
リン酸化プロテオミクスで見つけた Rad53 の新しい基質 33 のうち、Alb: Of 33 new Rad53 substrates found by phosphoproteomics, 12 including Alb1 are directly phosphorylated by Rad53 in vitro (30377154)
リン酸化プロテオミクスで見つけた Rad53 の新しい基質のうち、Set3 を含: Of the new Rad53 substrates found by phosphoproteomics, 12 including Set3 were confirmed to be directly phosphorylated in vitro (30377154)
リン酸化プロテオミクスで見つけた Rad53 の新しい基質のうち、Srv2 を含: Of the new Rad53 substrates found by phosphoproteomics, 12 including Srv2 were confirmed as directly phosphorylated in vitro (30377154)
リン酸欠乏で低親和性リン酸輸送体はエンドサイトーシスで液胞へ送られ、Pho87: Under phosphate deficiency, low-affinity phosphate transporters are sent to the vacuole by endocytosis, which for Pho87 strictly depends on SPL2. Pho90 does not depend on Spl2 (21143198). Spl2 appears to physically bind the SPX domains of Pho87 and Pho90 (19590579)
リン酸飢餓で代謝物センサー Pho81 は Atg11/FIP200 結合モチー: Under phosphate starvation, the metabolite sensor Pho81 binds Atg11 via an Atg11/FIP200-binding motif and regulates pexophagy through its SPX domain. It compensates for partially inactive Atg13 and promotes Atg11 phosphorylation by Atg1 (38316984 abstract and main text)
ロンボイド Rbd1 の基質として Ccp1 と Mgm1 を同定（127741: Ccp1 and Mgm1 were identified as substrates of the rhomboid Rbd1 (12774122)
ロンボイド偽プロテアーゼ Dfm1 は SPOTS 複合体と結合し、ERAD に: The rhomboid pseudoprotease Dfm1 binds the SPOTS complex and, independently of ERAD, assists ER export of Orm2, the main inhibitor of SPT, and its degradation in endosomes and Golgi (EGAD) (36350249)
一倍体の sum1・hst1・rfm1 欠失株では、オレイン酸で誘導される SP: In haploid sum1, hst1 and rfm1 deletion strains, oleate-induced SPS18 expression is higher than in wild type. The SPS18 MSE acts in repression (19583587)
上下関係の解析から Rtg2 と Mks1 は TOR の下流、Rtg1・Rtg: Epistasis analysis shows that Rtg2 and Mks1 act downstream of TOR and upstream of Rtg1 and Rtg3, and Mks1 is a negative regulator of activation of RTG target genes (11882290)
中性トレハラーゼ Nth1 とグリコーゲンホスホリラーゼ Gph1 の活性はおそ: The activities of neutral trehalase Nth1 and glycogen phosphorylase Gph1 are probably directly controlled by CDK (27203179). Main text: CDK phosphorylates Gph1 in vitro. Inhibiting Cdc28 causes glycogen accumulation
中期の動原体タンパク質 Dsn1 の脱リン酸化に Cdc14 が要る。後期の前に: Dephosphorylation of the kinetochore protein Dsn1 in metaphase requires Cdc14. Some Cdc14 appears to act outside the nucleolus even before anaphase (20923974)
主な細胞質ヒストンアセチル化酵素は Hat1 と Hat2 を含み、Hat2 は: The main cytoplasmic histone acetyltransferase contains Hat1 and Hat2, and Hat2 is required for high-affinity binding to H4 (8858151)

凝集する細胞では FLO1・FLO5 のプロモーターで Tup1 の結合が少なく: In flocculating cells, Tup1 binding is low and Rlm1 binding is high at the FLO1 and FLO5 promoters (31441971)
出芽と接合のとき Sph1p が成長の場所に正しく局在するには Spa2p が要: Correct localization of Sph1p to growth sites during budding and mating requires Spa2p (9443897)
出芽やフェロモンによる突起の形成のとき Slt2 がチロシンのリン酸化を受けて活: During budding and pheromone-induced projection formation, Slt2 is activated by tyrosine phosphorylation. Activation during vegetative growth is greatly reduced in cdc28 ts mutants and partly depends on Cdc28 (8598209). Direct action is not shown
出芽酵母 EMC のクライオ電顕構造。膜貫通部分は Emc4・Emc5・Emc6: Cryo-EM structure of budding yeast EMC. The transmembrane portion consists of Emc4, Emc5 and Emc6 plus the transmembrane domains of Emc1 and Emc3 (32494008)
出芽酵母でも Nt-amidase・arginyltransferase・UBR: In budding yeast too, Nt-amidase, arginyltransferase and UBR1 form a targeting complex (32366662)
In budding yeast too, Nt-amidase, arginyltransferase and UBR1-RAD6/UFD4-UBC4/5 form a targeting complex (32366662)
出芽酵母でも Nt-アミダーゼ・アルギニル転移酵素・UBR1-RAD6/UFD4: In budding yeast too, Nt-amidase, arginyltransferase and UBR1-RAD6/UFD4-UBC4/5 form a similar targeting complex (32366662)
出芽酵母でも Nt-アミダーゼ・アルギニル転移酵素・二重の E3（UBR1-RA: In budding yeast too, Nt-amidase, arginyltransferase and the dual E3 (UBR1-RAD6/UFD4-UBC4/5) form a targeting complex (32366662)
出芽酵母と線虫で、分裂期の H3 S10 のリン酸化は Ipl1/Aurora: In budding yeast and nematodes, mitotic H3 S10 phosphorylation is determined by the balance of Ipl1/Aurora kinase and Glc7/PP1, both required for H3 phosphorylation and chromosome segregation (10975519)
出芽酵母の EMC は 8 つの構成要素からなり、膜貫通部分を Emc4・5・6: Budding yeast EMC consists of eight components, and the transmembrane portion is formed by Emc4, 5 and 6 plus the transmembrane portions of Emc1 and Emc3 (32494008)
出芽酵母の H2A は二本鎖切断の周り 50 kb にわたって Tel1 と M: Budding yeast H2A is phosphorylated by Tel1 and Mec1 over 50 kb around double-strand breaks, recruiting repair factors (16299494)
出芽酵母の Nap1 は Clb2 と結合し Clb3 とは結合しない。遺伝学的: Budding yeast Nap1 binds Clb2 but not Clb3. Genetically, NAP1 is important for Clb2 function (7622566)
出芽酵母の Nop1 が Nop56 の N 末ドメインに結合した高分解能の構造: High-resolution structure of budding yeast Nop1 bound to the N-terminal domain of Nop56. Nop56 recruits the methyltransferase to the box C/D RNP (33483369)
出芽酵母の PRS 遺伝子は単独では PRPP 合成活性がなく、PRS1 PRS: Budding yeast PRS genes individually have no PRPP synthetase activity, and combinations such as PRS1 PRS4 produce active enzyme (expression in E. coli) (15280369)
出芽酵母の RPB3/RPB11 ヘテロ二量体は RPB11 の C 末端に強く: The budding yeast RPB3/RPB11 heterodimer depends strongly on the RPB11 C-terminus (15987790)
出芽酵母のセキュリン Pds1 はセパレース Esp1 を抑えるだけでなく、その: The budding yeast securin Pds1 not only inhibits separase Esp1 but also promotes its nuclear localization (12050115)
出芽酵母のタンパク質で、mtClpX が ALAS の mtClpX 結合部位か: With budding yeast proteins, mtClpX partially unfolds ALAS from the mtClpX-binding site to the active site, opening cofactor binding and activating it (32091391)
分子内ジスルフィド結合をもつ型の Mic19 が MICOS の Mic60 に: The form of Mic19 with an intramolecular disulfide bond binds Mic60 of MICOS (26416881)
分泌された成熟 Hsp150 は Kex2 特異的な部位で切られ 53 と 34: Secreted mature Hsp150 is cleaved at a Kex2-specific site into two subunits of 53 and 341 amino acids, which are secreted together non-covalently. It increases 7-fold upon heat shock (1570286)
分裂を終えて紡錘体を壊すとき、APC-Cdh1 が Fin1 を分解に向ける（1: When disassembling the spindle at the end of mitosis, APC-Cdh1 targets Fin1 for degradation (17173039)
分裂中期にストレスを受けると Hog1 は Net1 をリン酸化して Cdc14: When stressed in metaphase, Hog1 phosphorylates Net1, changing its affinity for Cdc14 and delaying mitotic exit. Net1 mutants that Hog1 cannot phosphorylate have reduced survival under osmotic stress (32265285). Main text: in vitro, adding Hog1 stabilizes Net1-Cdc14 binding even in the presence of Clb2-Cdc28, and phosphorylation of T62 and S385 by Hog1 prevents Cdc14 release (the statement that affinity is increased includes speculation, so confidence is medium)
分裂期 CDK は Cdc25（出芽酵母では Mih1）による Wee1 部位の: Mitotic CDK is activated by dephosphorylation of the Wee1 site by Cdc25 (Mih1 in budding yeast), and in strains retaining only Clb2, Mih1 becomes essential for mitotic entry at high temperature (23510481). In mih1Δ, mitotic Cdk1-Y19 phosphorylation increases, but toward G1, Ptp1 and PP2A-Rts1 are also involved in dephosphorylation (26715668)
分裂期に Aurora B による H3 S10 のリン酸化が Hst2 を呼び: In mitosis, H3 S10 phosphorylation by Aurora B recruits Hst2, which deacetylates H4 K16, promoting chromatin condensation (24385627)
分裂期に Clb3-Cdk1 が細胞質の Tom6 前駆体をリン酸化してミトコン: In mitosis, Clb3-Cdk1 phosphorylates the cytosolic Tom6 precursor, enhancing its import into mitochondria and promoting Tom40 channel assembly and respiratory activity (25378463). BioGRID's 21215441 is a paper on phosphorylation of the TOM complex by CK2 and PKA, and Cdc28 does not appear in its abstract
分裂期には複製開始因子の不活性化とライセンス因子の再活性化の間に時間の隔たりがあ: In mitosis, there is a time gap between inactivation of replication initiation factors and reactivation of licensing factors, whose size is determined by degradation of Sld2 (by Dma1/2) dependent on phosphorylation by CDK, DDK, Mck1 and Cdc5. Non-degradable Sld2 destabilizes the genome (27705801). Mck1 is one of several kinases, so confidence is medium
分裂期に複製の発火因子 Sld2 は CDK・DDK・Mck1・Cdc5 による: In mitosis, the replication firing factor Sld2 is degraded by Dma1/2 dependent on phosphorylation by CDK, DDK, Mck1 and Cdc5, creating a time gap between licensing and firing. Stable Sld2 mutants make the genome unstable (27705801)
分裂期に限って Nup53 が Kap121 に結合して NPC での動きを遅く: Specifically in mitosis, Nup53 binds Kap121, slowing its movement at the NPC and making it release cargo (14697200). Cargo and Nup53 compete for the same binding site (23541588)
分裂期の APC-Cdc20 基質の分解順序を生細胞で測り、セキュリンと Dbf: The order of degradation of APC-Cdc20 substrates in mitosis was measured in live cells; degradation of securin and Dbf4 is delayed by Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation near the Cdc20-binding sites (25287299). BioGRID's 14574415 is a comprehensive screen for Cdk1 substrates
分裂期の Cdc28-Clb2 の不活性化と Clb2 の分解は 2 段階で、中: Inactivation of mitotic Cdc28-Clb2 and degradation of Clb2 occur in two steps: the first, starting at the metaphase-to-anaphase transition, depends on Cdc20, and the second, in telophase, depends on Cdh1. The first step is a prerequisite for the second (10882135). BioGRID's 12574115 is an in vitro ubiquitination paper. The main degradation is the Cdh1 step, so confidence is medium
分裂期の H3 S10 のリン酸化の釣り合いは Ipl1/オーロラキナーゼとそれ: The balance of mitotic H3 S10 phosphorylation is determined by Ipl1/Aurora kinase and the genetically interacting phosphatase Glc7/PP1 (budding yeast and nematodes) (10975519). The APC controls H3 phosphorylation in the cell cycle at the level of Ipl1, and APC-induced transcription of GLC7 (the essential H3 phosphatase) maintains H3 dephosphorylation upon cell-cycle exit (14645525)
分裂期の Sld2 の分解は CDK・DDK・Mck1・Cdc5 のリン酸化とユ: Mitotic Sld2 degradation is due to phosphorylation by CDK, DDK, Mck1 and Cdc5 and the ubiquitin ligase Dma1/2 (27705801)
分裂期の初め、Sgo1 は PP2A-Rts1 を動原体周辺に呼び込み、双極付着: At the start of mitosis, Sgo1 recruits PP2A-Rts1 to pericentromeres, assisting bipolar attachment. Artificially recruiting Rts1 can substitute for Sgo1 function (25236599)
分裂期の始めの染色体凝縮は Cdk1 の活性に高い感受性を示し、その感受性は S: Chromosome condensation at the start of mitosis is highly sensitive to Cdk1 activity, a sensitivity conferred by multisite phosphorylation of Smc4. This phosphorylation couples chromatin binding of the condensation machinery to Cdk1 activity, and its loss is lethal due to segregation defects (25691469)
分裂期サイクリン Clb2 の LxF ドッキング配列は M-CDK を分裂期の: The LxF docking sequence of the mitotic cyclin Clb2 directs M-CDK to mitotic regulators, and Spo12 is phosphorylated via LxF to release Cdc14 (31101497). The main text states that phosphorylation of Spo12 by M-CDK is essential for FEAR
分裂溝の陥入の間 Rho1 は一時的に不活性化され、これには GDP 型 Rho: During furrow ingression, Rho1 is transiently inactivated, which requires Cyk3 binding to GDP-bound Rho1. Rho1 activation (or Cdc42 inactivation) promotes secondary septum formation. Cyk3 inhibits Rho1 activation ("appears") and promotes furrow ingression through the primary septum
切り詰め型 Syg1p は two-hybrid で Ste4 と結合し、gpa: Truncated Syg1p binds Ste4 in two-hybrid and suppresses the lethality and cell-cycle arrest of gpa1 loss. Overexpression of the full-length protein suppresses weakly (7592711)
切断された Spt23 の p90 はユビキチンを保ったまま膜にある相手につなが: The cleaved p90 of Spt23 remains attached, still ubiquitinated, to its membrane-bound partner, but is released by Cdc48(Ufd1/Npl4) and goes to the nucleus (11733065). Mutations in NPL4, UFD1 and CDC48 block cleavage of Mga2 and Spt23 and abolish OLE1 expression (11598205)
初期には Rrp5 が Rcl1 の rRNA への接近を妨げ、切断（両サブユニ: Early on, Rrp5 blocks Rcl1 access to rRNA, inhibiting cleavage (separation of the two subunits) (31217256)
別のクランプローダーは Rfc2-5 を共有し、大サブユニットだけ Rad24・: Alternative clamp loaders share Rfc2-5, with only the large subunit replaced by Rad24, Ctf18 or Elg1. These were purified from yeast (16793392)
動原体タンパク質 Cnn1 は Ndc80 複合体の根元にあり、KMN ネットワ: The kinetochore protein Cnn1 is at the base of the Ndc80 complex and inhibits binding between complexes of the KMN network, keeping them in a functional form. Cnn1 activity peaks in anaphase and is driven by the Cdc28, Mps1 and Ipl1 kinases (22561345). 23334295 states that N-terminal phosphorylation of Cnn1 tunes binding of two competing Ndc80 partners, but the direction is not stated
化学架橋で Oxa1 とリボソーム大サブユニットの MrpL40 が近接して結合: Chemical cross-linking showed that Oxa1 and the large ribosomal subunit protein MrpL40 are bound in proximity (19783770)
単独では活性がなく、PRS5 と PRS2 の組み合わせで活性のある PRPP: Inactive alone; the combination of PRS5 and PRS2 forms an active PRPP synthetase (15280369)
単独では活性がなく、PRS5 と PRS4 の組み合わせで活性のある PRPP: Inactive alone; the combination of PRS5 and PRS4 forms an active PRPP synthetase (15280369)
単量体 Cdc12 のゆっくりした加水分解と、一時的な Cdc12-GTP への: Slow hydrolysis by monomeric Cdc12 and the specific affinity of Cdc11 for transient Cdc12-GTP produce the Cdc11-Cdc12-Cdc3 trimer (28541184)
単離した C11 の NTD が C37/53 による Pol III の終結を: The isolated NTD of C11 promotes C37/53-mediated termination by Pol III (34625550)
厳しい条件の TAP で Nop19p は Dhr2p と Utp25p と優先: Under stringent TAP conditions, Nop19p binds preferentially to Dhr2p and Utp25p (21941128)
取り込ませた基質の分解は Pim1/LON による。hsp78Δ のミトコンドリ: Degradation of imported substrates is by Pim1/LON. Degradation efficiency decreases in hsp78Δ mitochondria (12237310)
取り込みの障害で Mix23 が大きく上がり、プロテアソームのサブユニットと同じ: Import defects greatly raise Mix23, which, like proteasome subunits, is under Rpn4 control (32826315)
受容体 Atg19 は Ape1 のプロペプチドの三量体をほどいて 2:1 の複: The receptor Atg19 unfolds the trimeric Ape1 propeptide to form a 2:1 complex, coating Ape1 aggregates and determining their size (27320913)
受容体 Atg32 は Atg11 の二量体化を促して活性化し、活性化した At: The receptor Atg32 promotes dimerization and activation of Atg11, and activated Atg11 tethers Atg9 vesicles. Increasing Atg32 activates Atg11 and promotes mitophagy (31356628). Upon mitophagy induction, Atg32 S114 and S119 are phosphorylated, mediating Atg11-Atg32 binding (21757540)
受容体に活性化されると Gα が Gβγ から離れ、Gβ がリン酸化される（23: Upon receptor activation, Gα separates from Gβγ and Gβ is phosphorylated (23613469). Ste4 mutants bind Gpa1 weakly but bind the Ste2 C-terminus normally (10664449)
古細菌の Kae1/Bud32 融合タンパク質の構造から、Kae1 との結合が: From the structure of an archaeal Kae1/Bud32 fusion protein, it was proposed that Kae1 binding keeps Bud32 inactive, and yeast Kae1 was shown to inhibit Bud32 kinase activity (19172740)
可溶型 Ubp1 の過剰発現で Ste6 が安定化し細胞表面に蓄積する。Ste6: Overexpression of soluble Ubp1 stabilizes Ste6, which accumulates at the cell surface. Ste6 ubiquitination is unchanged (15635103)
可溶型の Tim12 がまず Tim9・Tim10 と Tim12-core 複: Soluble Tim12 first forms the Tim12-core complex with Tim9 and Tim10, which then binds the membrane components of the TIM22 complex (18421298)
Soluble Tim12 first forms the Tim12-core complex with Tim9 and Tim10 (18421298)
各 β サブユニットのリングで Pup1 が Pup3 と相互作用する（9207: In each β-subunit ring, Pup1 interacts with Pup3 (9207060)
合成致死を使い、MON2 が GTP 型 ARL1[Q72L] の負の調節因子で: Using synthetic lethality, MON2 was shown to be a negative regulator of GTP-bound ARL1[Q72L] (22594927). Arl1 interacts directly with Mon2/Ysl2 (16219684)
合成酵素活性は ARG5,6 の量に依存。共沈で複合体を確認し、キナーゼ/還元酵: Synthase activity depends on the amount of ARG5,6. The complex was confirmed by coprecipitation, and Arg2 is unstable without the kinase/reductase (11553611)
同上。Rim15 → Igo1/2 ⊣ PP2A-Cdc55 で Gis1 のリ: Same as above. Rim15 → Igo1/2 ⊣ PP2A-Cdc55 maintains the phosphorylated form of Gis1 and activates transcription (23273919)
同上（3 つの上流キナーゼの 1 つ）: Same as above (one of three upstream kinases)
呼吸の機能が下がると CIT1 などの発現が RTG 制御に切り替わり、CIT1: When respiratory function declines, expression of CIT1 and others switches to RTG control, and Rtg1-Rtg3 binds the R box upstream of CIT1 (10490611)
呼吸の機能が下がると CIT1・ACO1・IDH1・IDH2 の発現が HAP: When respiratory function declines, expression of CIT1, ACO1, IDH1 and IDH2 switches from HAP to RTG1, RTG2 and RTG3 control (10490611)
呼吸の機能が落ちる・失われると CIT1・ACO1・IDH1・IDH2 の発現は: When respiratory function declines or is lost, expression of CIT1, ACO1, IDH1 and IDH2 switches from Hap2/3/4/5 to RTG1, RTG2 and RTG3 control. The R box (GTCAC) upstream of CIT1 is the Rtg1p-Rtg3p binding site (10490611)
固定したスフェロプラストから ProtA-Nic96 を精製すると Nup192: Purifying ProtA-Nic96 from fixed spheroplasts co-isolates Nup192 (10428845)
基質で誘導される Agp1 の取り込みは Rsp5 のユビキチン化の活性に依存す: Substrate-induced internalization of Agp1 depends on the ubiquitination activity of Rsp5 (33620458)
基質で還元された Dld2 は酸素とはほとんど反応せず、yETF に速やかに電子: Substrate-reduced Dld2 barely reacts with oxygen and rapidly transfers electrons to yETF (31081204)
塩とフェロモンを合わせた刺激で、Sho1 が Kss1 を介して HOG と交配: Under combined salt and pheromone stimulation, Sho1 mediates crosstalk between the HOG and mating pathways via Kss1 (39083355)
増殖中に Fks3 を発現させると、グルカン合成酵素の調節サブユニット Rho1: Expressing Fks3 during growth stabilizes Rho1, the regulatory subunit of glucan synthase, and suppresses the growth defect of fks1 temperature-sensitive strains (17158736)
変異型のホロ iso-1-cytochrome c が rho- 株で速く分解さ: SUE1 was identified as a mutation attenuating rapid degradation of mutant holo-iso-1-cytochrome c in rho- strains (RDD). Mutant levels increase in sue1 strains, and Sue1p is thought to act in degradation of abnormal cytochrome c (15123691)
変異解析で Mgr2 の TM1 が Tim23・Tim21 との会合に必須（3: Mutational analysis shows that Mgr2 TM1 is essential for association with Tim23 and Tim21 (32186971)
外のアミノ酸による AGP1 の誘導には Stp1（Stp2 ではない）が重要で: Stp1 (not Stp2) is important for AGP1 induction by external amino acids, and Stp1 and Uga35/Dal81 act synergistically through the 21 bp UAS(AA). Dal81-dependent induction remains in stp1 (15126393)
外のアミノ酸を Ssy1 が感知すると Stp1・Stp2 が切断されて核に入り: When Ssy1 senses external amino acids, Stp1 and Stp2 are cleaved and enter the nucleus to activate AGP1 and others. At low concentrations only Stp2 acts, activating AGP1 moderately (19906648)
外のアルカリ化で Rim8・Rim13・Rim20 が細胞膜に集まり、その集まり: Upon external alkalinization, Rim8, Rim13 and Rim20 gather at the plasma membrane, dependent on Rim21 (25002535)
外膜の Mcp3 は外膜の Om45 と内膜の Aim19 と結合する（3019: Outer membrane Mcp3 binds outer membrane Om45 and inner membrane Aim19 (30192984)
多コピーの DIE2 で ITR1 と INO1 の lacZ 融合遺伝子の発現: Multicopy DIE2 raises expression of ITR1 and INO1 lacZ fusion genes (7565092)
大腸菌で作った Cmk2 は Ca2+ とカルモジュリンに依存するキナーゼ活性を: Cmk2 produced in E. coli shows Ca2+- and calmodulin-dependent kinase activity (2061341). Deletion of CMK1 and CMK2 lowers the pheromone LD50, but has no effect in cmd1-6 strains with calmodulin unable to bind Ca2+ (8756641)
大腸菌で作った Dph5 が dph5 変異株の EF2 をメチル化する（150: Dph5 produced in E. coli methylates EF2 from dph5 mutants (1508200)
大腸菌で作った Gln3 が DAL3 などのプロモーター断片の UAS(NTR: Gln3 produced in E. coli binds specifically to UAS(NTR) in promoter fragments such as DAL3 (8655543)
大腸菌で作った Gln3 が GLN1 などの NCR 感受性プロモーター断片に: Gln3 produced in E. coli binds specifically to NCR-sensitive promoter fragments such as GLN1 and can activate transcription (8655543)
大腸菌で作った HSH49 は CUS1 に結合し、生体内でも N 末端 RRM: HSH49 produced in E. coli binds CUS1, and binds in vivo via its N-terminal RRM (9436903)
好気条件で TIR1 を抑えるのは一般抑制因子 Ssn6-Tup1（204027: Under aerobic conditions, TIR1 is repressed by the general repressor Ssn6-Tup1 (20402793)
娘細胞で誘導される Amn1 は Tem1 に直接結合し、標的キナーゼ Cdc1: Amn1, induced in daughter cells, binds Tem1 directly and prevents its binding to the target kinase Cdc15. Without Amn1 function, the spindle checkpoint and spindle orientation checkpoint are defective, and stopping Cdc14 in G1 is delayed (12628189). Amn1 removes Tem1 from the SPB and carries it to the nucleus, promoting Tem1 degradation as part of an SCF ubiquitin ligase. Inhibition occurs in daughter cells after cytokinesis (34518877)
定常期に ATG15 を欠くと Tgl4 が多くたまり、Tgl3・Tgl4 が脂: Lacking ATG15 in stationary phase causes Tgl4 to accumulate; Tgl3 and Tgl4 approach lipid droplets and lipolysis proceeds (26061644)
定常期に近づく細胞で液胞膜タンパク質の分解を Atg8 と Atg8 結合タンパ: In cells approaching stationary phase, Atg8 and the Atg8-binding protein Hfl1 promote degradation of vacuolar membrane proteins; the main role of Hfl1 is recruiting Atg8 to the membrane (34088313)
定常期の早期の細胞の H3 の N 末端を切る活性は prb1Δ で失われ、精製: The activity clipping the H3 N-terminus in early stationary-phase cells is lost in prb1Δ, and purified Prb1 cleaves H3 between K23 and A24 in vitro. Clipped endogenous H3 decreases in prb1Δ (24587380)
定常期やアミノ酸飢餓での N 末端ホルミル化の増加には Gcn2 が必須で、Gc: Gcn2 is essential for the increase in N-terminal formylation in stationary phase and under amino acid starvation; Gcn2 phosphorylates Fmt1 and retains it in the cytoplasm (30409808)
定量ノーザンで、YOR034C-A などは FLO11 の誘導を介してバイオフィ: By quantitative Northern blotting, YOR034C-A and others control biofilm through induction of FLO11 (25009170)
定量質量分析で Cdc14 の脱リン酸化部位 835 か所（455 タンパク質）: Quantitative mass spectrometry identified 835 Cdc14 dephosphorylation sites (455 proteins), and two were validated. Dephosphorylation of Smc4 by Cdc14 is essential for normal division (24319056). This is an individual validation within a global analysis, and the abstract does not say what changes in Smc4 (condensin) function, so confidence is medium
実験進化で得た pgm1 変異は sec53-V238M の糖鎖付加と増殖を回復: pgm1 mutations obtained by experimental evolution restore glycosylation and growth of sec53-V238M; reducing (not abolishing) Pgm1 activity compensates best (36214454)
小サブユニットの Mrp4 に付けた標識でミトリボソームを精製し、Ypl013c: Mitoribosomes were purified via a tag on the small subunit protein Mrp4, establishing Ypl013c (MrpS16) as a small subunit component (12392552)
小胞体で Vma9p と V0 サブユニットが組み立て因子 Vma21p と結合: In the ER, Vma9p and V0 subunits bind the assembly factor Vma21p (16569636)
小胞体の拡散障壁の形成に Epo1 が必要で、Epo1 は Scs2・Shs1: Formation of the ER diffusion barrier requires Epo1, which interacts with Scs2 and Shs1 (25083872)
小胞体ストレスで ATG39 の発現が上がり、そのプロモーターは Snf1 で正: ER stress raises ATG39 expression, and its promoter is positively regulated by Snf1. Snf1 exports Mig1 and Mig2 from the nucleus (32986716)
小胞体ストレスで ATG39 の発現が上がる。ATG39 のプロモーターは Sn: ER stress raises ATG39 expression. The ATG39 promoter is regulated positively by Snf1 and negatively by the transcriptional repressors Mig1 and Mig2 (32986716). Main text: Mig1 and Mig2 redundantly repress ATG39 promoter activity in the absence of stress
小胞体ストレスで Cch1-Mid1 のチャネルから Ca2+ が流入し、これが: Under ER stress, Ca2+ enters through the Cch1-Mid1 channel, activating calcineurin (14517337). The transient rise in cytosolic Ca2+ under alkaline stress is nearly lost in cells lacking Mid1 or Cch1, and responses of calcineurin-dependent promoters also stop (15299026)
小胞体ストレスで Pkc1 と Mpk1 の活性化が Cch1-Mid1 の C: Under ER stress, activation of Pkc1 and Mpk1 is required for stimulation of the Cch1-Mid1 Ca2+ channel (14517337)
小胞体ストレスで、活性化された Hac1 の助けで Tup1-Cyc8 が KA: Under ER stress, with the help of activated Hac1, Tup1-Cyc8 binds the KAR2 promoter and activates transcription (35123133)
小胞体ストレスで細胞壁の MAPK カスケードが活性化し、Pkc1 と Mpk1: ER stress activates the cell wall MAPK cascade, and activation of Pkc1 and Mpk1 is required for stimulation of the Cch1-Mid1 Ca2+ channel. Independent of known Mpk1 targets (14517337)
小胞体ストレス時に Cys4 は Sec14 と結合する（双方向の免疫沈降）（4: Under ER stress, Cys4 binds Sec14 (reciprocal immunoprecipitation) (41325883)
常に活性な Ras2 Val19 を発現させるか Bcy1 を欠くと、グルコース: Expressing constitutively active Ras2 Val19 or lacking Bcy1 strongly inhibits Hxt1 degradation under glucose starvation (24821015)
弱酸ストレスで Haa1 の標的遺伝子 9 個の転写が活性化され、そのうち TP: Under weak acid stress, transcription of nine Haa1 target genes is activated, of which TPO2, TPO3 and others are required for adaptation to weak acids (16176797)
形態形成チェックポイントで安定化した Swe1 が Cdc28 を抑制的にリン酸: Swe1 stabilized by the morphogenesis checkpoint inhibitorily phosphorylates Cdc28 and stops the cell cycle (12388757). Swe1 inhibits Cdc28 bound to Clb2 but not that bound to Clb5 (18558651). 31101497 also describes mutual inhibition of M-CDK and Swe1
形態形成チェックポイントの Hsl7 が Hos3 を出芽首に呼ぶ（250570: Hsl7 of the morphogenesis checkpoint recruits Hos3 to the bud neck (25057019)
後期に Cdc15 は両方の SPB に集まり、これは TEM1 に依存し BU: In anaphase, Cdc15 gathers at both SPBs, which depends on TEM1 and is inhibited by BUB2. Recruitment of Dbf2 to SPBs and its activation depend on TEM1 and CDC15 (11598184). Cdc15 binds Tem1 in vivo, and the binding-deficient cdc15-LF mutant cannot localize to SPBs and is temperature-sensitive (11290702). SPB localization of Tem1 promotes Tem1-Cdc15 binding and activates the MEN (39475649)
後期に Cdc55 が Cdk1-Clb2 に依存してリン酸化される。リン酸化を: In anaphase, Cdc55 is phosphorylated in a Cdk1-Clb2-dependent manner. Phosphomimetic cdc55-ED abolishes PP2A-Cdc55 activity toward Net1 and promotes Cdc14 activation (30927017). Results with phosphomimetic mutants
後期に Clb5-Cdk1 が不活性化されると Fin1 は Cdc14 に脱リ: When Clb5-Cdk1 is inactivated in anaphase, Fin1 is dephosphorylated by Cdc14 and binds the poles and microtubules of the elongating spindle, stabilizing the spindle (17173039)
後期の Cdc14 の活性化で Yen1 は核に集まり酵素として活性化される。C: Upon Cdc14 activation in anaphase, Yen1 gathers in the nucleus and is activated as an enzyme. Yen1 lacking Cdk phosphorylation is constitutively active and increases crossover-type repair (24631283)
