後期の始まりに、セパレースと Zds1 が PP2A-Cdc55 の活性を下げ、: At anaphase onset, separase and Zds1 lower PP2A-Cdc55 activity, promoting Net1 phosphorylation and Cdc14 release from the nucleolus. This is mediated by Cdk1 phosphorylation of Cdc55 (30927017)
必須の 5 つのタンパク質 Rrp4・Rrp41・Rrp42・Rrp43・Rrp: The exosome was identified as a complex of five essential proteins, Rrp4, Rrp41, Rrp42, Rrp43 and Rrp44 (Dis3) (9390555)
必須遺伝子 YDR1 と BUR6 がコードする転写抑制複合体を単離。ヒト Dr: A transcriptional repressor complex encoded by the essential genes YDR1 and BUR6 was isolated. It corresponds to human Dr1-DRAP1 (10713169)
必須遺伝子の網羅的解析でフェロモン経路の調節因子を探し、SCF(Cdc4) は: A comprehensive analysis of essential genes searched for pheromone pathway regulators: SCF(Cdc4) acts with Cdc34 at the G protein level, promotes degradation of the Gα Gpa1 in vivo, and ubiquitinates Gpa1 in vitro (20542006)
急なエタノール処理で Smc5・Smc6 が E3 の Mms21 の活性に依存: Acute ethanol treatment causes SUMOylation of Smc5 and Smc6 dependent on the activity of the E3 Mms21. It occurs in G1 and G2/M (33788582)
恒常活性型 GPA2 の効果は sch9 欠失株では見られず、GPR1/GPA2: The effect of constitutively active GPA2 is not seen in sch9 deletion strains, consistent with a model in which the GPR1/GPA2 pathway activates Sch9 (a model proposal)
恒常活性型 Gpa1(Q323L) による交配応答には Vps34 と Vps1: The mating response to constitutively active Gpa1(Q323L) requires Vps34 and Vps15. Gpa1 is on endosomes and binds Vps34 and Vps15 directly, raising PI3P production (16839886)
恒常活性型の GCN4 で ATR1 の発現が上がる（9287330）: Constitutively active GCN4 raises ATR1 expression (9287330)
恒常活性型の YAP1・GCN4 で ATR1 の発現が上がり、共通の DNA: Constitutively active YAP1 and GCN4 raise ATR1 expression, controlling it through a common DNA sequence (9287330)
成長が止まると Ifh1 は RP 遺伝子のプロモーターから離れ、長く離れたまま: When growth stops, Ifh1 leaves RP gene promoters, and Utp22 is required to keep it away for long (27818142). Depleting Utp22 or Rrp7 greatly increases RP mRNA (17452446)
抗 Erg25 抗体で Erg25 が Erg27・Erg28 と共免疫沈降する: With anti-Erg25 antibody, Erg25 coimmunoprecipitates with Erg27 and Erg28. Erg28 was proposed to be a scaffold tethering the C-4 demethylation enzymes (12119386)
抗真菌剤 NPD2560 で CRH1・KDX1・CWP1・PIR3 などの R: The antifungal NPD2560 induces Rlm1-dependent cell wall genes such as CRH1, KDX1, CWP1 and PIR3 (42233670)
持続的 DNA 損傷で SPB に呼び込まれた Cdc5 が Cnm67・Mps: Under persistent DNA damage, Cdc5 recruited to the SPB relays a phosphorylation signal to Cnm67 and Mps3, and their phosphorylation is required for checkpoint release (adaptation) (40601630)
接合フェロモンで HACS が活性化しカルシニューリンを活性化する。Kch1・K: Mating pheromone activates HACS, which activates calcineurin. Kch1 and Kch2 are required for HACS activation (23204190)

Mating pheromone activates HACS, which activates calcineurin. Kch1 and Kch2 (Prm6) are required for HACS activation, and when overexpressed they activate HACS without pheromone, dependent on extracellular K+ (23204190)
接合突起への Glc7 の集積に Afr1 が必要。AFR1 欠失では Glc7: Accumulation of Glc7 at the mating projection requires Afr1. In AFR1 deletion, Glc7 does not go to the projection (18552279)
損傷で止まった Pol II-Rad26 に Elf1 が結合した構造で、Elf: In the structure of Elf1 bound to damage-stalled Pol II-Rad26, Elf1 increases the interaction between Rad26 and Pol II. Biochemical and genetic results also support their cooperation (38194460)
損傷のないとき Rad53 は転写因子 Spt21 の S276 を抑える向きに: In the absence of damage, Rad53 phosphorylates S276 of the transcription factor Spt21 in an inhibitory direction, regulating histone levels. Mutations in this pathway increase dependence on glucose due to excess histones (32814778)
新しい ATPase Epa1（Npa3）は Pcl1 と結合し、Pcl1-Ph: The new ATPase Epa1 (Npa3) binds Pcl1 and is specifically phosphorylated by Pcl1-Pho85 (15082539)
新しい Yap1・Skn7 の結合部位が、TSA1 と CTT1 の Yap1・: New Yap1 and Skn7 binding sites mediate Yap1- and Skn7-dependent activation of TSA1 and CTT1 (16313629)
新しく合成された DIC は輸入受容体 Tom70 に結合する（目印配列は不要）: Newly synthesized DIC binds the import receptor Tom70 (no targeting sequence needed). Passage through the outer membrane requires the targeting sequence (18032784)
新しく合成された Pex15 は主に Pex19・Pex3 に依存する経路でペル: Newly synthesized Pex15 is delivered to peroxisomes mainly by a Pex19- and Pex3-dependent pathway (40344504)
新生遺伝子 MDF1（FYV5）は MATα2 と結合して富栄養培地での接合効率: The de novo gene MDF1 (FYV5) binds MATα2, lowering mating efficiency in rich medium and promoting vegetative growth (20195295)
末端の削り込みと相同組換えには DDK による活性化が要る。DDK は Mre1: End resection and homologous recombination require activation by DDK. DDK phosphorylates the Mre11 activator Sae2 and Dna2 (abstract). Main text: the mobility shift of Sae2 depends on the cell cycle and DDK, and DDK-phosphorylated Sae2 enhances Sae2-MRX endonuclease activity 2- to 3-fold (38570537)
本文: hal4Δ・hal5Δ で Mup1 の取り込みが速くなり、両キナーゼが: Main text: Mup1 internalization is faster in hal4Δ and hal5Δ, and both kinases contribute to regulating Mup1 internalization. Acutely stopping hal5AS with an inhibitor sends Mup1-GFP to the vacuole (32191698)
本文: hal4Δ・hal5Δ の単独変異体で Mup1 の液胞への局在と取り込: Main text: hal4Δ and hal5Δ single mutants show increased vacuolar localization and faster internalization of Mup1, and both kinases contribute to regulating Mup1 internalization (32191698)
本文: sit4Δ で Sec31 が過剰リン酸化され、試験管内で Sit4 が: Main text: Sec31 is hyperphosphorylated in sit4Δ, and in vitro Sit4 dephosphorylates Sec31 phosphorylated by Hrr25. Abstract: dephosphorylation allows the coat to rebind the ER
本文: sit4∆ 株ではラパマイシンで Orm がリン酸化されない。Sit4: Main text: in sit4∆ strains, Orm is not phosphorylated upon rapamycin. Sit4 is a PP2A-type phosphatase that dephosphorylates and activates Npr1 downstream of TORC1
本文の考察: Npr1 は Bul1/2 をリン酸化して阻害し、Gap1 のユビ: Main text discussion: Npr1 phosphorylates and inhibits Bul1/2, suppressing Gap1 ubiquitination and degradation
本文の考察: Orm1–Orm2 は小胞体で SPT に直接結合して阻害する: Main text discussion: Orm1–Orm2 bind and inhibit SPT directly in the ER
本文（考察）で、Tap42 はラパマイシン感受性の Tor 経路で Npr1 の: In the main text (discussion), citing prior work, it is stated that Tap42 inhibits Npr1 activity in the rapamycin-sensitive Tor pathway (10995454)
架橋と BN-PAGE で Lpe10p が Mrs2p を含むチャネル複合体と: By cross-linking and BN-PAGE, Lpe10p binds a channel complex containing Mrs2p. Coexpression gives a low conductance different from the Mrs2 channel (20653776)
染色体上の PGK 遺伝子のプロモーター活性の大部分は Rap1 結合部位を通じ: Most of the promoter activity of the chromosomal PGK gene is through the Rap1 binding site (8602150)
栄養が十分な条件で DHH1 の欠失は ATG8 などの ATG mRNA をた: Under nutrient-replete conditions, DHH1 deletion causes accumulation of ATG mRNAs such as ATG8. Dhh1 and the decapping machinery promote ATG mRNA decay and inhibit autophagy (26098573, main text)
栄養のある条件では Atg1 は凝集体・受容体・足場の Atg11 からなる複合: Under nutrient-rich conditions, Atg1 is active only within a complex of cargo aggregates, receptors and the scaffold Atg11. Purified receptor-bound aggregates and Atg11 could activate Atg1 (26166702 abstract). Main text: the pApe1-Atg19 complex controls Atg1 activity in nutrient-rich cells
栄養の多い条件では PKA が Rim11 の発現を低く保つ（38886580）: Under nutrient-rich conditions, PKA keeps Rim11 expression low (38886580). With glucose, Rim11 kinase activity is inhibited, and this nutrient signal is relayed via the cAMP/PKA pathway to Rim11 and then to Ime1 (15282298)
栄養の多い条件では TORC1 が Rim11 を細胞質に留め、PKA が Ri: Under nutrient-rich conditions, TORC1 retains Rim11 in the cytoplasm and PKA keeps Rim11 levels low. Stopping PKA and TORC1 increases Rim11 expression and nuclear localization (38886580)
栄養を戻すと Rts3 は TORC1-SCFCdc4-プロテアソームの経路で速: When nutrients are restored, Rts3 is rapidly degraded via the TORC1-SCFCdc4-proteasome pathway (41748572)
栄養制限・ストレスで Kns1 が Ckb1 のリン酸化を担う。tRNA 遺伝子: Under nutrient limitation and stress, Kns1 mediates Ckb1 phosphorylation. This correlates with reduced Ckb1 binding to tRNA genes (25631054)
核での SNF1 の活性は Std1 の粒への移動で調節され、グルコースが Vh: Nuclear SNF1 activity is regulated by movement of Std1 into puncta, which glucose regulates through Vhs1 and its substrate Sip5. Sip5 phosphorylation prevents its binding to Std1 (29249654). Vhs1 phosphorylates Sip5 in response to glucose, releasing it from Std1 (29322248)
核の JDP Apj1 は Hsf1 を標的 DNA の HSE から外すことで: The nuclear JDP Apj1 mainly controls the attenuation phase of the heat shock response by removing Hsf1 from HSEs in target DNA, and attenuation is impaired in apj1Δ (41025326)
核の Pif1 は NuA4 と Rpd3 で動的にアセチル化・脱アセチル化され: Nuclear Pif1 is dynamically acetylated and deacetylated by NuA4 and Rpd3. Acetylation enhances the toxicity of Pif1 overexpression and biochemically increases helicase, ATPase and DNA-binding activities (32878983)
核の Rio1 は rDNA の安定と分離を促す。S 期の rDNA 複製中に: Nuclear Rio1 promotes rDNA stability and segregation. During rDNA replication in S phase, it inhibits Pol I and recruits Sir2. In anaphase, it targets Rpa43 to inhibit Pol I and remove Pol I from rDNA (25851096)
核の Yap8p が ACR2・ACR3 の発現を高める。ChIP で ACR3: Nuclear Yap8p raises ACR2 and ACR3 expression. It binds the ACR3 promoter by ChIP (14978214)
核膜のタンパク質 Nur1 は Net1 と結合し、Cdk にリン酸化された形で: The nuclear envelope protein Nur1 binds Net1 and, in its Cdk-phosphorylated form, inhibits Cdc14 release. At early anaphase, Cdc14 dephosphorylates Nur1 to relieve this inhibition, forming positive feedback that promotes further Cdc14 release (25569132)
核膜孔の完全性を損なう変異や生理的な変化で Ulp1 が減り、NPC の mRN: Mutations or physiological changes impairing nuclear pore integrity reduce Ulp1, causing accumulation of SUMOylated Hek2 unable to bind NPC mRNA. Ulp1 acts as a sensor of NPC integrity and Hek2 as a repressor of NPC synthesis (29695777)
機械的ストレスで活性化された Pkc1 は Ste5 と Far1 の RING: Pkc1 activated by mechanical stress phosphorylates the RING-H2 domains of Ste5 and Far1 (in vitro; they are also phosphorylated in vivo), preventing Gβγ binding and inhibiting pheromone signaling and polarized growth (31315942). The main text concludes that RING-H2 phosphorylation inhibits Ste5 and Far1 function. Dissociation of Far1 from the membrane is described as "probably", so confidence is medium
機械的ストレスと細胞融合のとき、Pkc1 は Ste5 を接合突起から散らし、M: During mechanical stress and cell fusion, Pkc1 disperses Ste5 from the mating projection, leading to inhibition of the MAPK Fus3. In vitro, Pkc1 phosphorylates the RING-H2 domains of Ste5 and Far1 (31315942)
機能しない Dbf2 変異体が、共通の相手 Spo12 を奪って Dbf20 の: Non-functional Dbf2 mutants sequester the common partner Spo12, blocking Dbf20 function (genetic evidence) (8307336)
機能を失う変異と過剰に働く変異の両方から、PP2A の Cdc55・Tpd3 サ: Both loss-of-function and hyperactive mutations showed that the PP2A subunits Cdc55 and Tpd3 counteract activation of the 9-1-1 axis. This is because Cdc55 binds Ddc1 and prevents formation of the Ddc1-Dpb11 complex (38007689)
欠失と試験管内の再構成で Pus4 が TEF1 mRNA を修飾（253536: Deletion and in vitro reconstitution show that Pus4 modifies TEF1 mRNA (25353621)
欠失株のノーザンで YBL029W などがバイオフィルムを FLO11 の誘導を: Northern blotting of deletion strains revealed that YBL029W and others control biofilm through induction of FLO11 (25009170)
欠損株の網羅的な探索で、Rpn4 のユビキチン依存の分解に欠陥のある mub1Δ: A comprehensive search of deletion strains found mub1Δ defective in ubiquitin-dependent degradation of Rpn4, and in vitro reconstitution confirmed that Mub1 is required for Rpn4 ubiquitination (18070918)
段階的なプロモーター欠失から、YPL062W は ALD6 のコアプロモーターと: Stepwise promoter deletions show that YPL062W acts as the core promoter of ALD6 (30683746)
毒性の銅を感知する Ace1p は解毒の遺伝子 CUP1・CRS5・SOD1 の: Ace1p, which senses toxic copper, activates transcription of the detoxification genes CUP1, CRS5 and SOD1 in response to copper. CUP1 induction is fast and strong but transient, and Ace1p binding is also transient (9599102)
沈黙している FLO10 は IRA1 または IRA2 の機能喪失変異で活性化: Silent FLO10 is activated by loss-of-function mutations in IRA1 or IRA2 (15016375)
活性のある Vps15 は Vps34 の膜への呼び込みと PtdIns 3-キ: Active Vps15 is required for recruiting Vps34 to membranes and stimulating PtdIns 3-kinase activity. Loss of Vps15 function prevents Vps34 activation (7721937)
活性化された Ssk2/Ssk22 は Pbs2 だけをリン酸化する（Pbs2: Activated Ssk2/Ssk22 phosphorylate only Pbs2 (owing to the Pbs2 docking site)
活性化した Fus3 が Kss1 の活性化を抑えて混線を防ぐ（11583629: Activated Fus3 inhibits Kss1 activation, preventing crosstalk (11583629). Fus3 directly phosphorylates Ubp3, which is required to inhibit Kss1 activation (23645675). Fus3 prevents inappropriate activation of invasive growth by the pheromone pathway (9393860)
活性化した Hog1 は Hsl1 の Hsl7 結合部位の残基を直接リン酸化し: Activated Hog1 directly phosphorylates residues in the Hsl7-binding site of Hsl1, releasing Hsl7 from the septin ring so that Swe1 accumulates and cells arrest in G2. With Hsl1 that Hog1 cannot phosphorylate, Hsl7 is not released, cells do not arrest in G2 and become osmosensitive (16688223)
活性化した Hog1・Fus3・Kss1 による Ste50 のリン酸化は St: Phosphorylation of Ste50 by activated Hog1, Fus3 and Kss1 releases Ste50 from Opy2, downregulating the HOG pathway (20932477)
活性化した Rim101 が Nrg1 の抑制を介して Rsb1 の発現を誘導す: Activated Rim101 induces Rsb1 expression via repression of Nrg1 (18287536)
活性化した Rim101 が抑制因子 Nrg1 を抑えることで Rsb1 の発現: Activated Rim101 induces Rsb1 expression by repressing the repressor Nrg1 (18287536)
活性化していない Kss1 による Ste12 の抑制には Dig1 と Dig: Repression of Ste12 by non-activated Kss1 requires Dig1 and Dig2, which together with Kss1 inhibit Ste12 function at FREs (9860980)
活性化因子 Ndt80 とその標的 MSE が、mORC1 と逆向きに転写される: The activator Ndt80 and its target MSE are required for full induction of the meiotic SMA2, which is transcribed in the opposite direction from mORC1 (27362276)
活性化型 Ylr266（Pdr8）の直接の標的（マイクロアレイ・ChIP）に P: Direct targets of activated Ylr266 (Pdr8) (microarray, ChIP) include PDR15, YOR1 and AZR1 (12529331)
活性型 Arf1 との HDS1 を介した結合で Sec7 が膜に安定に呼ばれ、: HDS1-mediated binding to active Arf1 stably recruits Sec7 to membranes, and this binding mediates Sec7 localization to the TGN (22516198)
活性型 Cdc42 は Rsp5 と HSP40/HSP70 でユビキチン化され: Active Cdc42 is ubiquitinated by Rsp5 and HSP40/HSP70 and degraded by the proteasome. A non-degradable GTP-bound form hyperactivates the fMAPK pathway (36350310)
Active Cdc42 is ubiquitinated by Rsp5 and HSP40/HSP70 and degraded (36350310). Main text: Cdc42 degradation requires Rsp5, Ydj1 and Ssa1
Active Cdc42 is ubiquitinated by Rsp5 and HSP40/HSP70 and degraded (36350310). Main text: active Cdc42 is degraded by the proteasome dependent on Ydj1, Ssa1 and Rsp5
活性型 Pdr8 のトランスクリプトームと ChIP で、AZR1 などを Pd: The transcriptome and ChIP of activated Pdr8 identified AZR1 and others as direct Pdr8 targets (12529331)
活性型 Pdr8 の転写産物解析とクロマチン免疫沈降で、YJL216c を含む直: Transcript analysis and chromatin immunoprecipitation of activated Pdr8 identified direct target genes including YJL216c (12529331)
活性型 Ylr266（Pdr8）の転写解析と生体内 ChIP で直接の標的を同定: Transcriptional analysis and in vivo ChIP of activated Ylr266 (Pdr8) identified direct targets, including transporter genes such as PDR15, YOR1 and AZR1 (12529331)
活性型 Ypt1（Ypt31 ではない）が bet3ts 細胞の自食作用の欠陥を: Active Ypt1 (not Ypt31) partly rescues the autophagy defect of bet3ts cells; Bet3 acts through TRAPP mainly via Ypt1 (25581738)
活性型の upc2-1 で ERG2・ERG11 が過剰に発現する（212996: Active upc2-1 overexpresses ERG2 and ERG11 (21299653). Activation of ERG genes under iron deficiency is due to Upc2 and Ecm22 (36382795). Binding (SRE) has been shown for ERG2 (11533229)
活性酸素で Sod1 はすばやく核に移り、酸化ストレス耐性・修復の遺伝子の発現を: Upon reactive oxygen species, Sod1 rapidly moves to the nucleus and regulates expression of oxidative stress resistance and repair genes. The signal is via Mec1 and Dun1, and Dun1 binds Sod1 and phosphorylates S60 and S99. Main text: lacking DUN1 prevents Sod1 nuclear translocation (24647101)
活性酸素による Sod1 の核移行は Mec1 とその下流の Dun1 を介する: ROS-induced nuclear translocation of Sod1 is mediated by Mec1 and its downstream Dun1 (24647101)
浸透圧で誘導される PAI3 は ALD2 と同じく PBS2・HOG1 キナー: Osmotically induced PAI3, like ALD2, depends on the PBS2 and HOG1 kinases (8801420)
浸透圧ストレスで Hog1 は Mrc1 を Mec1 と別の部位でリン酸化し、: Under osmotic stress, Hog1 phosphorylates Mrc1 at sites different from Mec1, preventing Cdc45 loading and delaying origin firing and replication progression. Non-phosphorylatable mrc1(3A) does not delay replication, and transcription-associated recombination and genomic instability increase (PMID 23178807)
浸透圧ストレスで Hog1 は Whi5 と Msa1 に結合してリン酸化し、そ: Under osmotic stress, Hog1 binds and phosphorylates Whi5 and Msa1, and this phosphorylation is essential for repressing G1 cyclin expression (25733686). Whi5 is a repressor of G1/S transcription, so this is the direction strengthening its function
浸透圧ストレスで Hog1 は核膜孔複合体と結合し、内側のバスケットの Nup1: Under osmotic stress, Hog1 binds the nuclear pore complex and directly phosphorylates Nup1, Nup2 and Nup60 of the inner basket. Nup1 and others bind stress response gene promoters in a Hog1-dependent manner under stress, and non-phosphorylatable Nup1 mutants lower stress response gene expression (23645671). The sites were determined in vitro, and in vivo phosphorylation was hard to confirm by mass spectrometry, so confidence is medium
浸透圧ストレスで Hog1 は細胞膜の Nha1 と Tok1 をリン酸化する。: Under osmotic stress, Hog1 phosphorylates the plasma membrane proteins Nha1 and Tok1. Hog1 phosphorylation increases Nha1 activity and is essential for rapid rebinding of proteins to chromatin (15294160)
浸透圧ストレスで Rck2 は Hog1 に依存して体内でリン酸化され、Hog1: Under osmotic stress, Rck2 is phosphorylated in vivo dependent on Hog1, and Hog1 phosphorylates S519 in the autoinhibitory region, raising Rck2 kinase activity (10805732). Hog1 directly phosphorylates Rck2, enhancing its activity toward eEF2, and Rck2 phosphorylation rises transiently under osmotic stress (11344302). Consistent with the UniProt direction
浸透圧ストレスでは RTG 依存の遺伝子が Hog1 に依存して誘導され、Rtg: Under osmotic stress, RTG-dependent genes are induced in a Hog1-dependent manner, and Hog1 is required for nuclear accumulation of the Rtg1/3 complex. Hog1 also regulates chromatin binding and transcriptional activity of Rtg1/3 (22956768)
浸透圧ストレスでリン酸化された Hog1 は速く一過性に核へ移る。この取り込みに: Under osmotic stress, phosphorylated Hog1 moves rapidly and transiently to the nucleus. This import requires Ran-Gsp1 and Nmd5 (9755161)
浸透圧ストレスで活性化した Hog1 が細胞膜の Nha1 と Tok1 をリン: Hog1 activated by osmotic stress phosphorylates the plasma membrane proteins Nha1 and Tok1 (15294160)
浸透圧センサー Hkr1 の細胞質ドメインは Ste20 による Ste11 の: The cytoplasmic domain of the osmosensor Hkr1 contributes to activation of Ste11 by Ste20. Independent of Bem1 and actin (24570489)
液体培地でのバイオフィルム形成に要る遺伝子のうち、YBL029C-A を含む 3: Northern blotting showed that, among genes required for biofilm formation in liquid medium, 37 including YBL029C-A act via induction of FLO11 (25009170)
液胞が芽の皮質に着くと Cla4 が Vac17 をリン酸化し、それが Vac1: When the vacuole arrives at the bud cortex, Cla4 phosphorylates Vac17, which is required for Vac17 ubiquitination and degradation and release of the vacuole from Myo2. Main text: Cla4 directly phosphorylates Vac17 S222, and Ste20 partly substitutes for Cla4 (28495836)
液胞では Vps41 の ALPS モチーフが Yck3 にリン酸化され、Apl: At the vacuole, the ALPS motif of Vps41 is phosphorylated by Yck3, exposing the Apl5 binding site so that AP-3 vesicles bind and fuse (21079247)
液胞に運ばれた Aut5（Atg15）の分解はプロテイナーゼ A に依存する（パ: Degradation of Aut5 (Atg15) delivered to the vacuole depends on proteinase A (pulse-chase). In pep4 deletion, it remains in intravacuolar vesicles (11566994)
液胞のプロテイナーゼの前駆体成熟による活性化は Pep4（PrA）で始まり、pe: Activation of vacuolar proteinases by precursor maturation begins with Pep4 (PrA), and inactive precursors accumulate in pep4 loss (7628461)
液胞タンパク質の選別受容体 Vps10 の内腔ドメイン 2 に、アミノペプチダー: Aminopeptidase Y (APE3) binds as a ligand to lumenal domain 2 of the vacuolar protein sorting receptor Vps10 (10095782)
液胞膜の Rho1 と eEF1A（TEF1・TEF2）が C 末端の部分で結合: Vacuolar membrane Rho1 and eEF1A (TEF1, TEF2) bind via their C-terminal regions, mainly when both are GDP-bound. eEF1A is a non-canonical downstream effector of Rho1 (25561732)
減数分裂での Sic1 の分解と Clb5 キナーゼの活性化に Ime2 が必要: Ime2 is required for Sic1 degradation and Clb5 kinase activation in meiosis (9743499). Ime2 phosphorylates Sic1 at multiple PXS/T sites in vitro, but this phosphorylated Sic1 does not bind SCF-Cdc4, and expressing Ime2 in G1 haploids does not degrade Sic1. Ime2 is necessary but not sufficient for Sic1 degradation (16776651). 17137646 also states that Ime2 is not a simple substitute for G1 cyclin-CDK. That Ime2 reduces Sic1 is clear, but whether this occurs through direct phosphorylation is unknown, so confidence is low
減数分裂では Sic1 の分解を Ime2 が担う。Cak1 は Ime2 の活: In meiosis, Sic1 degradation is mediated by Ime2. Cak1 activates Ime2 by a mechanism requiring T242 and Y244 of the Ime2 activation loop, promoting autophosphorylation and accumulation of multiply phosphorylated forms. cak1 cells are defective in Sic1 degradation, partly suppressed by IME2 overexpression (14612412)
減数分裂では腕の接着は Rec8 による。2 つの部位のどちらかで Rec8 が: In meiosis, arm cohesion is due to Rec8. Cleavage of Rec8 by separase at either of two sites is required for chiasma resolution and homolog segregation (11081626)
減数分裂でミトコンドリアが細胞膜から離れるのは、つなぎ役の MECA が計画的に: Mitochondria detach from the plasma membrane in meiosis because the tether MECA is programmatically destroyed. Ndt80 activates Ime2, and MECA is phosphorylated and degraded in an Ime2-dependent manner. Ime2 phosphorylates both MECA subunits in vitro, and Num1 is phosphorylated in vivo in an Ime2-dependent manner. Merely enhancing Ime2 in prophase I causes early Num1 degradation (30538140)
減数分裂に入るには Ime1 と Ime2 が必要。Ime1 は転写活性化因子で: Meiotic entry requires Ime1 and Ime2. Ime1 is a transcriptional activator required for IME2 transcription. Ime2 destabilizes Ime1 (11884593)
減数分裂に特有の Cdk1・Ime2・Cdc7 による Sum1 のリン酸化は: Meiosis-specific phosphorylation of Sum1 by Cdk1, Ime2 and Cdc7 is required for NDT80 expression, and the Cdk1 and Ime2 sites appear to prime Sum1 for Cdc7 phosphorylation. The phosphorylation sites are required for removing Sum1 from the NDT80 promoter (24710277)
減数分裂の DSB で H3 T11 がリン酸化され、それには Mek1 が要り: At meiotic DSBs, H3 T11 is phosphorylated, which requires Mek1 and rapidly reverts when Mek1 is inactivated. Mek1 also phosphorylates it directly in vitro (28986445)
At meiotic DSBs, H3 T11 is phosphorylated, which requires Mek1, and Mek1 also phosphorylates it directly in vitro (28986445)
減数分裂の DSB 形成に伴い Tel1/Mec1 が Rec114 をリン酸化: With meiotic DSB formation, Tel1/Mec1 phosphorylate Rec114 and reduce its function. Mimicking constitutive phosphorylation reduces Rec114 binding to DSB hotspots and reduces or delays DSBs, while non-phosphorylatable rec114 increases DSBs and binding genome-wide (23825959). Mec1 immunoprecipitates phosphorylate Rec114 in vitro (main text)
減数分裂の M 期で Ime2 は Ndt80 を活性化し、Ndt80 は高い: In meiotic M phase, Ime2 activates Ndt80, and Ndt80 is required for high Cdc28 activity (12783856)
減数分裂の M 期に Ime2 の活性が上がり、それは Cdc28 と Ndt8: In meiotic M phase, Ime2 activity rises, depending on Cdc28 and Ndt80 (12783856)
減数分裂の S 期と前期に Mnd2 が APC/C の Ama1 による活性化: In meiotic S phase and prophase, Mnd2 prevents activation of the APC/C by Ama1. In vitro, Mnd2 inhibits Pds1 ubiquitination by APC/C-Ama1 (15797379)
減数分裂の mRNA メチル化の正常な量には Ime4 の触媒ドメインと、Ime: Normal levels of meiotic mRNA methylation require the Ime4 catalytic domain and the Ime4-binding proteins Mum2 and Slz1 (22685417)
減数分裂のパキテン期チェックポイントで Mek1 は活性化して Red1 をリン: At the meiotic pachytene checkpoint, Mek1 is activated and phosphorylates Red1. Glc7 antagonizes Mek1 activity and checkpoint arrest (10786836). Whether it directly dephosphorylates Mek1 is not stated
減数分裂の初めに Ume6 は APC/C-Cdc20 で分解される。Cdc20: At the start of meiosis, Ume6 is degraded by APC/C-Cdc20. Cdc20 and Ume6 bind in vivo, and APC/C-Cdc20 ubiquitinates Ume6 in vitro. Inactivating Cdc20 or stable Ume6 blocks meiotic gene transcription and progression (17889668)
減数分裂の前期に Ndc80 は APC-Ama1 とプロテアソームで分解され、: In meiotic prophase, Ndc80 is degraded by APC-Ama1 and the proteasome, which requires Aurora B (Ipl1)-dependent phosphorylation of Ndc80. Failure to degrade it makes chromosome missegregation likely (31919192). Phosphorylation of Ndc80 by Ipl1 weakens microtubule binding in vitro, but this phosphorylation is not essential in vivo (19822728). Its role in mitosis is limited, so confidence is medium
減数分裂の後期 I・II に Cdc14 が核小体から細胞質に出て Atg13: In meiotic anaphase I and II, Cdc14 exits the nucleolus to the cytoplasm and dephosphorylates Atg13, enhancing Atg1 kinase activity and autophagy. This supports meiotic progression and sporulation (35238874)
減数分裂の細胞で Spp1 は Mer2 と複合体をつくり、Spp1-Mer2: In meiotic cells, Spp1 forms a complex with Mer2, and Spp1-Mer2 binding is required for initiation of meiotic recombination (29444071)
減数分裂の細胞では Ndt80 がなくても Sum1 が中期のプロモーターから外: In meiotic cells, Sum1 leaves middle promoters even without Ndt80, which requires Sum1 phosphorylation by Ime2 (19528232). sum1 site mutants insensitive to either Cdk1 or Ime2 sporulate, but sum1-ci, insensitive to both, arrests in prophase. Cdk1 and Ime2 inhibit the Sum1 repressor complex to allow exit from meiotic prophase (20385771)
減数分裂の細胞は第一分裂と第二分裂の間でヘリカーゼの装填と活性化を両方抑えて D: Meiotic cells prevent DNA replication between meiosis I and II by inhibiting both helicase loading and activation. CDK and Ime2 cooperate to inhibit loading, and Ime2 has two new inhibitory mechanisms (29388912). The main text shows that Ime2 phosphorylates the Cdc6 degradation domain in vitro, and that Ime2 plays a larger role than CDK in inhibiting Cdc6 between meiosis I and II. This includes transcriptional repression, so confidence is medium
減数分裂の終わりに Ama1 は APC/C-Cdc20 の基質として分解され（: At the end of meiosis, Ama1 is degraded as a substrate of APC/C-Cdc20 (not APC/C-Cdh1); Cdc20 binds Ama1 in vivo, and APC/C-Cdc20 ubiquitinates Ama1 in vitro. The D-box and GxEN are required. Ama1 and Cdc20 direct each other's degradation, shutting off the APC/C (23816140)
減数分裂の組換えは Rad51・Dmc1 とヘテロ二量体 Mnd1/Hop2 に: Meiotic recombination depends on Rad51, Dmc1 and the Mnd1/Hop2 heterodimer (16581767)
減数分裂への移行は飢餓で AC/PK 経路が調節する。AC/PK 経路の CDC: The transition to meiosis is regulated by the AC/PK pathway under starvation. Mutations in the AC/PK pathway genes CDC25, CYR1 and BCY1 change IME1 transcript levels, and adding cAMP to cyr1-2 diploids represses IME1 transcription (2209544)
減数分裂前期の中期以降、Zip1 は染色体上の Zip3 依存の Smt3 結合: From mid meiotic prophase onward, Zip1 binds chromosomal Zip3-dependent Smt3 conjugates (such as Red1) to form the SC (16847351)
減数分裂期特異的キナーゼ Mek1 は Rad51 の相手 Rad54 の T1: The meiosis-specific kinase Mek1 phosphorylates T132 of Rad54, a Rad51 partner, weakening Rad51-Rad54 complex formation and inhibiting Rad51 function. A negative charge at T132 lowers Rad51 function both in vitro and in cells, and Rad54 is more active in T132A (19917248)
減数分裂特有の転写因子 Ndt80 は Rec114 の分解に寄与し、DSB 形: The meiosis-specific transcription factor Ndt80 contributes to Rec114 degradation and is required for complete cessation of DSB formation (23825959)
減数分裂特異的 MAPK の Smk1 は T-X-Y 活性化モチーフの T を: The meiosis-specific MAPK Smk1 is phosphorylated by Cak1 on the T of its T-X-Y activation motif, and the Y undergoes Ssp2-dependent autophosphorylation. The pT form has low activity and the pT/pY form high activity (23207907). Smk1 is phosphorylated in the activation loop and is not activated in cak1 missense mutants. Independent of Cdc28 (11739722)
減数分裂特異的な RNA 結合タンパク質 Rim4 は CLB3 の 5' UT: The meiosis-specific RNA-binding protein Rim4 binds the CLB3 5' UTR and represses CLB3 translation during meiosis I. At the start of meiosis II, Ime2 activity rises, Rim4 decreases, and translational repression is relieved (24115771)
減数分裂特異的セプチンを両方含む安定な複合体は Spr28-Spr3-Cdc3-: The stable complex containing both meiosis-specific septins is the octamer Spr28-Spr3-Cdc3-Cdc10-Cdc10-Cdc3-Spr3-Spr28 (26929450)
減数第一分裂で Mus81-Mms4 は Cdc5 によるリン酸化で強く活性化さ: In meiosis I, Mus81-Mms4 is strongly activated by Cdc5 phosphorylation and generates crossovers (21962513). Cdc5 enhances the cleavage activity of Mus81-Mms4 on 3′ flaps and Holliday junctions in vitro (22645308). 28096179 states that phosphorylation by CDK, Cdc5 and DDK is required for mitotic activation of Mus81
減数第一前期に Ndc80 は分解され、それは APC-Ama1 とプロテアソー: In meiotic prophase I, Ndc80 is degraded, dependent on APC-Ama1 and the proteasome (requiring Ipl1 phosphorylation) (31919192)
減数第一前期の終わりに Cdc5 は Swe1 の分解と Mih1 の核移行を促: At the end of meiotic prophase I, Cdc5 promotes Swe1 degradation and Mih1 nuclear translocation, activating Cdk1 (41927924). The main text suggests Cdc5 does not phosphorylate Mih1 directly and discusses whether it activates a phosphatase that promotes Mih1 nuclear translocation. The abstracts of BioGRID's 18022565 and 18316413 do not describe effects of Mih1 phosphorylation by Cdc5. This is a meiosis-only finding, so confidence is low
減数第二分裂で APC-Cdc20 が Sgo1 と Mps1 を分解し、動原体: In meiosis II, APC-Cdc20 degrades Sgo1 and Mps1, removing PP2A from kinetochores and relieving Rec8 protection (28514186)
減数第二分裂で APC/C-Cdc20 が Sgo1 と Mps1 を分解に導き: In meiosis II, APC/C-Cdc20 targets Sgo1 and Mps1 for degradation, removing PP2A from kinetochores and relieving Rec8 protection (28514186). In mitosis too, Sgo1 is an APC/C substrate degraded via a C-terminal D-box-like motif, but its removal from chromosomes before anaphase does not depend on degradation (25236599; the abstract does not specify Cdc20, and the BioGRID note says APC/C)
減数第二分裂の完了後、Isc10 は Ama1 に依存してユビキチン化・分解され: After completion of meiosis II, Isc10 is ubiquitinated and degraded in an Ama1-dependent manner, and Smk1 is activated by Ssp2 (32423992)
減数第二分裂を抜けるとき Cdc20 は APC-Ama1 で分解され、Ama1: On exit from meiosis II, Cdc20 is degraded by APC-Ama1, and Ama1 is degraded by APC-Cdc20 (23816140)
温度感受性の nup192-15 は核への取り込み・mRNA の搬出は正常だが、: Temperature-sensitive nup192-15 has normal nuclear import and mRNA export, but association of Nup49-GFP with nuclear pores is blocked at the restrictive temperature (10428845)
溜まった分泌小胞の多くは被覆が外れているが、SWA2 欠失でクラスリン被覆が一部: Most accumulated secretory vesicles are uncoated, but SWA2 deletion partly stabilizes clathrin coats (12372257)
熱で膜が伸びると Mid2 を介して Ssa1 の T492 がすばやくリン酸化: When heat stretches the membrane, Ssa1 T492 is rapidly phosphorylated via Mid2, regulating many processes including translational pausing, HSF activity, MAPK and stress granules (41390490). Main text: Pkc1 directly phosphorylates Ssa1 T492 (Bck1, Mkk1/2 and Mpk1 are not required), and this phosphorylation weakens Ssa1-Hsf1 binding and is required for heat-induced Hsf1 release. It is not an effect on Ssa1's overall chaperone function, so confidence is medium
熱による膜ストレスで、Tcb タンパク質がホスファチジルセリンの効果分子 Pkc: Under heat-induced membrane stress, Tcb proteins control plasma membrane localization of Pkc1, a phosphatidylserine effector (35440494)
熱ショックで PTP2 の転写が Mpk1 に依存して増える（PTP3 は増えな: Heat shock increases PTP2 transcription in an Mpk1-dependent manner (PTP3 does not increase). Ptp2 is thought to act as negative feedback inactivating Mpk1 (10523653)
熱ショックで YJR003C の抑制を MPP10 の抑制と連動させるのに Sp: Spt20, Snf2 and Chd1 are required to couple repression of YJR003C to repression of MPP10 upon heat shock (24706020)
熱ショックと弱酸に慣らした細胞で、hsp30 変異体と野生型の H+-ATPas: Comparing H+-ATPase activity of hsp30 mutants and wild type in cells adapted to heat shock and weak acid showed that Hsp30 induction lowers stress-induced H+-ATPase activation (9250391). In heat-shocked cells, Hsp30 lowers the Vmax of the H+-ATPase, an effect lost with deletion of the Pma1 C-terminus or mutation of T912 (9414109)
熱ショックによる PDR5 の速い一過性の誘導は yap1 yap2 の二重破壊: The rapid, transient induction of PDR5 by heat shock is very low in yap1 yap2 double disruptants and is mediated by yAP proteins (8821655)
熱ストレスで Tpk3 は細胞質の顆粒に可逆的に隔離されて不活性化し、この顆粒の: Under heat stress, Tpk3 is reversibly sequestered into cytoplasmic granules and inactivated, and formation of these granules requires Hsp42 (38865242)
熱ストレスで Tps2 の活性が上がるが tps3 変異体では上がらない。Tps: Heat stress raises Tps2 activity, but not in tps3 mutants. Tps3 is thought to be an activator of Tps2 (24380875)
生体内で Atx1 と Ccc2 の M1・M2 ドメインとの相互作用が Ccc: In vivo, interaction of Atx1 with the M1 and M2 domains of Ccc2 activates Ccc2 (19678841). Atx1 carries copper in the cytoplasm from cell-surface Ctr1 to Ccc2 and then to Fet3 (9083054)
生体内で Hmt1 にメチル化される 11 個のタンパク質のうち 3 つが Ga: Of 11 proteins methylated by Hmt1 in vivo, three were confirmed as Gar1, Nop1 and Nsr1 (12756332)
生体内で She4p は Myo3p・Myo4p・Myo5p の働きと局在に必要: In vivo, She4p is required for the function and localization of Myo3p, Myo4p and Myo5p (not Myo2p) (12725728)
生体内でも試験管内でも Mpt5 による HO の脱アデニル化に Pop2 と: Both in vivo and in vitro, deadenylation of HO by Mpt5 requires Pop2 and Ccr4; Ccr4 enzymatic activity is essential, while Pop2 activity is not. Pop2 is the bridge by which PUF recruits Ccr4 to target mRNAs, promoting deadenylation (17090538)
生体内の CTP 合成酵素のリン酸化は Pkc1 に依存し、試験管内では Pkc: In vivo phosphorylation of CTP synthetase depends on Pkc1, and in vitro phosphorylation by Pkc1 triples its activity (8626655). Changing the PKC sites S36, S354 and S454 to alanine reduces cellular activity and CTP, while S330A conversely increases them (12670958)
生体内のスクリーニングで HXT11・HXT9 が Pdr1・Pdr3 の標的と: An in vivo screen found HXT11 and HXT9 as targets of Pdr1 and Pdr3, which transcriptionally control them (9271421)
生体内のスクリーニングで HXT11・HXT9 を Pdr1・Pdr3 の新しい: An in vivo screen isolated HXT11 and HXT9 as new targets of Pdr1 and Pdr3. They are transcriptionally controlled (9271421)
生体内の光架橋で Tom7 は膜貫通部分で Tom40 と直接結合し、Mdm10: By in vivo photo-cross-linking, Tom7 binds Tom40 directly via its transmembrane segment and also binds Mdm10 (21036907)
生体内の再構成で Atg23 は Atg9 周辺構造の形成に働き、Atg9 の: In in vivo reconstitution, Atg23 acts in forming Atg9 peripheral structures and is required for Atg9 transport to the PAS (25385507)
生体内の部位特異的架橋と遺伝学で、Tim44 の両ドメインが Tim23 のマト: By in vivo site-specific cross-linking and genetics, both domains of Tim44 bind the matrix-side loop of Tim23, and the C-terminal domain also binds Tim17 (28440746)
生化学と遺伝学の解析で Alg1 を含む 2 つの複合体を同定。一方は Alg2: Biochemical and genetic analysis identified two complexes containing Alg1, one with Alg2 and the other with Alg11 (15044395)
生細胞で APC/C-Cdc20 の基質の分解を測ると、Clb5 が先に、6 分: Measuring degradation of APC/C-Cdc20 substrates in live cells, Clb5 is degraded first, and securin and Dbf4 6 minutes later. Degradation of securin and Dbf4 is delayed by Cdk1 phosphorylation near the Cdc20-binding sites (25287299). 10594027 also states that Dbf4 is degraded in an APC-dependent manner at chromosome segregation (G1 degradation is APC-dependent, but the cofactor is not specified in the abstract). The abstract only treats Dbf4 as an APC/C-Cdc20 substrate, so confidence is medium
生細胞で Mlh1-Pms1 の核内の点の形成は Msh2-Msh6 に依存する: In live cells, formation of nuclear Mlh1-Pms1 foci depends on Msh2-Msh6 (22118461). In a reconstituted system, activation of the Mlh1-Pms1 endonuclease and mismatch repair require mismatch recognition by Msh2-Msh6 and recruitment of Mlh1-Pms1 (26170454)
生細胞の 1 分子追跡で、Yaf9 の YEATS が SWR1 のクロマチンか: Single-molecule tracking in live cells shows that the Yaf9 YEATS domain slows dissociation of SWR1 from chromatin (Bdf1 promotes binding) (40768570)
発酵ストレス応答の Igd1（Yfr017c）は Gdb1 と特異的に結合し、試: Igd1 (Yfr017c) of the fermentation stress response binds Gdb1 specifically and inhibits Gdb1 activity in vitro. Deletion strains cannot store sufficient glycogen during aerobic growth and fermentation, and the authors propose that Igd1 acts as a Gdb1 inhibitor (21585652). Consistent with the UniProt direction
発酵条件で Puf3 は Pop2 と分解装置を結合 mRNA に呼び寄せて速く: Under fermentative conditions, Puf3 recruits Pop2 and the decay machinery to bound mRNAs for rapid decay; under respiratory conditions, Puf3-Yak1 binding increases, and Yak1 phosphorylates Pop2, reducing Puf3-Pop2 binding and stabilizing target mRNAs (37060252)
相互のタンデムアフィニティー精製で、Msl5 は生体内で Mud2 とヘテロ二量: By reciprocal tandem affinity purification, Msl5 forms a heterodimer with Mud2 in vivo and binds the U1 snRNP (22287628)
窒素が十分なとき TorC1 がリン酸化 Tap42–PP2A 複合体を抑える（: When nitrogen is sufficient, TorC1 inhibits the phosphorylated Tap42–PP2A complex (31213504). Phosphorylated Tap42 binds the PP2A catalytic subunit (10329624). The direction is disputed (see the note on TAP42 ⊣ SIT4)
窒素が尽きると URS1 の抑制が外れ、Ume6 がアルギニン依存で CAR1・: When nitrogen is exhausted, URS1 repression is relieved and Ume6 binds ArgRI and ArgRII, which activate CAR1 and CAR2 in an arginine-dependent manner (10809695)
窒素の制限で Ume6 の N 末端の GSK3 部位のリン酸化が体内で増える。: Nitrogen limitation increases in vivo phosphorylation of the GSK3 sites at the Ume6 N-terminus. Mutating these sites reduces Ume6-Ime1 binding and meiotic gene expression. Phosphorylation depends on the two GSK3s Rim11 and Mck1, and in rim11-K68R meiosis depends entirely on Mck1 (10891485)
窒素源の乏しいとき Bul は Npr1 に依存してリン酸化され、Gap1 を分: When nitrogen sources are poor, Bul is phosphorylated in an Npr1-dependent manner and bound to 14-3-3, which protects Gap1 from degradation. Adding ammonium dephosphorylates Bul, releasing it from inhibitory 14-3-3 and allowing its ubiquitination (22966204)
窒素飢餓 1 時間で PAT1 の欠失により ATG1・ATG2・ATG7・AT: After 1 hour of nitrogen starvation, PAT1 deletion greatly reduces ATG1, ATG2, ATG7 and ATG9 mRNAs (30527663, main text)
窒素飢餓で Eap1 は Dhh1 と結合し、Atg1 と Atg13 の翻訳を: Under nitrogen starvation, Eap1 binds Dhh1 and assists translation of Atg1 and Atg13. Dhh1 raises translation of ATG1 and ATG13 mRNAs dependent on a structured region just after the start codon (30973873)
窒素飢餓で Gln3/Gat1 により誘導された Rts3 は、栄養を戻すと T: Rts3, induced by Gln3/Gat1 under nitrogen starvation, is rapidly degraded via the TORC1-SCFCdc4-proteasome pathway when nutrients are restored (41748572)
窒素飢餓で Hrr25 が受容体 Atg34 をリン酸化し、Ams1 との結合は: Under nitrogen starvation, Hrr25 phosphorylates the receptor Atg34, promoting its binding to Atg11 without changing binding to Ams1 and activating Ams1 transport to the vacuole (25281559). Like Atg19, Atg34 is also controlled by Hrr25 (24968893)
窒素飢餓で Lap3 は液胞へ選択的に運ばれ、その輸送に ATG11・ATG19: Under nitrogen starvation, Lap3 is selectively transported to the vacuole, and ATG11 and ATG19 are important for this transport (19061865)
窒素飢餓で Pat1 は ATG1 mRNA の蓄積と Atg1 タンパク質の発: Under nitrogen starvation, Pat1 is required for ATG1 mRNA accumulation and Atg1 protein expression, and the ATG1 3′ UTR is important for this regulation (30527663, main text)
窒素飢餓で Rim15 は Rph1 をリン酸化させ、Rph1 の働きを抑える。: Under nitrogen starvation, Rim15 causes Rph1 phosphorylation and inhibits Rph1 function. Preventing phosphorylation stops autophagy induction (25660547). With rapamycin, Rim15 phosphorylates Rph1, and phosphomimetic Rph1 leaves ribosomal genes (32619236)
窒素飢餓で Tps2 は Rim15 を 14-3-3（Bmh1/2）から離して: Under nitrogen starvation, Tps2 releases Rim15 from 14-3-3 (Bmh1/2), promoting its nuclear translocation and activation. Rim15 is a negative regulator of Ume6, and in tps2Δ Ume6 is dephosphorylated and represses ATG8 transcription (32240040)
窒素飢餓で複合体 I の Vps34 は Atg1 に依存してリン酸化され、これ: Under nitrogen starvation, Vps34 of complex I is phosphorylated in an Atg1-dependent manner, which is required for full autophagy activation and survival. Atg1 directly phosphorylates Vps34 in vitro (36803233)
窒素飢餓や TORC1 の直接の阻害で Rpc82 などがすぐ脱 SUMO 化さ: Upon nitrogen starvation or direct TORC1 inhibition, Rpc82 and others are rapidly deSUMOylated; TORC1-dependent SUMOylation of Rpc82 is required for RNAPIII assembly and tRNA transcription (28096404)
窒素飢餓後 lsm1Δ では Atg1・Atg9 のタンパク質量が野生型ほど上が: After nitrogen starvation, Atg1 and Atg9 protein levels in lsm1Δ do not rise as much as in wild type (30527663, main text)
第 1 段階後に強く結合した Cwc25 はスプライソソームから外され、それには: Cwc25, tightly bound after the first step, is released from the spliceosome, which requires Prp16 and ATP hydrolysis (28057857)
第 VIII 染色体左腕の SACE の ATF/CREB 部位が COS8 プ: The ATF/CREB site of SACE on the left arm of chromosome VIII acts as a UAS/URS of the COS8 promoter, mediated by Sko1p, Aca1p and Aca2p (12051917)
第二分裂で Hrr25（CK1δ）は Rec8 をリン酸化し、同時にシュゴシンと: In meiosis II, Hrr25 (CK1δ) phosphorylates Rec8 and simultaneously removes the cohesin protector of shugoshin and PP2A from kinetochores, preparing kinetochore cohesin for cleavage by separase (28017619)
精製 Apc11 は試験管内で E1・E2 依存に Clb2 などをユビキチン化: Purified Apc11 ubiquitinates Clb2 and others in vitro in an E1- and E2-dependent manner, requiring the RING-H2 (10888670)
精製 Bil1 は Bud6 の調節配列に結合し、Bud6 の Bnr1 への: Purified Bil1 binds the regulatory sequence of Bud6 and triggers Bud6's NPF activity on Bnr1 (23671312)
精製 Gdi1 は Sec4 からの GDP の解離を遅くし、GDP 型を膜から: Purified Gdi1 slows GDP dissociation from Sec4 and extracts the GDP-bound form from membranes. Depleting Gdi1 in vivo causes loss of cytosolic Sec4, and secretion stops at multiple steps (8157010)
精製した Ilv6 が Ilv2 の触媒活性を最大 7 倍に高め、バリン阻害の感: Purified Ilv6 enhances Ilv2 catalytic activity up to 7-fold and confers sensitivity to valine inhibition (10213630)
精製した Msb4（Gyp4）は Ypt/Rab 特異的な GAP で、主に S: Purified Msb4 (Gyp4) is a Ypt/Rab-specific GAP acting mainly on Sec4, Ypt6 and Ypt7 (10937877)
精製した Scp1 は F アクチンに直接結合し、繊維を架橋して脱重合から安定化: Purified Scp1 binds F-actin directly, cross-links filaments and stabilizes them against depolymerization (12857851)
精製した Ste11・Ste7・Fus3 で MAPK カスケードを再構成し、S: The MAPK cascade was reconstituted with purified Ste11, Ste7 and Fus3: Ste11 phosphorylates and activates Ste7, and Ste7 phosphorylates Fus3. The Ste11-dependent phosphorylation sites of Ste7 are required for Ste7 activity (8159759)
精製した TFIID は TBP と 14 種の TAF からなり、新しい TA: Purified TFIID consists of TBP and 14 TAFs, including the new TAF65p (TAF8) and TAF48p. Neither is part of SAGA (10788514)
精製した Vts1 が Dna2 のエンドヌクレアーゼ活性を高める（Dna2 の: Purified Vts1 enhances Dna2 endonuclease activity (the Dna2 N-terminus is required). VTS1 suppresses dna2-K1080E (20007605)
精製した pre-40S 粒子で Nob1 による 20S pre-rRNA の: In purified pre-40S particles, cleavage of 20S pre-rRNA by Nob1 is strongly stimulated by the GTPase activity of Fun12 (22751017)
精製したセラミド合成酵素に新しいサブユニット Lip1 があり、生体内・試験管内: Purified ceramide synthase contains a new subunit, Lip1, which is required for ceramide synthesis in vivo and in vitro (15692566)
精製した複合体は TRP2 と TRP3 の産物の 2 つのサブユニットからなる: The purified complex consists of two subunits, the products of TRP2 and TRP3 (3881257)
精製した酵母 SRP に Srp14p・Srp68p・Srp72p が含まれ、こ: Purified yeast SRP contains Srp14p, Srp68p and Srp72p; lacking any of these reduces SRP RNA and proteins (7925282)
精製した酵母 SRP に Srp14・Srp68・Srp72・Srp21 が含ま: Purified yeast SRP contains Srp14, Srp68, Srp72 and Srp21; lacking Srp14 or others reduces SRP components (7925282)
精製タンパク質で再構成した複製で、Mrc1 は CMG ヘリカーゼの巻き戻しを速: In replication reconstituted with purified proteins, Mrc1 speeds unwinding by the CMG helicase, and Rad53 phosphorylation of Mrc1 prevents this, slowing forks. Phosphomimetic Mrc1 cannot promote replication and partly rescues the sensitivity of rad53 loss in vivo (34387546). This inhibits its replication-speeding function, not its checkpoint mediator function
精製タンパク質で再構成した複製反応で、Rad53 による Mcm10 のリン酸化: In replication reactions reconstituted with purified proteins, Rad53 phosphorylation of Mcm10 slows elongation, but only in the absence of unphosphorylated Mrc1 (34387546)
糖新生条件の Gid 複合体は Gid1/Vid30・Gid2/Rmd5・Gid: The Gid complex under gluconeogenic conditions consists of six subunits: Gid1/Vid30, Gid2/Rmd5, Gid5/Vid28, Gid7, Gid8 and Gid9/Fyv10 (22645139)
糖鎖付加の異常では Kss1 だけが活性化し、活性化した Kss1 と Ptp2: Under glycosylation defects, only Kss1 is activated, and activated Kss1 and Ptp2 inhibit Hog1. Without Kss1 or Ptp2, Hog1 is also activated (19369942)
糸状成長で STE12 mRNA はポリソームに多く結合し Ste12 タンパク: During filamentous growth, STE12 mRNA associates more with polysomes and Ste12 protein increases, but this increase is partly blocked by caf20 and dhh1 mutations (17041186). CAF20 overexpression increases Ste12 protein (18182159)
紡錘体の位置決めタンパク質 Kar9 は星状微小管だけでなく動原体微小管にも局在: The spindle positioning protein Kar9 localizes not only to astral microtubules but also to kinetochore microtubules, where the STUbL Slx5-Slx8 targets it for proteasomal degradation. Kar9 SUMOylation is not required, but SUMO-dependent recruitment of the STUbL to kinetochores is. Failure to degrade Kar9 causes defects in chromosome segregation and spindle positioning (26906737)
紡錘体チェックポイントが働くと Mps1 が Mad1 をリン酸化し、Mps1: When the spindle checkpoint is active, Mps1 phosphorylates Mad1, and Mps1 overexpression modifies Mad1 and arrests cells in mitosis with a normal spindle (not in checkpoint mutants) (8688079)
紡錘体位置チェックポイント（SPOC）の Kin4 は母細胞側で FEAR によ: Kin4 of the spindle position checkpoint (SPOC) counteracts FEAR-mediated MEN activation in the mother cell. In the main text, Cdc28-Clb2 phosphorylates six CDK sites of Bfa1 in vitro, and non-phosphorylatable bfa1-6A loses the SPOC in cells lacking FEAR and Kin4. The authors favor a model in which phosphorylation by Kin4 and CDK keeps the Bfa1-Bub2 GAP active in parallel (28117323). The effect is seen only in specific genetic backgrounds, so confidence is medium
細胞のストレスで Chs3 の定常状態の局在が内部の貯蔵（キトソーム）から細胞膜: Upon cell stress, the steady-state localization of Chs3 rapidly shifts from internal stores (chitosomes) to the plasma membrane, which requires Rho1 and Pkc1 but not the MAP kinase module. Expressing active Rho1 or Pkc1 alone moves Chs3 to the plasma membrane even without stress (12928491)
細胞内架橋で Cdc73 と Spt6 の直接の結合を検出。試験管内でも結合。S: In vivo cross-linking detected direct binding of Cdc73 and Spt6, which also bind in vitro. Rapid depletion of Spt6 releases Paf1 from chromatin (36928138)
細胞壁の損傷では Pkc1-Mpk1 の活性が皮質の PP2A(Cdc55) を: Upon cell wall damage, Pkc1-Mpk1 activity inhibits cortical PP2A(Cdc55), and Rho1 preferentially activates the cell wall pathway. In the main text, Rho1 activation of Pkc1-Mpk1 causes loss of cortical Cdc55 and Zds1
細胞壁ストレスでの FKS2 の転写の活性化は SBF（Swi4/Swi6）と: Transcriptional activation of FKS2 under cell wall stress depends on SBF (Swi4/Swi6) and the activating signal to Mpk1 (18268013)
細胞外のアミノ酸に応じて Ssy5 は Stp1 と Stp2 を切って活性化し: In response to extracellular amino acids, Ssy5 cleaves and activates Stp1 and Stp2, raising expression of genes regulated by the SPS sensor. Cleavage of Stp1 and Stp2 occurs between a P1 cysteine and a P1' serine or alanine (29661936)
細胞外タンパク質 Ecm33 は効率のよいグルコースの取り込みと、栄養に応じた: The extracellular protein Ecm33 is required for efficient glucose uptake and full nutrient-responsive activation of the TORC1 pathway. Without it, autophagy occurs and the TORC1 substrates Atg13 and Sch9 are dephosphorylated (29029364)
細胞膜での Rsp5/Art4 による Chs3 の N 末端のユビキチン化は、: Ubiquitination of the Chs3 N-terminus by Rsp5/Art4 at the plasma membrane makes Chs3 recognized by ESCRT and degraded in the vacuole (27798229). With external calcium, the Rsp5 adaptor Rcr1 ubiquitinates and reduces Chs3 (32421152)
細胞膜の GEF Rom2 からのシグナルが Elo2 のリン酸化状態と VLC: Signals from the plasma membrane GEF Rom2 control the phosphorylation state of Elo2 and VLCFA synthesis (25519905)
細胞膜のカゼインキナーゼ 1（Yck1/2）は Rim21 依存で Rim8 の: Plasma membrane casein kinase 1 (Yck1/2) phosphorylates multiple sites in the Rim8 hinge region in a Rim21-dependent manner (also in vitro with purified Yck1). Loss of CK1 constitutively activates the RIM pathway; non-phosphorylatable Rim8 mutants activate pH signaling, while phosphomimetic mutants impair it. Rim8 phosphorylation prevents Rim8 from accumulating at the plasma membrane at acidic pH, inhibiting RIM signaling (25851600). Examined in yck1Δ yck2ts
細胞膜のカゼインキナーゼ 1（Yck1/2）は Rim8 のヒンジ領域を多部位リ: Plasma membrane casein kinase 1 (Yck1/2) phosphorylates multiple sites in the Rim8 hinge region, and loss of CK1 (yck1Δ yck2ts) constitutively activates the RIM pathway. Rim8 phosphorylation prevents Rim8 from accumulating at the plasma membrane at acidic pH, inhibiting RIM signaling (25851600)
細胞膜のストレスのもとで Ypk1/Ypk2 はホスファチジルセリンなどの脂質の: Under plasma membrane stress, Ypk1/Ypk2 change the arrangement of lipids such as phosphatidylserine to retain Rho1 at the plasma membrane. Genetics suggests this is via a Lem3-containing flippase (28167678)
細胞表面のセンサー候補 Mid2 を欠くと、バナジン酸による Slt2 のリン酸: Lacking the candidate cell-surface sensor Mid2 prevents vanadate-induced Slt2 phosphorylation (caffeine-induced phosphorylation still occurs) (10625705)
細胞質の 2 つのチオレドキシン Trx1・Trx2 は過酸化水素処理での Ms: The two cytoplasmic thioredoxins Trx1 and Trx2 are essential for nuclear accumulation of Msn2/4 upon hydrogen peroxide treatment. This nuclear accumulation does not correlate with reduced PKA activity (19581440)
細胞質の Bud20 は Kap123 依存の経路で核へ戻る（23045392）: Cytoplasmic Bud20 returns to the nucleus via a Kap123-dependent pathway (23045392)
細胞質の Mn が増えると TORC1 の活性が上がり、これは Smf1・Smf: Increased cytosolic Mn raises TORC1 activity, depending on Smf1 and Smf2. In vitro, Mn2+ activates TORC1 better than Mg2+ (35904415)
細胞質の亜鉛が少ないとき Yke4 は分泌経路から亜鉛を除き、YKE4 欠失は: When cytosolic zinc is low, Yke4 removes zinc from the secretory pathway, and YKE4 deletion partly compensates for Msc2 deletion (16760462)
細胞質の微小管に欠陥があると Spc72 が Kin4 を両方の SPB に呼び: When cytoplasmic microtubules are defective, Spc72 recruits Kin4 to both SPBs, and Kin4 phosphorylates Bfa1, delaying mitotic exit (17967947)
細胞質の鉄が増えると Yap5 が活性化して液胞の鉄輸送体 CCC1 の転写を上: When cytosolic iron increases, Yap5 is activated and raises transcription of the vacuolar iron transporter CCC1 (22915593). CCC1 transcription is raised by iron through Yap sequences, with Yap5 as its transcription factor (18070921)
細胞質分裂のとき Cdc5 が Hof1 をリン酸化した後 Dbf2-Mob1: During cytokinesis, after Cdc5 phosphorylates Hof1, Dbf2-Mob1 phosphorylates it, releasing Hof1 from the septin ring and binding it to the contractile ring (21498574)
細胞質分裂の前、Myo1 の局在はセプチン結合タンパク質 Bni5 に依存する（: Before cytokinesis, Myo1 localization depends on the septin-binding protein Bni5 (21173112)
細胞質分裂の調節因子 Hof1 が Ubp5 の局在に必要（26427873）: The cytokinesis regulator Hof1 is required for Ubp5 localization (26427873)
細胞質分裂の間、Myo1 の局在は IQGAP の Iqg1 に依存する（211: During cytokinesis, Myo1 localization depends on the IQGAP Iqg1 (21173112)
細胞質微小管に異常があると Spc72 が Kin4 を両方の SPB に呼び込: When cytoplasmic microtubules are abnormal, Spc72 recruits Kin4 to both SPBs, and Kin4 phosphorylates Bfa1, protecting it from inactivation by Cdc5 and delaying mitotic exit (17967947). Phosphorylation by Kin4 creates a Bmh1 binding site, distributing Bfa1 to both SPBs so the SPOC functions (24850890). 21670215 also states that Kin4 phosphorylates Bfa1 to stop mitotic exit
終期の Lte1 の表層からの解離は Cdc14 の活性化に依存し、中期に Cd: Dissociation of Lte1 from the cortex in telophase depends on Cdc14 activation; releasing Cdc14 in metaphase causes early dephosphorylation and cortical release. It is also a direct Cdc14 substrate in vitro (12432084)
終結は Atg1 による Atg13 の再リン酸化で起こり、Δtag1 では A: Termination occurs by rephosphorylation of Atg13 by Atg1, and Δtag1 lacks Atg13 rephosphorylation and PAS dispersal (33536246)
終結は Atg1 による Atg13 の再リン酸化と PAS の解散で起こり、Δ: Termination occurs by rephosphorylation of Atg13 by Atg1 and PAS dispersal, which are lacking in Δtag1 (33536246) (PMID: 33536246)
組み込まれていない Sbh2 は Doa10 に依存して速やかに分解され、デグロ: Unassembled Sbh2 is rapidly degraded in a Doa10-dependent manner, with the degron in the transmembrane segment (25918226). Sbh2 is stabilized in both ubc6Δ and ubc7Δ, more strongly in ubc7Δ. The double deletion does not stabilize it further
組み込まれていない Sbh2 は Doa10 依存で速く分解され、その分解には: Unassembled Sbh2 is rapidly degraded in a Doa10-dependent manner, requiring both Ubc6 and Ubc7 (Ubc7 being the main one). Main text: HA-Sbh2 is clearly stabilized in ubc6Δ or ubc7Δ (25918226). 39533056 is a paper on in vitro Sbh2 ubiquitination (on serines) reconstituted with Doa10 and Ubc6
組換え CF IA の組み立てに Clp1 が要り、P ループ変異の一部は Pc: Assembly of recombinant CF IA requires Clp1, and some P-loop mutants cannot bind Pcf11 (22216186)
組換え Dpm1 を PKA で試験管内でリン酸化すると Vmax が約 6 倍: Phosphorylating recombinant Dpm1 with PKA in vitro raises Vmax about 6-fold. It decreases with S141A. Not confirmed in vivo
組換え Sas2 の HAT 活性は Sas4 を絶対に必要とし、Sas5 で高: The HAT activity of recombinant Sas2 absolutely requires Sas4 and is enhanced by Sas5 (12626510)
組換えの Dcp1p と Dcp2p を一緒に精製すると活性のある脱キャップ酵素: Copurifying recombinant Dcp1p and Dcp2p yields an active decapping enzyme; Dcp2p is thought to be the catalytic subunit and Dcp1p to enhance Dcp2p activity (12554866)
組換えの複合体から、Pml1 は Snu17（IST3）に結合し、Snu17 が: From recombinant complexes, Pml1 binds Snu17 (IST3), and Snu17 contacts Bud13 (19033360)
組換えタンパク質で Apc11 は E2 の Ubc4 と直接結合する（1088: With recombinant proteins, Apc11 binds the E2 Ubc4 directly (10888670)
組換えタンパク質で Nab2 と Gfd1 の直接結合、ツーハイブリッドで Na: Direct binding of Nab2 and Gfd1 with recombinant proteins, binding to the Nab2 N-terminus in two-hybrid, and a Nab2-Gfd1 complex by coimmunoprecipitation from yeast extracts (15208322)
経時老化で H3K36me3 が下がるのは Set2 の分解による。分解は Ub: The decline of H3K36me3 during chronological aging is due to Set2 degradation. Degradation is mediated by Ubc3 and Bre1, and acetylation of Set2 by Gcn5 is a prerequisite for its polyubiquitination by Bre1 and degradation (37796660)
経時老化での Set2 の分解は Ubc3 と Bre1 が担い、Bre1 がな: Set2 degradation during chronological aging is mediated by Ubc3 and Bre1; without Bre1 or with ubiquitination abolished, Set2 is stable, H3K36me3 is maintained and lifespan is extended (37796660)
経路が働くと Slt2 は Msg5 をリン酸化し、Msg5 と Slt2 の親: When the pathway is active, Slt2 phosphorylates Msg5, lowering the Msg5-Slt2 affinity. The authors speculate that Slt2 inhibits Msg5 function by weakening the binding (14703512). 26786099 shows that Slt2 phosphorylates the Msg5 N-terminus and catalytic domain
結合分子を作れない Rad51 変異でも減数分裂の組換えは正常で、Rad51 は: Even Rad51 mutants unable to form joint molecules have normal meiotic recombination; Rad51 acts with Mei5-Sae3 as a cofactor of Dmc1. Rad51 catalyzes recombination directly in mitosis and via Dmc1 in meiosis (22955832). Rad51 acts as an accessory protein of Dmc1 in meiosis (31790385)
網羅的な検索で SCF(Grr1) の新しい代謝の基質として Tye7 と Pf: A comprehensive search found Tye7 and Pfk27 as new metabolic substrates of SCF(Grr1), which targets them in response to glucose removal (17828247)
縮退した RING をもつ Gid9/Fyv10 が Gid2/Rmd5 に結合: Gid9/Fyv10, with a degenerate RING, binds Gid2/Rmd5, and its mutation abolishes polyubiquitination and degradation of gluconeogenic enzymes (22044534)
翻訳抑制因子 Rim4 はアミロイド様の集合体をつくる。Ime2 が Rim4: The translational repressor Rim4 forms amyloid-like assemblies. Ime2 phosphorylates multiple sites in the intrinsically disordered region of Rim4, dissolving the assemblies and leading to proteasomal degradation (29738715). At the start of meiosis II, Ime2 activity rises and Rim4 decreases, relieving translational repression of CLB3 and others (24115771). BioGRID's 35508136 is a paper showing that 14-3-3 assists Rim4 phosphorylation and clearance, and 16319894 is a protein chip global analysis
胞子形成で IME1 の転写物が十分に蓄積するには MCK1 が要る。栄養増殖で: Full accumulation of IME1 transcripts during sporulation requires MCK1. It is also required for basal IME1 expression during vegetative growth (2010083)
胞子形成培地にグルコースを加えると Ime2 が不安定になり、その分解には Gr: Adding glucose to sporulation medium destabilizes Ime2, and its degradation requires Grr1, Cdc53 and Cdc34. Ubiquitin conjugates of Ime2 are detected, and their formation depends on GRR1 (15601864)
胞子形成培地に移ると Cdh1 は APC-Cdh1 自身によって分解される。分: Upon transfer to sporulation medium, Cdh1 is degraded by APC-Cdh1 itself. Degradation requires direct phosphorylation of Cdh1 S200 by the SNF1 complex, and S200A mutant Cdh1 is stable and causes abnormal meiosis and sporulation (42160514)
脂質の非対称性が乱れた細胞で Opt2 は Rim101 経路により誘導される（: In cells with disrupted lipid asymmetry, Opt2 is induced by the Rim101 pathway (25359886)
脱リン酸された Kxd1 は Vps21 の GAP の Msb3 との結合が強: Dephosphorylated Kxd1 binds more strongly to Msb3, the GAP of Vps21, accelerating Vps21 inactivation (42412525)
脱リン酸化された Hog1 の核からの運び出しには NES 受容体 Xpo1/C: Nuclear export of dephosphorylated Hog1 requires the NES receptor Xpo1/Crm1 (9755161)
脱リン酸化した Amu1/Par32 は細胞表面に集まり、特定のアンモニウム輸送: Dephosphorylated Amu1/Par32 gathers at the cell surface and inhibits specific ammonium transporters. Conserved repeat sequences are required for binding to the transporters (26172854). Npr1 regulates Mep1 and Mep3 via Par32 (30156471)
脱リン酸化で下がった Dgk1 の DAG キナーゼ活性は CKII 処理で 5: The DAG kinase activity of Dgk1, reduced by dephosphorylation, is restored 5.5-fold by CKII treatment. CKII phosphorylates Dgk1 S45 and S46 (mainly S46). In vivo, S46A and S45A/S46A lose the stationary-phase increase in DAG kinase activity and have reduced ability to produce PA and cause the pah1Δ phenotype (27834677)
脱抑制に Bas1・Pho2 が必要。ChIP で Bas1 が ADE1・AD: Derepression requires Bas1 and Pho2. By ChIP, Bas1 binds the ADE1, ADE2, ADE4, ADE5,7 and HIS4 promoters (16215179)
膜に結合した Vta1 は Vps60 と共精製され、液胞前区画で Vps60: Membrane-bound Vta1 copurifies with Vps60 and interacts with Vps60 in the prevacuolar compartment (14701806)
自己リン酸化部位の変異 rad53-TA で Rad53・Dun1・14-3-3: The autophosphorylation site mutant rad53-TA showed genetic interactions among Rad53, Dun1 and the 14-3-3 proteins Bmh1/Bmh2, providing evidence that 14-3-3 directly assists Rad53 function in vivo (17299042)
自己抑制で重合しない Snf7 が Bro1 と混ぜると重合し、Bro1 が S: Autoinhibited, non-polymerizing Snf7 polymerizes when mixed with Bro1; Bro1 directly activates Snf7 (27074665 main text). Bro1 overexpression prevents disassembly by Vps4 and stabilizes ESCRT-III in vivo and in vitro (21263029)
自由な Gβγ は Far1-Cdc24 を伸びる場所へ呼び寄せる（236134: Free Gβγ recruits Far1-Cdc24 to sites of growth (23613469). Cdc24, Far1 and Gβ form a complex, and pairwise binding occurs even without the third (10087263). Far1 links activated Gβγ to the GEF Cdc24 (14988725)
自食作用の誘導時に Atg2 が Hsv2 を PAS へ呼ぶ（34368840: During autophagy induction, Atg2 recruits Hsv2 to the PAS (34368840)
芽の皮質に移った Lte1 は小 GTPase の Ras と Bud1 の活性: Lte1 that has moved to the bud cortex prevents activation of the small GTPases Ras and Bud1 (21149565)
芽の首にある Elm1 は Kin4 の活性化ループの保存残基をリン酸化して K: Elm1 at the bud neck phosphorylates conserved residues in the Kin4 activation loop, activating Kin4. Inactivating Elm1 abolishes Kin4 kinase activity in vivo and the SPOC response to spindle misorientation (20855503)
芽の首に順に集まる Cla4 と Cdc5 が Swe1 を段階的にリン酸化して: Cla4 and Cdc5, which gather sequentially at the bud neck, phosphorylate Swe1 stepwise to reduce its function (15037762). Phosphorylation of Swe1 by Clb2-Cdc28 provides a scaffold that promotes hyperphosphorylation by Cdc5 and degradation (15920482)
芽の首に順に集まる Cla4（PAK）と Cdc5（Polo）が Swe1 を段: Cla4 (PAK) and Cdc5 (Polo), which gather sequentially at the bud neck, phosphorylate Swe1 stepwise and reduce it (15037762)
蓋の変異株で Rpn3-Rpn7 の組などの中間体が見つかる（20471955）: Intermediates such as the Rpn3-Rpn7 pair are found in lid mutants (20471955)
複合体 I では Atg14 が Vps30 を Vps34 につなぎ、複合体: In complex I, Atg14 links Vps30 to Vps34; in complex II, Vps38 does (22437838)
複合体 II では Vps38 が Vps30 を Vps34 につなぐ（224: In complex II, Vps38 links Vps30 to Vps34 (22437838)
複数の Nhp6 分子がヌクレオソームに結合して構造を変え、Spt16-Pob3: Multiple Nhp6 molecules bind nucleosomes and change their structure, allowing Spt16-Pob3 to bind and form yFACT-nucleosome complexes (12952948)
複製が止まると Mec1 が停止したフォークで Mrc1 をリン酸化し、Rad5: When replication stalls, Mec1 phosphorylates Mrc1 at stalled forks, creating a scaffold for Rad53 activation. Mutating the Mec1 sites of Mrc1 abolishes phosphorylation and Rad53 is not activated (12865299). BioGRID's 19457865 is a reconstitution paper showing that Mrc1 assists Rad53 phosphorylation by Mec1, and does not describe effects of Mrc1 phosphorylation

酵母から精製した VTC 複合体は Vtc4 1 個・Vtc3 1 個・Vtc1: The VTC complex purified from yeast is a heteropentamer of one Vtc4, one Vtc3 and three Vtc1 (37066886)
酵母では Arf の GEF Syt1 が Arl1 を活性化し、Imh1 が後: In yeast, the Arf GEF Syt1 activates Arl1, and Imh1 gathers at the late Golgi. The Ire1-Hac1 pathway regulates Syt1 phosphorylation, which enhances Arl1 activation, Imh1 recruitment and Syt1-Arl1 binding. Inducing the UPR with tunicamycin increases Syt1 phosphorylation and activates Arl1 (26966233)
酵母の CCT は PLP2p と三者複合体を作りアクチンを折りたたみ、精製系で: Yeast CCT forms a ternary complex with PLP2p to fold actin and restores denatured actin to the native state in a purified system. A system to follow actin folding by fluorescence was developed (21056978)
酵母の Dph1 と Dph2 は複合体を作り、試験管内で第 1 段階を触媒する: Yeast Dph1 and Dph2 form a complex sufficient to catalyze the first step in vitro (24422557)
酵母の Dr1/DRAP1 抑制複合体は必須遺伝子 YDR1 と BUR6 にコ: The yeast Dr1/DRAP1 repressor complex is encoded by the essential genes YDR1 and BUR6, and the yDr1/Bur6 complex represses transcription in vitro (9023340)
酵母の Nopp140 相同体 SRP40 は、Nopp140 と同様に cas: SRP40, the yeast homolog of Nopp140, is phosphorylated by casein kinase II like Nopp140, but to a much lower extent (8702624)
酵母の Nsg は Hmg2 のステロール感知ドメインを含む膜貫通部分に直接結合: Yeast Nsg binds directly to the transmembrane region of Hmg2 containing its sterol-sensing domain and specifically inhibits Hmg2 degradation. Nsg1 acts at its native level (16270032). Nsg1 inhibits GGPP-stimulated ERAD and stabilizes Hmg2, and its binding and stabilization require lanosterol (23306196)
酵母の PFK-1 は PFK1 と PFK2 がコードする α・β サブユニッ: Yeast PFK-1 is a hetero-octamer of α and β subunits encoded by PFK1 and PFK2 (15116431)
酵母の SF3b 下位複合体に Rse1p・Hsh155p・Hsh49p・Cus: Rse1p, Hsh155p, Hsh49p, Cus1p, Rds3p and others copurify in the yeast SF3b subcomplex (16314500)
酵母の TORC1 は lipin の Pah1 の働きを抑え、トリアシルグリセ: Yeast TORC1 inhibits the function of the lipin Pah1, preventing triacylglycerol accumulation. Stopping TORC1 dephosphorylates and activates Pah1, and TAG increases in a Pah1-dependent manner. This regulation requires Nem1-Spo7 (25117580)
酵母の TORC2 は AVO1・AVO2・AVO3・BIT61・LST8・TO: Yeast TORC2 consists of six components: AVO1, AVO2, AVO3, BIT61, LST8 and TOR2 (16002396)
酵母の TRAPP サブユニットで試験管内に Bet3 は Trs33 と結合し: Among yeast TRAPP subunits, Bet3 binds Trs33 in vitro, which promotes Bet3-Bet5 binding (16262728)
酵母の Tcd はミトコンドリア外膜にあり、ヘテロ／ホモ二量体を作る。本文: T: Yeast Tcd is in the mitochondrial outer membrane and forms hetero- and homodimers. Main text: Tcd2 forms a heterodimer with Tcd1, and ct6A is not formed even in either single deletion (42087783)
酵母のアンチザイム Oaz1 の合成はポリアミンで調節されるフレームシフトを伴い: Synthesis of yeast antizyme Oaz1 involves a polyamine-regulated frameshift, and proteasomal degradation of ODC (Spe1) depends on Oaz1. Oaz1 itself is degraded in a ubiquitin-dependent manner, and its degradation is inhibited by polyamines (15538383). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition)
酵母のストークは P1A-P2B と P1B-P2A の 2 つのヘテロ複合体が: The yeast stalk forms from two heterocomplexes, P1A-P2B and P1B-P2A, attached to the ribosome via P0. The P1A-P2B complex, unlike the individual proteins, has a hydrophobic core (12653543)
酵母のプロテアファジーは受容体 Cue5 を使い、Cue5 はユビキチンと At: Yeast proteaphagy uses the receptor Cue5, which binds ubiquitin and Atg8 simultaneously (27477278)
酵母の抽出液から Dam1・Duo1・Dad1・Spc19・Spc34・Dad2: A ~245 kD complex containing Dam1, Duo1, Dad1, Spc19, Spc34, Dad2 and Ask1 was purified from yeast extracts (11756468)
酵母の高浸透圧による液胞からの Ca2+ 放出は PI(3,5)P2 の産生と: Hyperosmotic Ca2+ release from the yeast vacuole requires both PI(3,5)P2 production and the TRPML homolog (20802798). Main text: release is abolished in fab1Δ and yvc1Δ
酵母は菌類特有の Tco89 を使って TORC1 を活性型の Rag GTPa: Yeast uses the fungus-specific Tco89 to tether TORC1 to active Rag GTPases. This binding allows TORC1 to finely tune Sch9 activity in response to amino acids (40359108)
酵母プロフィリンは酵母アクチンに強く結合し、ヌクレオチド交換を促す（182232: Yeast profilin binds yeast actin strongly and promotes nucleotide exchange (18223293)
酵母抽出液に Kin28-Ccl1-Tfb3 の三量体が存在する（1183979: A Kin28-Ccl1-Tfb3 trimer is present in yeast extracts (11839796)
酵母抽出物のペプチドライブラリーで、リボソームタンパク質 Rpl24a が Np: A peptide library from yeast extracts showed that the ribosomal protein Rpl24a is a good in vitro substrate of Npr1 (19780626)
酵母細胞から取った 90S のクライオ電顕で Bfr2-Lcp5 複合体を捉え、: Cryo-EM of 90S isolated from yeast cells captured the Bfr2-Lcp5 complex, consistent with protein-protein binding results (35650250)
酵素は α・β サブユニットからなり、LSC1・LSC2 のどちらを欠いても活性: The enzyme consists of α and β subunits and has no activity if either LSC1 or LSC2 is lacking (9874242)
酸化ストレスで Cdc48 がミトコンドリアに局在し、これは Vms1 に依存す: Under oxidative stress, Cdc48 localizes to mitochondria, dependent on Vms1. Vms1 binds Cdc48 stably (21070972)
酸化ストレスで Med13 が分解され、サイクリン C が細胞質へ出る。Slt2: Under oxidative stress, Med13 is degraded and cyclin C exits to the cytoplasm. Slt2 first phosphorylates cyclin C to release it from Med13, then modifies Med13 itself to promote its degradation by SCF-Grr1 (29212878)
酸化ストレスで Med13 が分解されサイクリン C が細胞質に出る。Snf1: Under oxidative stress, Med13 is degraded and cyclin C exits to the cytoplasm. Snf1 activates the second SCF-Grr1 degron of Med13; snf1Δ cannot degrade Med13 and cyclin C remains in the nucleus (30175106). Main text: Snf1 activation is necessary but not sufficient for Med13 degradation upon H2O2
酸化ストレスで Psk1 の活性が上がり、Psk1 は Mrc1 と結合して N: Oxidative stress raises Psk1 activity; Psk1 binds Mrc1 and phosphorylates its N-terminus (in vivo phosphorylation decreases in psk1). In both psk1 and mrc1-3A, the H2O2-induced S-phase delay disappears and TAR and genomic instability increase (no additivity in the double mutant) (29371596)
酸化ストレスで SCF-Grr1 ユビキチンリガーゼが Med13 を分解し、サ: Under oxidative stress, the SCF-Grr1 ubiquitin ligase degrades Med13 and cyclin C exits to the cytoplasm (30175106)
酸化ストレスによる GPX2 の誘導は Yap1 と Skn7 で厳密に制御され: Induction of GPX2 by oxidative stress is strictly controlled by Yap1 and Skn7 (15225652)
酸化ストレスのあと Skn7 は TRX2 とチオレドキシン還元酵素の遺伝子の誘: After oxidative stress, Skn7 regulates induction of TRX2 and the thioredoxin reductase gene and binds the TRX2 promoter in vitro (9118942). Yap1 and Skn7 cooperatively activate TRX2 and TRR1 (10347154)
酸化ストレス下で GSH2 の発現は Yap1 に制御され、熱ショックでの GS: Under oxidative stress, GSH2 expression is controlled by Yap1, and induction of GSH1 and GSH2 by heat shock is also Yap1-dependent (10809786)
酸化剤で GLR1 の発現は 2〜3 倍に上がり、この調節は Yap1 に依存す: Oxidants raise GLR1 expression 2- to 3-fold, and this regulation depends on Yap1 (8843443)
重複したユビキチンリガーゼ Dma1・Dma2 は Elm1 を芽の首へ効率よく: The redundant ubiquitin ligases Dma1 and Dma2 efficiently gather Elm1 at the bud neck, controlling septin dynamics and the SPOC. In dma1 dma2, Elm1 at the bud neck and Elm1-dependent Kin4 activation decrease, and artificially targeting Elm1 to the bud neck restores them
重複して働く E3 の Dma1 と Dma2 が Mmr1 をユビキチン化し、: The redundant E3s Dma1 and Dma2 ubiquitinate Mmr1, which is rapidly degraded by the proteasome. In dma1Δ dma2Δ, Mmr1 lifetime is extended and mitochondria accumulate at the bud tip. In vitro too, Dma1 ubiquitinates Mmr1 phosphorylated by Ste20 and Cla4 (35422486)
重複して働く Ptc2・Ptc3 が Atg13 と Atg1 を脱リン酸化して: The redundant Ptc2 and Ptc3 dephosphorylate Atg13 and Atg1 to regulate autophagy. Lacking both stops starvation-induced autophagy and the Cvt pathway and impairs recruitment to the PAS. ATG13-8SA, lacking TORC1 sites, partly bypasses the defect (30655342)
重金属ストレスでの PUN1 の転写誘導に Crz1 が必要（ノーザン）（212: Transcriptional induction of PUN1 under heavy metal stress requires Crz1 (Northern) (21223946)
野生型では β6（Pre7）と β7（Pre4）のプロペプチドが β2（Pup1: In wild type, the propeptides of β6 (Pre7) and β7 (Pre4) are cleaved to the final form by β2 (Pup1) (10500111)
野生型ではイノシトールで EPT1 の転写と活性が下がるが、cpt1 株では下が: In wild type, inositol lowers EPT1 transcription and activity, but not in cpt1 strains. CPT1 is required for regulation of phospholipid synthesis by inositol (7961831)
野生型の Arp5-Ies6 モジュールを加えると INO80 の ATP 加水: Adding the wild-type Arp5-Ies6 module enhances ATP hydrolysis and nucleosome sliding by INO80. Incorporation of Arp5-Ies6 into INO80 requires Ies2 and the Ino80 spacer region (26306040). 26755556 also states that Arp5-Ies6 enhances INO80 function in vitro
野生型の Rpl22A/Rpl22B タンパク質が RPL22B イントロンの領: Wild-type Rpl22A/Rpl22B proteins bind a region of the RPL22B intron, inhibiting RPL22B splicing and lowering its expression (29304067)
野生型の量の LEU1・LEU2 の RNA には LEU3 が必要で、LEU4: Wild-type levels of LEU1 and LEU2 RNA require LEU3, and LEU4 transcripts are also affected by LEU3 (2823102). Leu3 binds the LEU1, LEU4 and ILV2 promoters (3043190)
野生型の量の LEU2 の RNA には LEU3 が必要で、Leu3 依存の結: Wild-type levels of LEU2 RNA require LEU3, and a Leu3-dependent binding activity binds upstream of LEU2 (2823102)
鉄があると Aft1 の核外輸送が進み、その受容体は Msn5。Msn5 は鉄が: Iron promotes nuclear export of Aft1, with Msn5 as its receptor. Msn5 recognizes Aft1 when iron is sufficient, which requires phosphorylation of S210 and S224 and iron-induced intermolecular interaction of Aft1 (17538022). Export from the nucleus was treated as inhibition
鉄がないとき、Fet3-Ftr1 は Snx3 とレトロマーに依存する再利用の経: In the absence of iron, Fet3-Ftr1 is maintained at the plasma membrane by a Snx3- and retromer-dependent recycling pathway, and the Ftr1 recycling signal binds Snx3 directly (17420293, 18768754)
In the absence of iron, Fet3-Ftr1 is maintained at the plasma membrane by a Snx3- and retromer-dependent recycling pathway (17420293)
鉄が足りないとき Cth2 の標的である SDH4 mRNA の分解は Dhh1: Under iron deficiency, decay of SDH4 mRNA, a Cth2 target, depends on Dhh1. Cth2 binds Dhh1 (18715869). Upon iron depletion, Cth2 represses translation of SDH4 and CTH2 mRNAs, which requires the ARE and TZF (29912874)
鉄が足りないとき、Cth1/Cth2 は WTM1 mRNA に結合して分解を促: Under iron deficiency, Cth1/Cth2 bind WTM1 mRNA and promote its decay, causing Rnr2-Rnr4 to move to the cytoplasm (22152479)

Under iron deficiency, Cth1/Cth2 bind WTM1 mRNA and promote its decay; Wtm1, which anchors Rnr2-Rnr4 in the nucleus, decreases and Rnr2-Rnr4 move to the cytoplasm (22152479). Cth2 also represses translation of WTM1, CCP1 and HEM15 mRNAs (29912874)
鉄に応じて Yap5 が制御する遺伝子として TYW1 が誘導される（21917: TYW1 is induced as a gene controlled by Yap5 in response to iron (21917924)
鉄の制限で Aft1 が FET4 の発現を誘導する（12095998）: Under iron limitation, Aft1 induces FET4 expression (12095998)
鉄の制限や Cth2 の過剰発現で ERG1・ERG7・ERG11 が下がる。C: Iron limitation or Cth2 overexpression lowers ERG1, ERG7 and ERG11. Cth2 represses translation of these ARE-containing mRNAs and reduces the mRNAs (37453649)
鉄の制限や Cth2 の過剰発現で、エルゴステロール合成の初めの 3 段階（ER: Iron limitation or Cth2 overexpression lowers the first three steps of ergosterol synthesis (ERG1, ERG7, ERG11). Cth2 represses translation of these ARE-containing ERG mRNAs and reduces the mRNAs (37453649)
鉄の欠乏で AFT1 が FET3 プロモーターに結合し転写を活性化する。結合部: Under iron deficiency, AFT1 binds the FET3 promoter and activates transcription. The binding site is occupied only in iron-deficient cells (8670839)
鉄欠乏での ERG 遺伝子の活性化は Upc2 と Ecm22 による（3638: Activation of ERG genes under iron deficiency is due to Upc2 and Ecm22 (36382795). Main text: basal expression of ERG genes including ERG11 decreases in ecm22Δ
鉄欠乏による CTR2 の誘導は Mac1 か Aft1 の欠失でなくなる。外か: Induction of CTR2 by iron deficiency is abolished by deletion of Mac1 or Aft1. Exogenously expressed Aft1 and Mac1 form a stable complex and synergistically raise CTR2 transcription (22683637)
鉄欠乏への適応のあいだ、Cth2 の N 末端のセリンのリン酸化が SCF-Gr: During adaptation to iron deficiency, phosphorylation of N-terminal serines of Cth2 promotes recognition by SCF-Grr1 and accelerates proteasomal degradation. If it cannot be degraded, Cth2 increases and cells fail to grow under iron deficiency. Hrr25 phosphorylates Cth2 and promotes its destabilization (30228242)
銅の添加で Ctr1 がユビキチン化され、rsp5 変異でユビキチン化・エンドサ: Copper addition causes Ctr1 ubiquitination, and rsp5 mutations nearly abolish ubiquitination, endocytosis and degradation. They are also greatly reduced in bul1Δ bul2Δ (17645432)
銅を感じる転写因子 Mac1 は CTR1・CTR3 の転写を調節するが、銅に依: The copper-sensing transcription factor Mac1 regulates CTR1 and CTR3 transcription and is also required for copper-dependent Ctr1 degradation. Mutations in the Mac1 Cu-fist or Ctr1 REP-III impair Ctr1 degradation (12011036)
銅欠乏による CTR2 の転写誘導は mac1 の欠失でなくなり、ChIP で: Transcriptional induction of CTR2 by copper deficiency is abolished by mac1 deletion; by ChIP, Mac1 binds the CTR2 promoter, and Mac1 overexpression raises CTR2 transcription (22445756)
長い前期 I には APC/C とその減数分裂特異的活性化因子 Ama1 による: A long prophase I requires inhibition of mitotic-type control by the APC/C and its meiosis-specific activator Ama1; APC/C-Ama1 causes degradation of M-phase regulators and Ndd1. ama1Δ exits prophase I early (23101628)
隣の遺伝子 ISF1 が NAM7/UPF1 の抑圧活性の効率を上げる（7506: The neighboring gene ISF1 increases the efficiency of the suppressor activity of NAM7/UPF1 (7506349)
静止期への移行では Rpd3 が遺伝子の半分以上のプロモーターに呼ばれ、それには: During the transition to quiescence, Rpd3 is recruited to the promoters of more than half of genes, which requires quiescence transcription factors such as Xbp1 and Stb3 (26300265). Main text: in stb3Δ, the Rpd3 ChIP signal at Stb3 binding sequences disappears
非共有結合の Scw4 は Kex2 で切られ、さらにヤプシンで Kex2 部位: Non-covalently bound Scw4 is cleaved by Kex2 and further by yapsins 9 residues downstream of the Kex2 site. Only the fully mature form shows a phenotype when overexpressed (27965112)
非発酵性炭素源での Sip4 のリン酸化には Srb10 が要り、Srb10 の: Sip4 phosphorylation on non-fermentable carbon sources requires Srb10, and Srb10 catalytic activity enhances transcriptional activation by LexA-Sip4. Srb10 and Sip4 coprecipitate and bind in two-hybrid (11486018)
非発酵条件で ACS1・FBP1・ICL1・IDP2・JEN1・MLS1・PCK: Under non-fermentative conditions, Cat8 is required for derepression of ACS1, FBP1, ICL1, IDP2, JEN1, MLS1, PCK1, SFC1 and SIP4 (11024040)
飢餓で Atg3 の K19・K48 は一過性にアセチル化される。脱アセチル化酵: Under starvation, Atg3 K19 and K48 are transiently acetylated. Lacking the deacetylase Rpd3 increases acetylation and also autophagy (22539722)
飢餓でのアミノ酸輸送体のエンドサイトーシスには Art2 と、一般アミノ酸制御（: Starvation-induced endocytosis of amino acid transporters requires Art2 and induction of Art2 by the general amino acid control (GAAC) pathway (32744498). Main text: in gcn4Δ, starvation-induced induction of ART2 mRNA and protein is lost
飢餓に応じた Hmt1 の不活性化が Psp2 のアルギニンメチル化と mRNA: Starvation-responsive inactivation of Hmt1 switches arginine methylation and mRNA binding of Psp2 (31666677)
高リン酸の培地で、Pho80–Pho85 が Pho4 の 4 残基をリン酸化し: In high-phosphate medium, Pho80–Pho85 phosphorylates four residues of Pho4 and inactivates it
高圧での Tat2 の分解は Rsp5 依存で、DOA4・UBP6・UBP14: Degradation of Tat2 under high pressure is Rsp5-dependent, and loss of DOA4, UBP6 or UBP14 stabilizes Tat2 (15451116)
高塩濃度など強いストレスでの ATH1 転写の誘導に Hog1 がはっきり関わる: Hog1 is clearly involved in induction of ATH1 transcription under strong stresses such as high salt (19016884)
高浸透圧で Hog1 が Sko1 をリン酸化し、抑制因子から活性化因子に変える: Under hyperosmotic conditions, Hog1 phosphorylates Sko1, converting it from a repressor into an activator
高浸透圧で PBS2 依存に HOG1 がチロシンリン酸化される。Hog1 は: Under hyperosmotic conditions, HOG1 is tyrosine-phosphorylated in a PBS2-dependent manner. Hog1 is activated by Thr and Tyr phosphorylation by Pbs2
高浸透圧で RTG 依存の遺伝子は Hog1 依存に誘導され、Hog1 は Rt: Under hyperosmotic conditions, RTG-dependent genes are induced in a Hog1-dependent manner, and Hog1 is required for nuclear accumulation, chromatin binding and transcriptional activity of Rtg1/3
高浸透圧による SLT2 の誘導は転写因子 Rlm1 と Hog1 に依存する（: Hyperosmotic induction of SLT2 depends on the transcription factor Rlm1 and Hog1 (11923319)
高浸透圧ショックでカルシニューリンが PI(4,5)P2 ホスファターゼ Inp: Upon hyperosmotic shock, calcineurin binds and dephosphorylates the PI(4,5)P2 phosphatase Inp53. It activates Inp53 to repolarize the actin cytoskeleton and maintain plasma membrane shape (25518934)
高浸透圧ストレスは Hog1 を通して AQY2 の発現を抑える（1988909: Hyperosmotic stress represses AQY2 expression through Hog1 (19889095)
高温（37℃）で Fmc1p を欠くと F1 の α・β が凝集し、Atp12p: At high temperature (37°C), lacking Fmc1p causes aggregation of F1 α and β, which is compensated by raising Atp12p expression. Proposed that Fmc1p is required for folding, stability and function of Atp12p under heat stress (11096112)
高濃度の Ca2+ で Hsl1 は芽の首から外れて不安定化し、それには SCF: At high Ca2+, Hsl1 leaves the bud neck and is destabilized, which requires SCF-Cdc4 (not the APC) (11230131)
高濃度のグルコースでは HXT2・HXT4 は Mig1 に抑制され、Mig1: At high glucose, HXT2 and HXT4 are repressed by Mig1, and Mig1 and Rgt1 bind the promoters of both genes and act directly (8816466)
高濃度のグルコースは Rgt2/Snf3 の経路を通じて Mth1 を分解させ、: High glucose causes Mth1 degradation via the Rgt2/Snf3 pathway, and GFP-Mth1 accumulates in the nucleus in rgt2 snf3 (20205947). Snf3 and Rgt2 send a signal that inhibits Std1 and Mth1 function in the presence of glucose (16400179)
